jobs.title: Program Coordinator - YAWL Work Based Learning
jobs.description:
**JOB ANNOUNCEMENT**


The Community Youth Center of San Francisco (CYC) provides the youth of our city a sense of belonging and vital tools and experiences to succeed in life. Our services include academic support and college counseling, job placement and employment training, substance use and violence prevention education, crisis intervention and mediation, leadership development, technology and computer training. Our mission is to encourage a diverse population of high\-need young people to explore their full potential through academic, career, family, and community life.

 **Title:****Program Coordinator \- YAWL Work Based Learning**

**Salary:****$30\.00 \- $34\.00 per hour plus excellent benefits**

**Reports to:****Program Supervisor**

**Status:****Full\-Time, (40 hours/week), Non\-Exempt**  

  

**Program Summary:** CYC’s YAWL Workforce Development Program provides job readiness and employment support services to youth ages 16\-24\. The program offers 1:1 job search and career coaching, work based learning internships, college and career exploration, and job shadowing opportunities to propel youth and young adults to be ready for college, work and reach productive adulthood.  

  

**Position Description:** Under the supervision of the Program Supervisor, the Program Coordinator is responsible for overseeing the Work Based Learning portfolio, supervising staff, overseeing workshops/trainings, establishing best practice program models, and providing high quality youth workforce and development services.

 **DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Oversee the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of the Young Adult Work Link program and comprehensive service delivery model.
* Develop policy and procedure recommendations to strengthen the program model and collaboration among grantee and coalition partners.
* Ensure program development and service delivery align with “Youth Program Quality Standards” and meet all “Work Plan” deliverables and deadlines.
* Complete all required documentation, reports, and program deliverables in a timely manner.
* Lead citywide outreach and recruitment efforts, cultivating strategic community partnerships and developing a robust referral network to support recruitment and engagement, with a focus on priority populations.
* Develop and facilitate job readiness training workshops, including but not limited to professionalism, career exploration, resume and cover letter building, job search/navigation, interview skill development, mock interviews, and strength/talent identification.
* Coordinate subsidized internships, recruiting local SF businesses/employers to partner as a worksite and provide support to worksite supervisors and participants throughout the internship period.
* Conduct participant assessments and provide intensive case management, wraparound supportive services, and guidance to address barriers affecting work and school performance.
* Develop individualized vocational goals and career plans using vocational and interest assessments, and provide personal and career guidance.
* Coordinate GED attainment, tutoring, basic skills remediation, postsecondary education, and workforce training services.
* Provide 1:1 career guidance and assist participants with individualized education and career planning services, job search and placement assistance and conduct follow ups for retention services.
* Connect participants to resources within CYC and other CBO or city services for barrier removal to ensure their success.
* Supervise, support, coach and train Program Specialists in job readiness training content, career counseling, outreach, funder databases, and other duties as applicable.
* Collaborate with the workforce team to strategize on program planning, development and implementation of overall youth workforce development programs and outcomes.
* Partnerships/Event Planning
* Coordinate career exploration events and adult mentoring opportunities such as worksite/company tours, college tours, and networking events for program participants
* Support agency\-wide events and perform other duties as assigned by management.

 **QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor's degree in relevant field.
* Experience working with diverse youth backgrounds, preferably within youth workforce development programs.
* Previous experience in program coordination, internship coordination, and development
* Ability to work with ethnically diverse groups of low\-income youth as well as English learners to support their social and emotional needs during transition.
* At least 1 year of experience supervising a team of three or more staff.
* Experience working with San Francisco's diverse communities and neighborhoods.
* Experience working with community\-based service providers and private sector partners.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills and proficiency in Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, Zoom, and other technology platforms.
* Experience facilitating workshops for youth and young adults.
* Ability to work as part of a team, to prioritize and handle multiple tasks and to work independently in a high\-pressure environment.
* Bilingual in Cantonese/Mandarin/Spanish and English is preferred.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills.
* Enthusiasm for promoting academic achievement and college education.
* Able to lift or move at least 25lbs
* Ability to work some evenings and weekends.

jobs.title: HEALTH EDUCATION PROGRAM COORDINATOR
jobs.description:
The Health Education Program Coordinator manages and implements health education programs, develops community education and outreach activities, and counsels patients.




**ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:**




* Develops, implements, coordinates, and evaluates bilingual health education programs and activities on preventative health care, chronic disease management, Western medicine, and other related topics
* Develops curricula, toolkits, health education programs and materials
* Provides group class and/or one\-on\-one health education services to members and the general public
* Acts as primary liaison with appropriate community agencies and schools to establish, promote, and carry out community education and outreach programs
* Manages Health Education centers
* Counsels patients on a variety of subjects such as diabetes, hypertension, asthma, smoking cessation, substance abuse, teen health, Hepatitis B, preventive cancer screening and immunization, etc.
* Coordinates with clinical departments to develop multilingual educational material
* Reviews translations of materials for accuracy and appropriateness
* Researches grants and funding opportunities, and assists in writing grant proposals
* Collects, tabulates, analyzes program data, and prepares reports
* Works collaboratively with Administration and Project Management Department, and provides support in health information projects such as activity schedule, newsletter, informational displays, flyers posters, staff bulletin, community health events, etc.
* Travels to NEMS’ clinic site to conduct programs and events
* Supervises summer interns and volunteers and assists in implementing education activities for the Health Center Week
* Provides day\-to\-day operational support to Health Education Assistants including scheduling, training, and guidance; acts as a liaison to communicate updates or concerns to Health Education Manager as needed
* Supports walk\-ins and provider referrals to Health Education
* Administers Remote Patient Monitoring assignment, monitoring, tracking and calls
* Calls outreach lists tied to organizational goals and PIP measures, as needed
* Assists with ad hoc outreach lists (e.g., health plan initiatives or incentive programs that require patient outreach), as needed
* Covers and rotates to other sites as required
* Performs other job duties as required by manager/supervisor




**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor’s degree (degree in public health or related field preferred).
* Health \& Wellness Coach Training completed by a NBC\-HWC\-approved program or ability to obtain it within 6 months of first available training date is required
* CHES certification preferred
* Two years’ experience in community health education, health communication or related field preferred
* Prior experience in program planning, design and implementation that incorporates evidence\-based strategies and cultural competency
* Experience with formative research or program evaluation preferred
* Prior experience working with the underserved, immigrant, low\-income and/or Asian communities preferred
* Current documentation of Basic Life Support is required




**LANGUAGE:**




* Must be fluent in English (reading, writing, and speaking)
* Must be fluent in Chinese: Cantonese and/or Mandarin (reading, writing, and speaking)




**STATUS:**




This is an FLSA Non\-exempt position.


This is not an OSHA high\-risk position.

jobs.title: Senior Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Note:If you are a current employee, please apply through the internal career page.**


IOA is on the forefront of revolutionary healthcare models, reshaping the way people can age in place. Our innovative models transform lives, enhance communities, and save healthcare systems millions of dollars. Rather than focusing on archaic outdated design, we strive to consistently question the “status\-quo” and create new and more innovative ways to help aging adults and adults with disabilities maintain their quality of life.


With over 23 programs, we offer multiple ways to aid seniors maintain their health, well\-being, independence and participation in the community, fulfilling our mission.


Urgently hiring.
  

Serving as the key administrative support team member to the Enrichment Center and supporting other Companioa Programs, this role requires a highly organized and proactive individual to ensure maximum efficiency and streamline operations in a highly dynamic team. Primary duties include supporting client referral to enrollment process, client records compliance, transportation management, supply management, and program coordination.**Prospects, Tours \& Enrollments**

* Maintain a thorough knowledge of all dementia services to communicate Companioa programs effectively and accurately to referral sources, prospects, and other visitors to the Enrichment Center.
* Receive all incoming calls to main line at the Enrichment Center \& provide response within 1 business day.
* Facilitate tours of the Enrichment Center for prospects and referral sources as needed and conduct timely follow up after tour to identify next steps.
* Proactively engage Director as enrollment barriers arise.
* Assist new client / family with Enrichment Center enrollment paperwork.
* Ensure all new clients have a successful transition to designated Companioa programs.
* Assist in completing \& submitting transit applications and supplemental documentation for all impacted new enrollees.
**Client Records \& Billing Management**

* Maintain daily attendance log with updates, notes, and client\-specific needs.
* Enter client status updates (enrollment, disenrollment, hold, etc.) and notes for all communication with prospects and clients into electronic health record within 2 business days.
* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date records for all funder \& grant contracts using required systems.
* Completely and accurately follow client file checklists to ensure files are complete, current, and in compliance with licensing.
* Manage client roster for Enrichment Center and Care Coaching programs. This includes, providing enrollment and disenrollment information in the client health record and submitting accurate attendance reports to billing department.
* Maintain emergency rosters for all enrolled clients with a minimum of monthly updates.
* Collaborate with program liaisons at Veterans Administration, SF Department of Disability and Aging Services, and other grant/funders as needed.
**Transportation**

* Manage relationship and requests with outside transit providers, this includes assisting clients with Paratransit enrollment and coordinating requests for Group Van services, including participation in stakeholder meetings.
* Maintain transportation manifests for multiple providers.
* Document unmet and untimely service in internal logs \& communicate with vendors in real time.
**Supply \& Vendor Management**

* Coordinate meal service with outside vendor to ensure accurate count of meals based on forecasted Enrichment Center attendance.
* Maintain adequate stock of program materials and supply and replenish proactively.
**Other Duties**

* Participate in daily team meetings to inform Enrichment Center staff of the anticipated daily attendance and other details regarding prospects and other visitors.
* Assist Program Director in audit readiness and ongoing monitoring tasks to ensure compliance with state licensing regulations and other service contracts.
* Maintain knowledge of all safety and emergency protocols to effectively direct staff, clients, and visitors.
* Support Enrichment Center programs, including meals and activities, as needed.
* Actively participate in Companioa and IOA meetings.
* Other duties as assigned.
**EDUCATION:**


Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.

**BACKGROUND AND EXPERIENCE:**

* Five years of program or administrative experience
* Interest and ability to support older adults, particularly persons with dementia
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines
* Ability to maintain effective relationships with a wide range of internal and external clients
* Team player
* Excellent written and oral communication skills
* Computer proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook
**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:**

* Ability to lift 35 lbs
* Ability to reach, bend and walk
**COMPENSATION:**

**Range:** $ 34 \- 35\.50/hourly

*This amount is not necessarily reflective of actual compensation that may be earned, nor a promise of any specific pay for any specific employee, which is always dependent on actual experience, education and other factors.*

*This range does not include any additional equity, benefits, or other non\-monetary compensation which may be included.*

***THE CITY*** is focused on enhancing our community members’ quality of life through well\-designed services and a positive workplace culture. San Rafael is the economic and cultural heart of Marin County, and its high quality of life is centered on its commercial districts, engaged neighborhoods, active lifestyle, and natural environment. San Rafael (population 60,000\) is a full\-service city with a city council/city manager form of government with 12 departments, more than 400 employees, and an annual budget in fiscal year 2026\-2027 of $208 million. The City’s vision is to be a vibrant economic and cultural center reflective of its diversity. The City Council is engaged and seeks to strengthen the urban and commercial areas as well as sustain the beautiful natural environment.


San Rafael’s Organizational culture framework is an initiative called **“Together San Rafael.”** City employees are our greatest asset, and we seek talented individuals with diverse backgrounds who are creative, curious, and excited about a challenge. We are a results\-driven team focused on the needs of community members. The **Together San Rafael initiative is focused** on modernizing City services and increasing the engagement of employees. This initiative recognizes the interconnectedness of the customer and employee experience.

The Recreation Division operates with a $4\.93 million budget and 18 FTE. Key facilities include the Albert J. Boro Community Center, Pickleweed Community Park, Terra Linda Pool and Terra Linda Community Center.

--------------------

  

  

  

Docusign brings agreements to life. Over 1\.5 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business\-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using Docusign’s Intelligent Agreement Management platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the \#1 company in e\-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).  

  

**What you'll do**

This role translates strategy into processes, tools, and operating rhythms that enable Customer Success teams to execute consistently, reduce friction, and deliver measurable customer and business outcomes and will focus on our most strategic initiatives.  

  

This position is an individual contributor role reporting to the Senior Director, Customer Success Experience.

* Act as Customer Success Operations lead for Customer Success Experience, owning P0/P1 transformation initiatives and major change programs from design through execution ensuring plans, dependencies, and risks are visible and proactively managed
* Translate Customer Success Experience strategy into clear program charters, roadmaps, success metrics, and operating rhythms across Customer Success, Sales, Services, and cross\-functional partners

* Work with data and analytics partners to define telemetry needs, success metrics, and reporting that help Customer Success leaders run the business (e.g., GRACV/GNACV, adoption, churn, pipeline of IAM opportunities)
* Partner with technology teams and Customer Success Experience Architects to prioritize, scope, and deliver systems enhancements, ensuring requirements are business\-led and well documented
* Build and maintain program governance, including forums, cadences, and artifacts that keep leaders aligned on priorities, trade\-offs, and progress
* Prepare high\-quality executive\-level communications and materials (decks, narratives, decision briefs) that clearly surface issues, options, and recommendations
* Serve as a trusted partner to Customer Success and Go To Market leadership, proactively identifying operational risks, gaps, and opportunities and driving resolution
* Champion Docusign's principles (Customer First, Deliver Results, Say What Matters, Own It, Make It Better, One Team) in how programs are designed, communicated, and executed

  

**Job Designation**
-------------------

  

  

  

**Hybrid:** Employee divides their time between in\-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week; may vary by team but will be weekly in\-office expectation)  

  

  

Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.  

  

**What you bring**

* 8\+ years of experience in Customer Success Operations, Sales Operations, Strategy and Operations, or related roles
* Experience leading complex cross\-functional programs from concept through implementation, with clear business impact
* Experience with Customer Success and Go To Market processes (renewals, forecasting, adoption programs, playbooks, success planning) and how they show up in tools

* Experience with Salesforce and Gainsight (or similar CRM/CS platforms) and how telemetry and data pipelines support CS operations
* Experience building structured plans, managing dependencies, and coordinating across multiple stakeholder groups
* Experience with executive and stakeholder management and relationship\-building skills, with the ability to influence without direct authority

**Preferred**
* Experience in B2B SaaS
* Strong strategic thinking skills, able to connect company and CS strategy to concrete operational plans and system requirements
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a proven ability to create concise, executive\-ready narratives and presentations
* Experience managing global business management systems for Customer Success
* Extensive experience driving annual planning, leading projects from start to finish to deliver large\-scale, complex business and technical initiatives successfully and on time in high\-growth, performance\-focused environments
* Ability to model business processes using various tools and techniques
* Proactive approach to collaboration across multiple functions and geographies to achieve complex objectives
* Demonstrated ability to lead large cross\-functional teams, mentor, coach, and effectively transfer expertise to others

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager, Beneficial Deployments - Life Sciences
jobs.description:
**About Anthropic**
-------------------



Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

**About the role**
------------------



Join Anthropic as a Customer Success Manager supporting our Beneficial Deployments team's initiatives in Life Sciences. As a Customer Success Manager for Life Sciences, you’ll be a strategic partner and trusted advisor to the world's leading organizations working to accelerate scientific discovery. You will help them harness the full potential of Claude's capabilities across the API, Claude for Enterprise, Claude Code, and Claude Science to accelerate their scientific work.



This is a hybrid role that blends deep 1:1 account management with scaled, one\-to\-many programs. You'll own a portfolio of named strategic accounts, such as research institutes, academic medical centers, scientific foundations, and mission\-driven biotech, where you'll build genuine partnerships grounded in a deep understanding of their research mission, scientific objectives, programmatic goals, and technical capacity. You will help these organizations scale their usage effectively drive model and use case optimization, implement change management strategies, and maximize the value of their investment through expanded use cases across their organization. Alongside that portfolio, you'll design and run a handful of one\-to\-many engagement programs, including webinars, hackathons, cohort\-based enablement, and researcher communities, that extend Claude's impact across the broader life sciences ecosystem well beyond any single partner relationship.



The insights you gather from these partnerships will directly inform our research priorities, product development (including how Claude for Life Sciences evolves), and strategies for beneficial AI deployment, making you a key voice in shaping how we build and deliver AI systems that accelerate science for the benefit of society.

-------------------------


* Build trusting, strategic relationships with research leaders, principal investigators, program directors, and IT teams to understand their organizational goals, scientific priorities, and impact objectives, identifying opportunities for optimization and expanded AI deployment in service of their research mission

* Monitor usage patterns and proactively drive adoption across your 1:1 accounts, identifying optimization opportunities and discovering new applications for Claude
* Develop and execute change management strategies appropriate for scientific and academic organizational cultures, driving adoption through Train the Trainer programs, Center of Excellence development, and organizational enablement that respects partner capacity constraints, governance requirements, and decision\-making processes

* 6\+ years of experience in Customer Success, Technical Account Management, or Solutions Engineering
* 3\+ years of experience in life sciences research with ample exposure to the intersection of new technologies as a catalyst for accelerating progress
* Experience working directly with life sciences organizations, such as academic research institutions, nonprofit research institutes, foundations, biotech, or pharma, and familiarity with how scientific research is conducted, funded, and governed.
* Deep understanding of regulations, risk, and compliance needs of the industry

jobs.description:
### **The Role**



As a **Design Program Manager** at Everlaw, you'll establish the operating system for our growing product design team, bringing structure, visibility, and predictability to how we design AI\-powered litigation tools. As our first dedicated Design Program Manager, you'll absorb operational friction and cross\-functional complexity so product designers can focus entirely on craft, quality, and solving complex user workflows.


**This is a full\-time, exempt position based in our Oakland, CA office with a hybrid work schedule: in office M/W/Th with the option to work from home on Tu/Fr.**


#### **What you'll do**


* Own the design operating model for planning and delivery — define how design work is estimated, sequenced, and handed off, and maintain the system that makes dependencies and timeline risk visible before they become escalations.
* Define design readiness criteria and coordinate pre\-launch quality reviews to ensure shipped features meet high standards for craft, responsiveness, accessibility, and edge cases.
* Own the working interfaces between Design, Product Management, Engineering, User Research, and Technical Writing — define how scope is agreed, how dependencies are tracked, and where conflicts get decided, so those questions have a standing answer instead of being renegotiated per project.
* Build and champion lightweight design operations rhythms, frameworks, and templates—such as design briefs and critique structures—to streamline team workflows.
* Manage design resourcing and bandwidth tracking to inform staffing decisions, highlight capacity constraints, and help leadership plan for future team growth.
* Own how design's work is represented to the business — build and maintain the reporting layer (capacity, throughput, readiness) that lets product and executive leadership plan against design, rather than assembling narrative updates each cycle.

#### **About You**


* You have at least 5 years of experience in Design Program Management or Design Operations supporting product design teams in complex, enterprise B2B SaaS or data\-heavy environments.
* You excel at balancing competing priorities across multiple stakeholders, steering teams through ambiguity with structure, clear prioritization, and empathy.
* You've built and scaled lightweight design operations frameworks, delivery plans, and resource tracking processes without stifling creative momentum.
* You bring excellent communication and storytelling skills, with a proven ability to translate design progress and complex trade\-offs into business\-relevant narratives for leadership.
* You bring a strong understanding of user\-centered design methodologies, modern UX workflows, and tools like Figma.
* You have experience working with project tracking tools like Jira or emerging AI tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude Design).
* You operate with a low\-ego, highly collaborative style, finding genuine fulfillment in making design teams visible and successful.
* You are authorized to work in the United States without restrictions. Please note that at this time, Everlaw is not sponsoring F\-1 visas, including OPT, for this role.


Think you're missing some of the skills and are hesitant to apply? We do not believe in the 'perfect' candidate and encourage you to apply if you feel you can bring value to our team. We often revisit candidates who may have applied for a different role if something comes up that's a better fit.


### **The Team — Product**



The Product team shapes products used by everyone from document reviewers and corporate teams to government attorneys and law firm partners, each with distinct needs across a broad and complex domain. The team brings together user insight, market context, business priorities, design, and technical feasibility to decide what Everlaw builds and why. This work turns deeply capable technology into intuitive experiences and helps define the next era of legal work.


### **Total Rewards \& Benefits**



The expected salary range for this role is $140,000 \- $178,000\. Final salary depends on factors including the candidate's experience and skills, and the base pay range is subject to change. This role is also eligible for equity and the benefits below.


#### **Health \& well\-being**


* Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage
* Flexible Spending Accounts for health and dependent care expenses
* Membership to Modern Health to support mental health and wellness
* Paid parental leave
* Company\-sponsored life and disability insurance

#### **Financial rewards**


* Competitive equity grants, so you share in Everlaw's long\-term growth
* 401(k) plan with company matching of up to 4% of eligible annual compensation

#### **Growth \& everyday perks**


* 17 paid vacation days, 11 federal holidays, and paid sick leave
* Four "Everlawlidays" (additional paid company\-wide days off) per year
* Annual allocation for learning \& development and relevant professional membership dues
* Hybrid work with regular work\-from\-home days and flexibility for life's logistics
* Monthly home internet reimbursement, plus a stipend for your desk setup
* Catered lunch each workday, plus snacks and company\-wide events in our offices

### **About Everlaw**



When a lawsuit or investigation happens, teams must comb through vast amounts of electronic evidence — emails, documents, chats, files — to find what matters. That work is not a side task but the case itself, and where most of the time and money in litigation goes. Everlaw is the litigation and investigation management platform changing that, using AI to turn mountains of messy data into the handful of facts that win or lose a case, compressing weeks of work into hours.

jobs.title: Security Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**About Altruist**



Altruist is transforming the multi\-trillion dollar wealth management industry by building an AI platform for wealth professionals. We partner with financial advisors nationwide, empowering them to grow, optimize time and resources, and deliver superior outcomes for their clients.



We're looking for exceptional talent to help us achieve our mission of making financial advice better, more affordable, and accessible to all. If you're passionate about challenging the status quo and want to do the most important work of your life, we'd love to meet you!


**But first, our values**


**Kindness** \- Kindness doesn't *just* equal niceness. We listen to understand. We embrace, and encourage healthy debate and diverse perspectives. We approach conflict openly, honestly, and respectfully.  

  

**Brilliance** \- Humility is the skill we're most proud of and possessing a growth mindset is always top of mind. We take ownership in everything we touch; regularly using our unique superpowers to reach a common goal as a team. We succeed and fail as one.  

  

**Grit** \- When challenges arise, we stay laser focused on achieving our mission and finding a way forward, even when it's hard. We are nimble and maintain a sense of urgency, swiftly adapting to change and overcoming obstacles.

**About the position**



Altruist is in the midst of an exciting phase and we're excited to hire a Security Operations Manager to lead detection, response, and security monitoring for a self\-clearing broker\-dealer. You'll build and lead the team and the 24x7 program that keeps our platform — and our advisors' clients — safe.


***This role follows a hybrid schedule, with three days per week onsite in our San Francisco FiDi or Culver City office.***


**What you'll do**


* Lead, mentor, and grow the security operations / detection \& response team, setting priorities and career paths.
* Own our 24x7 security monitoring strategy across our managed detection \& response provider
* Run the incident response program end to end — from detection through containment, eradication, recovery, and post\-incident review.
* Define and report on SecOps metrics and SLAs (MTTD/MTTR, alert quality, coverage) to security and executive leadership.
* Mature our detection engineering, threat\-intelligence ingestion, and response automation (SOAR) capabilities.
* Drive regular tabletop and purple\-team exercises and partner with Cloud, IT, and Engineering to close gaps surfaced by monitoring.
* Own the day\-to\-day operation and roadmap of the security operations tooling stack.


**What you'll bring**


* **Experience \-** 6\+ years in security operations, including 2\+ years leading or managing a SOC or detection \& response team:
* Hands\-on incident response and investigations in a cloud\-first environment
* Depth with SIEM (Datadog/Splunk), EDR/MDR (CrowdStrike/SentinelOne), and cloud telemetry (AWS)
* Experience managing an MDR/MSSP and/or IR retainer relationship
* Strong ability to lead through influence and operate with urgency
* **Education \-** A B.A. / B.S. degree in relevant fields such as Computer Science or Computer Engineering or Information Security or relevant experience

We're building the future of in\-person connection, from intimate exec offsites to a conference\-level company offsite.


Nowadays is the first AI\-powered platform for planning corporate events. Our software handles everything from venue sourcing to vendor negotiations, making it easier and faster for teams to meet up in real life.


We've planned events across the globe for companies like Google, Airbnb, and Quantstamp, and we're just getting started.


Our mission is simple: make it easier for teams to create meaningful moments together.

We're a sister\-founded team based in San Francisco. We move fast, care deeply, and love bringing people together (whether it's a strategic offsite or a Friendsgiving in our Nowadays home).

jobs.title: Data Center Operations Implementation Manager
jobs.description:
**Role Overview**
=================



We are seeking a Data Center Operations Implementation Manager to own the end\-to\-end Day 0 to Day 2 transition of Nscale's data centres — spanning construction, fit\-out, and live, steady\-state local operations — across an assigned region and set of sites. Rather than owning construction execution itself, you'll be the connective tissue between Construction, Network Engineering, Compute/Infrastructure Deployment, and local Operations teams — driving a structured, well\-documented transition so every site goes live on schedule and ready to support production workloads. This is an individual\-contributor role built on strong stakeholder management, cross\-functional influence, and travel to sites during critical transition windows.


**What You'll Do**
==================


**Day 0 to Day 2 Transition Leadership**


* Own the end\-to\-end Day 0 to Day 2 transition process for each data centre site within your assigned region — spanning construction, fit\-out, and steady\-state operations.
* Define and maintain a standardized transition framework and readiness checklist applied consistently across your assigned sites.
* Track and drive closure of cross\-team action items, dependencies, and blockers standing between construction handover and operational go\-live.
* Identify and escalate risks to go\-live timelines, and drive resolution across the relevant stakeholder groups.


**Stakeholder \& Cross\-Functional Coordination**


* Track progress and status across Construction, Network Engineering, Compute/Infrastructure Deployment, Facility Engineering, SDM, and local site Operations teams throughout the transition window.
* Partner with Construction teams to track handover status, outstanding items, and site readiness milestones.
* Track Network Engineering's buildout, testing, and cutover activities required for a site to go live.
* Track hardware intake, rack\-and\-stack, and deployment scheduling with Compute/Infrastructure Deployment teams to stay aligned with the transition timeline.
* Coordinate with Facility Engineering on site systems and infrastructure readiness ahead of transition.
* Engage with the Service Delivery Management (SDM) team to ensure alignment with customer needs, SLAs, security, and facility performance.
* Take part in regular cross\-functional syncs and stakeholder reviews to stay current on transition status.
* Contribute to a shared sense of ownership and accountability across stakeholder teams, even without formal authority over them.


**Local Day Two Operations Readiness**


* Partner with local Operations leads to confirm staffing, training, tooling, and support processes are in place before a site transitions to Day 2 ownership.
* Create and validate standard operating procedures (SOPs) and operational processes required for local Operations teams to run the site post\-handover.
* Create the operational site tool bill of materials (BOM) required for local Operations teams to maintain the site post\-handover.
* Verify the spare parts bill of materials (BOM) is complete and in place ahead of Day 2 handover.
* Facilitate structured knowledge transfer and handover documentation from Construction, Network, and Compute teams to local Operations teams.
* Confirm monitoring, ticketing, and ITSM processes are validated and operating before a site is handed to local Operations.
* Act as an escalation point for local Operations teams during the early post\-handover period to smooth the transition.


**Reliability, Safety \& Compliance**


* Define and enforce Day 2 readiness criteria that a site must meet before transitioning to local Operations ownership.
* Facilitate root\-cause analysis for transition delays or gaps surfaced during handover, and drive remediation across teams.
* Ensure health, safety, and environmental requirements are validated and documented as part of readiness sign\-off.
* Support certification and audit readiness (ISO 27001, ISO 22237, SOC 2, Cyber Essentials Plus, ISO 22301\) ahead of go\-live.


**Vendor \& Supplier Coordination**


* Coordinate with construction contractors and colocation providers as needed to close out remaining items affecting the transition timeline.
* Track vendor commitments and SLAs relevant to the transition window, and escalate delays that put go\-live at risk.
* Coordinate with the Supply Chain team to align hardware intake and staging with the transition schedule.


**Monitoring, Reporting \& Analytics**


* Track KPIs and KRIs for the Day 0 to Day 2 transition process (time to transition, readiness checklist completion rate, post\-handover incident rate, etc.).
* Build and maintain dashboards that track transition status across your assigned site pipeline for all stakeholder teams.
* Produce regular reports for senior leadership on transition status, risks, and blockers.
* Use data\-driven insights to identify systemic bottlenecks in the Day 0 to Day 2 process and drive continuous improvement.

**About You**
=============


**Experience \& Background**


* 3\-8 years of experience in data centre operations, program/project management, or infrastructure deployment at scale.
* Proven track record coordinating the transition of new sites into live operations across construction, network, compute, and operations functions.

jobs.title: Program Manager, Consumption Products
jobs.description:
**WHAT IS BOX?**



Box (NYSE:BOX) is the leader in Intelligent Content Management. Our platform enables organizations to fuel collaboration, manage the entire content lifecycle, secure critical content, and transform business workflows with enterprise AI. We help companies thrive in the new AI\-first era of business. Founded in 2005, Box simplifies work for leading global organizations, including JLL, Morgan Stanley, and Nationwide. Box is headquartered in Redwood City, CA, with offices across the United States, Europe, and Asia.



By joining Box, you will have the unique opportunity to continue driving our platform forward. Content powers how we work. It's the billions of files and information flowing across teams, departments, and key business processes every single day: contracts, invoices, employee records, financials, product specs, marketing assets, and more. Our mission is to bring intelligence to the world of content management and empower our customers to completely transform workflows across their organizations. With the combination of AI and enterprise content, the opportunity has never been greater to transform how the world works together and at Box you will be on the front lines of this massive shift.


**WHY BOX NEEDS YOU**



Box is expanding into a new era of monetization, one that blends our trusted subscription model with dynamic, consumption\-based pricing for AI\-powered and Platform capabilities. As the Program Manager, Consumption Products, you will own the day\-to\-day operations of this early\-stage but high\-priority business, sitting at the intersection of product, finance, analytics, and our customer\-facing teams. This is a rare opportunity to build something new at scale: you will help define how Box monetizes AI Units today and lay the operational foundation for expanding consumption\-based models across our Platform and beyond.



This role reports to the VP, Renewals and Consumption and carries direct visibility with Box's Chief Operating Officer and other senior leaders. You will work across an exceptionally diverse set of teams \- from Product Management and Data Engineering to Billing, Marketing, and Account Teams serving as the connective tissue that keeps this fast\-moving program running accurately and efficiently.


**WHAT YOU'LL DO**



You will own the customer\-facing consumption program at Box globally. As the owner, you will:


* Monitor daily customer consumption, overage trends, and program activity, identifying accounts that require action and driving unresolved issues to closure.
* Coordinate and execute operational actions including exception handling, managing customer controls, advising on account\-specific treatments, and providing validated data for periodic customer reporting and billing.
* Serve as the first\-line subject matter expert for consumption billing questions from Account Teams and GTM stakeholders, providing timely guidance on program mechanics, alerts, and commercial considerations.
* Work with Business Analytics and Product teams to investigate new usage patterns and new reporting capabilities, translating business requirements into clear, actionable requests for analysts and data specialists.
* Review product updates and policy changes to assess operational impact, and contribute to internal playbooks, FAQs, and customer\-facing guidance.
* Act as the cross\-functional orchestrator across work\-streams converting ambiguous problems into clear decisions, owners, and action plans — while maintaining an integrated view of dependencies across product, billing, analytics, marketing, and customer communications.
* Lead the expansion of consumption billing to new products at Box


**WHO YOU ARE**



You love building from scratch and leaving your mark. You are someone who excitedly brings structure to chaos, with the ability to connect disparate dots and discern signal from noise. You are incredibly detail oriented with a "GSD" mindset, while always keeping the big picture in mind. Where others see problems, you see solutions. You always put the customer in the center of your decision making. If this sounds like you, you also likely have the following experience:


* You have 4\+ years of experience in management consulting, program management, operations, or a cross\-functional business role, ideally within a consulting firm, SaaS or technology company.
* You have a strong understanding of SaaS business models and familiarity with consumption\-based or usage\-based pricing, including AI\-driven products.
* You have clearly demonstrated quantitative analysis experience, comfortably bring able to perform moderate analyses' and interpreting data prepared by others
* You communicate clearly and concisely in both written and verbal form, with the ability to simplify complex policies, workflows, and commercial terms for diverse audiences.
* You have strong attention to detail when handling customer\-specific terms, exceptions, alerts, and operational actions.


Box lives its values, with community and in\-person collaboration being a core part of our culture. Boxers are expected to work from their assigned office a minimum of 3 days per week. Your Recruiter will share more about how we work and company culture during the hiring process.



At Box, we believe unique and diverse experiences benefit our culture, our products, our customers, our company, and our world. We aim to recruit a passionate, high\-performing workforce that reflects the world we live in. If you are head\-over\-heels about this role but unsure if you meet all the requirements, we encourage you to apply!


**EQUAL OPPORTUNITY**



We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability, and any other protected ground of discrimination under applicable human rights legislation. Box strives to

jobs.description:
**About Visions**



Visions Management began in 2007 with the goal to reimagine the experience of move management, space planning and FF\&E services for our clients. To meet this goal, we built a diverse team of experts from varied backgrounds. Visons is a Certified Women Business Enterprise, Small Business, San Francisco Local Business Enterprise and EcoVadis Gold Medalist (Universal Sustainability Award).



We believe company culture is key to the professional and personal growth of our employees. Visions Management is committed to inspiring our people as a family first company offering an environment that promotes continued education, training, coaching, creativity and bringing ideas to life.



We look forward to learning about you!  

  

**About the Team**



Visions’ embedded teams work onsite supporting their client with a variety of services, including move management, event support, space and occupancy planning and more. Team members are uniquely positioned to work within their client’s systems and processes, while delivering the excellent service and results that are emblematic of Visions. The employees who make up the Embedded vertical rise to meet the challenge of representing the excellence of Visions for their client.

 **About the Role**



The Workplace Readiness Project Manager supports the planning, coordination, and execution of workplace projects and transition initiatives, with a focus on People \& Culture (P\&C), Front Office operations, employee experience, and workplace readiness.



This role serves as a key coordination point across project teams, internal stakeholders, vendors, and employees to ensure workplace initiatives are organized, well communicated, and successfully executed. The Workplace Readiness Project Manager will manage project documentation and schedules, coordinate operational readiness and move activities, support employee communications and engagement, and help drive projects from planning through go\-live.

  

The ideal candidate is highly organized, proactive, and collaborative, with excellent written and verbal communication skills, strong attention to detail, and the creativity to develop practical solutions that enhance the workplace and employee experience.

 **Responsibilities –**

 **Project Coordination \& Stakeholder Management**


* Coordinate project plans, schedules, milestones, budgets, risks, decisions, deliverables, and action items across P\&C and Front Office workstreams.
* Coordinate stakeholders and facilitate project meetings, ensuring decisions, responsibilities, and next steps are clearly documented and communicated.
* Gather and synthesize stakeholder feedback, identify gaps or potential issues, and coordinate resolution with project leadership.
* Prepare status reports, readiness updates, executive summaries, and other project communications.
* Maintain accountability across stakeholders and workstreams to support timely completion of project deliverables.
* Manage and coordinate external vendors, including schedules, deliverables, responsibilities, follow\-up, and issue resolution.

  


**Workplace Readiness \& Operations**


* Coordinate workplace readiness activities for Front Office spaces, shared amenities, workplace services, and other employee\-facing operational needs.
* Support the development and implementation of workplace procedures, service standards, operational guidelines, and readiness plans.
* Develop, document, and help establish workplace best practices, processes, and service standards that support efficient and consistent operations.
* Coordinate vendors, responsible owners, testing, walkthroughs, punch\-list items, and operational handoffs leading up to go\-live.
* Support furniture\-related planning and coordination, including understanding furniture layouts, employee needs, installation requirements, and readiness of workspaces and shared areas.
* Help ensure spaces, services, and operational processes are prepared for a successful employee transition.
* Apply creativity and problem\-solving to workplace challenges, identifying solutions that balance functionality, employee experience, operational needs, and project requirements.

  


**Employee Communications \& Engagement**


* Support the development and coordination of employee communications, FAQs, guides, orientation materials, and move\-related resources.
* Draft clear, polished employee communications, workplace processes, procedures, guides, and other written materials for a variety of audiences.
* Coordinate employee orientations, facility tours, go\-live activities, and engagement initiatives.
* Partner with P\&C, Marketing \& Communications, Workplace Strategy, and other stakeholders to create a consistent and positive employee transition experience.
* Help ensure employees have clear and timely information throughout workplace changes and transitions.

  


**Move \& Transition Coordination**


* Coordinate P\&C and Front Office clean\-out, inventory, packing, staging, and move\-readiness activities.
* Track employee, vendor, and workstream responsibilities related to relocation and transition activities.
* Support secure records relocation and other specialized move requirements.
* Coordinate with furniture, moving, facilities, and other workplace vendors to support installation, relocation, and operational readiness.
* Provide hands\-on coordination and onsite support during key move, transition, and go\-live periods.

  


**Research \& Recommendations**


* Conduct targeted research related to transportation, workplace services, employee experience, and other workplace transition needs.
* Evaluate options and develop practical recommendations to support stakeholder decision\-making.
* Identify tools, resources, best practices and process improvements that may enhance project planning, documentation, tracking, communication, and execution.
* Bring a creative and solutions\-oriented approach to evaluating workplace needs and

jobs.title: Technology Services Project Manager
jobs.description:
Join a Team Where Engineering Excellence Drives Opportunity
  
  

At Affiliated Engineers, Inc. (AEI), we bring together expertise and innovation to solve the most complex challenges. Since 1978, we’ve supported mission\-driven organizations in designing systems and environments that advance society and improve lives. Today, with more than 1000 professionals across 23 offices, we help shape the future of healthcare, science and technology, energy, education, and other vital sectors.
  
  

From elevating patient care in Mayo Clinic’s world\-class hospitals to enabling discovery in high\-containment laboratories for U.S. agencies and driving environmental progress with Microsoft’s renowned Thermal Energy Center, our work enriches the human experience, safeguards the environment, and pushes the boundaries of possibility.
  
  

AEI consistently earns national recognition from leading industry publications, including Building Design\+Construction, Engineering News\-Record, and Consulting\-Specifying Engineer, with distinctions such as being named the \#1 Laboratory Engineering Firm in the nation and receiving multiple Best of the Best Project awards, underscoring the lasting legacy of our work.
  
  

At AEI, you’ll join a collaborative community where your expertise fuels innovation, your ideas drive progress, and your work helps shape a brighter future.
  
  

As a Technology Services Project Manager in our San Diego office, you will help us empower our clients to achieve energy\-efficient building solutions, save global environments, and create a better, greener future for all.
  
  

**Here's Why We Need You:**  

In this role, you will lead major projects, develop client relationships, deliver projects according to client needs and budget, lead concept development of building systems, and guide a team of engineers from project conception though occupancy. Within this position, you will also participate in project interviews, providing high\-level client service, establishing long\-term partnerships, keeping abreast of market trends, and ensuring resolution of all technical and service issues.
  
  

**Expertise of our most successful Project Manager:**  

* BS in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering or Architectural Engineering from an ABET accredited program.
* RCDD registration.
* 10\+ years in consulting environment designing building systems or leading design projects across MEP disciplines.
* Successful management of large and complex projects for sophisticated client’s healthcare, laboratory, infrastructure, higher education, industrial, or R\&D facilities.

jobs.description:

------------

  

Company Overview:
Join Allied Universal® Technology Services, a global leader in transforming the security industry. jobs.title: Plumbing Project Manager
jobs.description:
Ayoob \& Peery is a locally owned mechanical contractor based in San Francisco.

Our focus is in wet side mechanical building systems, including general plumbing, steam heating, hydronics, and fire protection. As a design/build firm, we provide solutions for projects of all stages – from early design and development to construction and operations.

We are seeking to fill a **Plumbing Project Manager** position on our project management team in San Francisco.

The Plumbing Project Manager will lead all phases of commercial plumbing construction projects, from pre\-construction and buyout through final closeout. This role directly contributes to project success by owning financial performance, managing schedules, and fostering strong relationships with clients, general contractors, and field teams. Ultimately, the Plumbing Project Manager will ensure complex plumbing systems are delivered safely, on time, and under budget, contributing to the company's overall profitability and reputation for high\-quality installation.

All positions available include competitive pay and benefits package.

Job Responsibilities:

* Lead and manage all aspects of assigned commercial plumbing projects, ensuring they meet financial, quality, and safety goals.
* Develop, track, and manage project budgets, including accurate forecasting, cost\-to\-complete analysis, and monthly WIP (Work in Progress) reporting.
* Negotiate, estimate, and process change orders with clients, general contractors, and subcontractors.
* Collaborate with plumbing superintendents and field foremen to develop, monitor, and update project schedules and manpower loading.
* Lead the project buyout process by negotiating and issuing purchase orders for plumbing fixtures, pipe, valves, fittings, and sub\-tier trades (e.g., insulation, core drilling).
* Oversee and mentor Assistant Project Managers (APMs) and Project Coordinators in the processing of plumbing submittals, fixture cuts, RFIs, and document control.
* Act as the primary point of contact for clients, attending job walks, OAC (Owner\-Architect\-Contractor) meetings, and leading project presentations.
* Identify and mitigate potential project risks, design clashes, and schedule delays before they impact the job.
* Partner with the safety team to ensure strict adherence to all project safety plans, especially regarding trenching, rigging, and job site hazards.
* Oversee the successful turnover and closeout of projects, including punch lists, warranties, and O\&M manuals.

Job Requirements:

* Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Engineering, or equivalent experience (candidates who have transitioned from the trades as a Journeyman/Master Plumber are highly encouraged to apply).
* 5\+ years of proven experience as a Project Manager specifically focused on commercial plumbing construction.
* Strong working knowledge of the California Plumbing Code (CPC) and standard industry practices.
* Strong financial acumen with a track record of successfully managing project P\&L and billing cycles.
* Proficiency in construction management and estimating software (e.g., Procore, Bluebeam, ERP systems).
* Excellent leadership, negotiation, and conflict\-resolution skills.
* Advanced ability to read, interpret, and identify discrepancies in complex plumbing blueprints, isometric drawings, and specifications.
* Familiarity with construction scheduling software (e.g., MS Project, Primavera P6\).
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
* Valid driver's license, with the ability to travel to various job sites throughout the Bay Area.

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: $60\.00 \- $70\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Retirement plan
* Vision insurance

License/Certification:

* Driver's License (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Design Program Manager
jobs.description:
### **The Role**



As a **Design Program Manager** at Everlaw, you'll establish the operating system for our growing product design team, bringing structure, visibility, and predictability to how we design AI\-powered litigation tools. As our first dedicated Design Program Manager, you'll absorb operational friction and cross\-functional complexity so product designers can focus entirely on craft, quality, and solving complex user workflows.


**This is a full\-time, exempt position based in our Oakland, CA office with a hybrid work schedule: in office M/W/Th with the option to work from home on Tu/Fr.**


#### **What you'll do**


* Own the design operating model for planning and delivery — define how design work is estimated, sequenced, and handed off, and maintain the system that makes dependencies and timeline risk visible before they become escalations.
* Define design readiness criteria and coordinate pre\-launch quality reviews to ensure shipped features meet high standards for craft, responsiveness, accessibility, and edge cases.
* Own the working interfaces between Design, Product Management, Engineering, User Research, and Technical Writing — define how scope is agreed, how dependencies are tracked, and where conflicts get decided, so those questions have a standing answer instead of being renegotiated per project.
* Build and champion lightweight design operations rhythms, frameworks, and templates—such as design briefs and critique structures—to streamline team workflows.
* Manage design resourcing and bandwidth tracking to inform staffing decisions, highlight capacity constraints, and help leadership plan for future team growth.
* Own how design's work is represented to the business — build and maintain the reporting layer (capacity, throughput, readiness) that lets product and executive leadership plan against design, rather than assembling narrative updates each cycle.

#### **About You**


* You have at least 5 years of experience in Design Program Management or Design Operations supporting product design teams in complex, enterprise B2B SaaS or data\-heavy environments.
* You excel at balancing competing priorities across multiple stakeholders, steering teams through ambiguity with structure, clear prioritization, and empathy.
* You've built and scaled lightweight design operations frameworks, delivery plans, and resource tracking processes without stifling creative momentum.
* You bring excellent communication and storytelling skills, with a proven ability to translate design progress and complex trade\-offs into business\-relevant narratives for leadership.
* You bring a strong understanding of user\-centered design methodologies, modern UX workflows, and tools like Figma.
* You have experience working with project tracking tools like Jira or emerging AI tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude Design).
* You operate with a low\-ego, highly collaborative style, finding genuine fulfillment in making design teams visible and successful.
* You are authorized to work in the United States without restrictions. Please note that at this time, Everlaw is not sponsoring F\-1 visas, including OPT, for this role.


Think you're missing some of the skills and are hesitant to apply? We do not believe in the 'perfect' candidate and encourage you to apply if you feel you can bring value to our team. We often revisit candidates who may have applied for a different role if something comes up that's a better fit.


### **The Team — Product**



The Product team shapes products used by everyone from document reviewers and corporate teams to government attorneys and law firm partners, each with distinct needs across a broad and complex domain. The team brings together user insight, market context, business priorities, design, and technical feasibility to decide what Everlaw builds and why. This work turns deeply capable technology into intuitive experiences and helps define the next era of legal work.


### **Total Rewards \& Benefits**



The expected salary range for this role is $140,000 \- $178,000\. Final salary depends on factors including the candidate's experience and skills, and the base pay range is subject to change. This role is also eligible for equity and the benefits below.


#### **Health \& well\-being**


* Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage
* Flexible Spending Accounts for health and dependent care expenses
* Membership to Modern Health to support mental health and wellness
* Paid parental leave
* Company\-sponsored life and disability insurance

#### **Financial rewards**


* Competitive equity grants, so you share in Everlaw's long\-term growth
* 401(k) plan with company matching of up to 4% of eligible annual compensation

#### **Growth \& everyday perks**


* 17 paid vacation days, 11 federal holidays, and paid sick leave
* Four "Everlawlidays" (additional paid company\-wide days off) per year
* Annual allocation for learning \& development and relevant professional membership dues
* Hybrid work with regular work\-from\-home days and flexibility for life's logistics
* Monthly home internet reimbursement, plus a stipend for your desk setup
* Catered lunch each workday, plus snacks and company\-wide events in our offices

### **About Everlaw**



When a lawsuit or investigation happens, teams must comb through vast amounts of electronic evidence — emails, documents, chats, files — to find what matters. That work is not a side task but the case itself, and where most of the time and money in litigation goes. Everlaw is the litigation and investigation management platform changing that, using AI to turn mountains of messy data into the handful of facts that win or lose a case, compressing weeks of work into hours.



We're the kind of place that's ranked \#1 on G2 in our category and named a Great Place to Work™ by our own team. So if you want a front row seat to an industry in transformation, career\-defining work you'll be proud to tell people about, and real upsi

### **The Role**



As a **Design Program Manager** at Everlaw, you'll establish the operating system for our growing product design team, bringing structure, visibility, and predictability to how we design AI\-powered litigation tools. As our first dedicated Design Program Manager, you'll absorb operational friction and cross\-functional complexity so product designers can focus entirely on craft, quality, and solving complex user workflows.


**This is a full\-time, exempt position based in our Oakland, CA office with a hybrid work schedule: in office M/W/Th with the option to work from home on Tu/Fr.**


#### **What you'll do**


* Own the design operating model for planning and delivery — define how design work is estimated, sequenced, and handed off, and maintain the system that makes dependencies and timeline risk visible before they become escalations.
* Define design readiness criteria and coordinate pre\-launch quality reviews to ensure shipped features meet high standards for craft, responsiveness, accessibility, and edge cases.
* Own the working interfaces between Design, Product Management, Engineering, User Research, and Technical Writing — define how scope is agreed, how dependencies are tracked, and where conflicts get decided, so those questions have a standing answer instead of being renegotiated per project.
* Build and champion lightweight design operations rhythms, frameworks, and templates—such as design briefs and critique structures—to streamline team workflows.
* Manage design resourcing and bandwidth tracking to inform staffing decisions, highlight capacity constraints, and help leadership plan for future team growth.
* Own how design's work is represented to the business — build and maintain the reporting layer (capacity, throughput, readiness) that lets product and executive leadership plan against design, rather than assembling narrative updates each cycle.

#### **About You**


* You have at least 5 years of experience in Design Program Management or Design Operations supporting product design teams in complex, enterprise B2B SaaS or data\-heavy environments.
* You excel at balancing competing priorities across multiple stakeholders, steering teams through ambiguity with structure, clear prioritization, and empathy.
* You've built and scaled lightweight design operations frameworks, delivery plans, and resource tracking processes without stifling creative momentum.
* You bring excellent communication and storytelling skills, with a proven ability to translate design progress and complex trade\-offs into business\-relevant narratives for leadership.

* You are authorized to work in the United States without restrictions. Please note that at this time, Everlaw is not sponsoring F\-1 visas, including OPT, for this role.

The Product team shapes products used by everyone from document reviewers and corporate teams to government attorneys and law firm partners, each with distinct needs across a broad and complex domain. The team brings together user insight, market context, business priorities, design, and technical feasibility to decide what Everlaw builds and why. This work turns deeply capable technology into intuitive experiences and helps define the next era of legal work.

The expected salary range for this role is $140,000 \- $178,000\. Final salary depends on factors including the candidate's experience and skills, and the base pay range is subject to change. This role is also eligible for equity and the benefits below.

jobs.description:
**Job Description**  

  

The Community Youth Center of San Francisco (CYC) provides the youth of our city a sense of belonging and vital tools and experiences to succeed in life. Our services include academic support and college counseling, job placement and employment training, substance use and violence prevention education, crisis intervention and mediation, leadership development, technology and computer training. Our mission is to encourage a diverse population of high\-need young people to explore their full potential through academic, career, family, and community life.

**Title:****Program Leader**

**Salary:****$23\.50\-$27\.00/Hour**

**Reports to:****Site Coordinator/Beacon Director**

**Status:** **Part****\-Time, Non\-Exempt (school year end: 6/2/2027\)**

**POSITION DESCRIPTION:**


Under the supervision of the Site Coordinator, the Program Leader is responsible for developing, implementing, and overseeing a variety of academic and enrichment activities targeting middle school youth at the CYC Aptos Beacon Center. This includes designing curriculum and activities which incorporate skill building and project based learning that are fun and engaging for youth.


We are looking for multiple staff to teach one or more of the following enrichment activities:

* Arts (i.e. painting, drawing, crafting, etc.)
* Mixed Sports (i.e. soccer, basketball, table tennis, skateboarding, etc.)
* Performing Arts (i.e. drama, voice, dance, etc.)
* Cooking, Gardening, Cultural Arts and Exploration
* Academic Tutoring
* Career \& College Awareness
* STEAM (i.e. coding, 3D printing, game design, robotics, video/music production, etc.)

 **DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Develop, implement, and oversee a variety of skill building and project based learning activities for middle school aged youth.
* Provide academic tutoring and assist students with their daily homework as needed.
* Establish and maintain a positive and safe learning environment for program participants including assisting with classroom and behavior management, resolving and mediating conflicts using restorative practices, handling emergencies and injuries, etc.
* Create marketing strategies and promotional materials to recruit and retain youth in afterschool programs.
* Collaborate with school and Beacon staff to coordinate cultural celebrations and culminating events that builds community and celebrates youth accomplishments.
* Work with school faculty and parents/guardians to maintain a high level of communication and positive relationships/climate between school, beacon and families.
* Assist with data collection and produce programmatic reports as requested.
* Assist with administering and collecting evaluation data as required by funders and for continuous program improvement.
* Participate in regular staff meetings and attend on\-going training opportunities as needed.
* Maintain the cleanliness and organization of all shared program spaces.
* Complete other duties as assigned by the supervisor.

 **QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor's degree preferred or must have completed a minimum of 48 college units or passed an Instructional Aide Exam.
* Knowledge of youth development practices and one or more years of experience planning and facilitating enrichment activities for youth.
* Experience in classroom management, conflict mediation, and restorative practices is a plus.
* Experience working with ethnically diverse youth and families who have experienced poverty, crisis, trauma, and other adverse events is a plus.
* Ability to develop, implement, and organize programs and special events.
* Possess good organizational, communication and teamwork skills.
* Capacity to multitask, work independently, and meet strict programmatic deadlines.
* Good technology skills (familiar with Google docs \& sheets, MS Office, etc.)
* Ability to model to staff and participants: professionalism, personal responsibility, a strong work ethic and positive character.
* Bilingual in Cantonese/Mandarin, Spanish, or Tagalog is preferred.
* Able to lift or move at least 25lbs.

  

CYC is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and will not discriminate against any applicant or employee on the basis of race, age, religion, gender, marital status, national origin, citizenship, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, or any other basis recognized by federal, state, or local law, including on the basis of the intersection of two or more protected characteristics, also known as intersectional discrimination.
