We produce high\-quality French\-inspired desserts and are proud to be a Certified B Corporation, balancing purpose and profit while considering the impact of our decisions on our employees, customers, community, and the environment.

POSITION SUMMARY  
The QA Technician is responsible for ensuring that all production paperwork is completed, collected, organized, reviewed, and filed to the satisfaction of all pertinent regulatory agencies and customers. Ensure the site is always audit\-ready by maintaining GMP, Organic, SQF, and any other certifications. Ensure the quality of all incoming ingredients, batches, and finished products. Perform required quality testing of products and records accurate product specifications in a timely manner. The ideal candidate will have a good understanding of food safety protocols, quality control processes, and regulatory compliance in the food manufacturing industry.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES  
\- Maintain a solid and up\-to\-date understanding of all regulatory issues pertaining to the completion, review, and filing of production paperwork.  
\- Maintain a solid and up\-to\-date understanding of all customer requirements and preferences pertaining to the completion, review, and filing of production paperwork.  
\- Collect all production paperwork, ensuring that any missing paperwork is located.  
\- Provide aggressive reporting and retraining for all incomplete, incorrect, or non\-compliant paperwork.  
\- Organize paperwork per established filing system.  
\- Review paperwork, ensuring that all process CCP’s, quality specifications, and customer requirements have been met. Any product affected by deviations or missing records must be reported to QA Manager and placed on QA hold.  
\- Manage filing systems such that all completed and reviewed records are maintained and accessible for the time required by customers and regulatory agencies.  
\- Release product.  
\- Provide assistance/support as needed with the customer, government, and third\-party audits.  
\- Ensure all products meet the customer and product requirements.  
\- Always keep all work areas and equipment within SQF standards and clean.  
\- Ensure all personal protective equipment is always properly worn.  
\- Ensure all equipment is set up, calibrated, and functioning properly throughout your shift.  
\- Keep all equipment that is used clean, in your area always, and prepared for the next run.  
\- Perform several checks to the batches such as Color, pH \& sensory, vacuum and % solid.  
\- Obtain batch samples by opening kettles, turning off agitators, ladle the samples, place samples in beakers, and take them to QC Bench for testing.  
\- Obtain liquid ingredient samples from bulk containers and perform testing on them.  
\- Recommend adjustments be made to batches by adding or subtracting ingredients.  
\- Monitor the Filler Machine and lines by checking the weights, charts, codes, labeling, pasteurizer temperatures and perform hourly finished product analysis.  
\- Verify codes and charts very closely \- the ink can run dry and codes can be set wrong.  
\- Perform visual checks and record results, weigh product on calibrated scales, obtain and bring the samples to the QC bench for testing, perform tests, and record results.  
\- Place batches of finished products on hold as required.  
\- Copy batch cards as required for kitchen operators.  
\- All other assigned duties required during your work period.

REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE  
\- GED or High School Diploma  
\- Previous QA experience in a food manufacturing environment.  
\- Ability to work with numbers, perform calculations, and possess mechanical abilities.  
\- Ability to identify food safety concerns or risks.  
\- Demonstrated ability to work independently, with limited supervision.  
\- Communication skills: must be able to communicate and work closely with all departments and management levels.  
\- Keep up with a fast\-paced work environment and record data as required in a timely manner.  
\- Extreme attention to detail.  
\- Strong organizational ability.  
\- Good communication skills (both written and verbal).  
\- General computer proficiency (Word, Excel, etc.).  
\- Ability to attend and successfully complete related training programs.  
\- Spanish (Plus, not required)

EQUIPMENT AND TOOLS USED  
\- Use the following equipment: Refractometer, Salt Titrator, Acid Titrator, PH Meter, Color Meter, Moisture Meter, Viscometer, and Consistometer, various gages, torque meters and other equipment as required.  
\- Handcarts and pallet jacks.  
\- Forklift (not all QC Techs.)

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS  
\- SQF Certified (Plus, not required)  
\- PCQI Certified (Plus, not required)  
\- HACCP Certified (Plus, not required)  
\- Experience in the food manufacturing industry required.  
\- Knowledge of food safety regulations, quality standards, and production best practices.  
\- Experience with lean manufacturing, process improvement, or waste reduction is a plus.  
\- Experience in dessert, dairy, pudding, or refrigerated food production is a plus.

WORK ENVIRONMENT/CONDITIONS AND PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS  
\- Varied temperature work areas.  
\- The environment is very wet, slippery, and has continuous forklift traffic.  
\- Handle and work around various moving equipment and chemicals.  
\- Frequent use of hot/cold water to perform checks and clean equipment and area.  
\- Frequent lifting objects \< 30 lbs. and pushing/pulling of objec

jobs.title: TAY Trauma Case Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Description: Transitional Age Youth Case Manager**

**DEPARTMENT:** **Jail Health Services: Behavioral Health and Reentry Programs**

**Core Job Description**

Responsible for providing behavioral health treatment, care management and care coordination services to Transitional Age Youth incarcerated in the San Francisco City and County Jail system. Conducts trauma screenings and needs assessments and works collaboratively with clients to develop comprehensive reentry plans. Adheres to all State, Federal and County documentation standards and HIPAA regulations. Is computer literate and competent in electronic health record documentation. Bachelor Degree is required.

**Summary of Major Job Responsibilities**

Under administrative direction and clinical supervision, provides evidence based treatment with a focus on reentry planning to a caseload of transitional age youth suffering from a history of trauma. As a staff member, the case manager is responsible for the mission of Jail Health Services’ Behavioral Health and Reentry Services programs as outlined in the specific areas of responsibility.

**Specific Areas of Responsibilities**

* Conducts trauma screenings and behavioral health evaluations with individuals incarcerated in the San Francisco City and County Jail who are between the ages of 18 and 25\.
* Collaborates with patients to develop comprehensive reentry plans.
* Provides evidence\-based and trauma informed care to all patients in both individual and group treatment settings.
* Makes referrals to community treatment providers as clinically indicated.
* Works with existing treatment providers, family members and friends to prevent the patient’s disconnection from their natural community supports.
* Acts as a liaison between the patient’s natural community supports and the criminal justice and legal systems.
* Works closely with San Francisco Superior Court’s Collaborative Court programs including Young Adult Court, Drug Court and Behavioral Health Court.
* Collects demographic and treatment outcome data for the incarcerated TAY population.
* Provides follow\-up treatment after community placement, as indicated.
* Provides in custody mental health treatment including, but not limited to, individual, group and milieu therapy.
* Routinely assesses for client safety.
* Charts on patients.
* Develops treatment plans.
* Refers to psychiatrist for medication when indicated.
* Follows all policies and procedures of the program.
* Imparts and maintains ethical standards
* Promotes high quality treatment that is grounded in the principles of wellness and recovery.
* Works with Jail Health Services staff and other treatment providers to ensure integrated care.
* Wears appropriate, professional attire at all times.
* Demonstrates commitment to the continued development of multi\-cultural understanding through trainings, workshops, reading, etc.

**Minimum Qualifications** 

* Experience working with individuals with mental illness, substance use disorders and / or characterological challenges.
* Proficiency in computer usage, including Microsoft Office products (Excel, Outlook and Word).
* Good communication skills.
* Good attention to detail.
* Ability to get to all of San Francisco’s jails and treatment facilities.
* Ability to type.
* Ability to respond quickly and use good judgment in unusual and emergency situations.
* Ability to work with prisoners in a jail environment.
* Ability to obtain and maintain a jail clearance.
* Willingness to accompany clients in the community.
* Sensitivity to and experience working with the ethnically, culturally, socially, and sexually diverse individuals, communities, agencies, and organizations which comprise the constituency of Jail Health Services.
* Ability to work independently within a multidisciplinary team and interact effectively with the medical and criminal justice system as well as community providers in order to facilitate the delivery of comprehensive behavioral health care.
* Bachelor Degree

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Working knowledge of DSM 5 diagnoses.
* Knowledge of evidence\-based practices ie Motivational Interviewing, Cognitive Behavioral Therapy, Trauma Informed Care and Wellness and Recovery principles.
* Experience with crisis intervention, assessment, suicide prevention, and drug and alcohol treatment.
* Experience working with the Transitional Age Youth population.
* Working knowledge of psychiatric medications.

**Essential Job Functions and Physical Demands**

Ability to read and write, and to use a telephone and a computer. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit, talk, hear, stand, and walk. The employee is occasionally required to reach with hands and arms, use hands to finger or handle, and climb. Specific vision abilities required by the job include close vision and ability to adjust focus. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions.

**Work Environment**

Working in a jail frequently exposes the employee to moderate levels of noise, fumes, airborne particles and toxic or caustic chemicals. Employees work with criminal offenders, some of whom may be dangerous.

Schedule : Monday \- Friday (evenings and weekends may be required)

*Community Works is an equal opportunity employer committed to maintaining a culturally diverse work environment that reflects the make\-up of the communities we serve. People with diverse personal experiences are urged to apply, especially people of color, bi\-lingual English\-Spanish speakers, lesbian, gay, bisexual and transgender individuals, women, and those that have been formerly incarcerated or impacted by incarceration.*

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: $28\.75 \- $31\.75 per hour

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Ability to Relocate:

* Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance
* 401(k) with 5% Employer Match
* Free Onsite Parking

  


**Pay:** $70,000\.00 \- $100,000\.00 per year

We prohibit discrimination and harassment based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic under federal, state, or local laws.*

jobs.title: Case Manager II
jobs.description:
**JOB SUMMARY**: The Case Manager II (CM II), a key member of the primary care interdisciplinary team, provides services for patients with complex care needs. This position conducts patient outreach, engagement and psychosocial service assessment, assists in developing a patient\-centered care plan, is the lead implementer of Enhanced Care Management (ECM) and coordinates service referrals and delivery. The Case Manager meets clients in home, clinic, or community as appropriate or required by the specific program/site. The CM II provides services to specific populations that have multiple complex health and social services needs and often provides care outside of a traditional health center setting, such as home visits, hospitals, supportive housing sites, encampments and shelters.


This position is represented by SEIU\-UHW. Salaries and benefits are set by a collective bargaining agreement (CBA), and an employee in this position must remain a member in good standing of SEIU\-UHW, as defined in the CBA.

**Essential Functions**:

* Outreach, via telephone and in person at LifeLong, community and residential sites, to patients who meet case management program eligibility criteria or are prioritized by LifeLong for this service
* Proactively meet and engage with patients to build effective relationships and assess strengths and needs through use of standard intake, screening tools, and health, and social services records review
* Actively involve patients and caregivers, as appropriate, in designing and delivering services, including development of care plans, assuring alignment with patients’ values and expressed goals of care
* Provide and facilitate referrals for internal and external resources, and collaborate with the patient to complete required applications, forms, or releases of information
* Maintain a patient caseload in accordance with LifeLong standards for the specific population served or site requirements
* Utilize data registries and reports to manage caseload, meet program requirements, maintain grant deliverables, and promote high quality care
* Provide health education and training to patients, including but not limited to, harm reduction and disease risk\-mitigation strategies that empower patients to manage their own health and wellness (e.g. overdose prevention, mitigating spread of communicable diseases)
* Assist patients with accessing and retaining public benefits and insurance (e.g. MediCal, SSI/SSDI, CalFresh, General Assistance, etc), and affordable/subsidized housing
* Respectfully and routinely communicate with patients, their care team members, external partners, and identified social supports
* Maintain knowledge of patients’ medical/behavioral health treatment plans and facilitate utilization of services by providing resources such as accompaniment, transportation, in\-home care, reminder calls etc.
* Participate in team meetings to coordinate care, support patient goals, and reduce barriers to accessing services
* Advocate on behalf of patients to get their needs met and/or support patients to learn advocacy strategies for themselves.
* Provide case management services to patients with multiple complex acute or chronic medical or behavioral health conditions (e.g. HIV/AIDS, Hep C, congestive heart failure, severe diabetes, severe hypertension, psychosis, pregnancy, and homelessness)
* Provide general housing case management services that includes document readiness, housing problem solving, and assessments for Coordinated Entry System
* Assist with patient crisis intervention and de\-escalation
* Provide and document billable services to eligible populations that result in revenue generation for LifeLong
* Keep current on community resources and social service supports to effectively serve the target population
* Document patient contacts/services in required data systems (EHR, HMIS etc.) according to LifeLong policy
* Specific activities may vary depending on the requirements of the program and funder.
* Promote diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging in support of patients and staff
* Represent LifeLong positively in the community and advocate on behalf of underserved populations

**Qualifications**

* Commitment to working directly with low\-income persons from diverse backgrounds in a culturally responsive manner
* Commitment to harm reduction, recovery, housing first, age\-friendly and patient centered care
* Strong organizational, administrative and problem\-solving skills, and ability to be flexible and adaptive to change while maintaining a positive attitude
* Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written skills
* Ability to prioritize tasks, work under pressure, and complete assignments in a timely manner
* Ability to seek direction/approval on essential matters, yet work independently, using professional judgment and diplomacy
* Works well in a team\-oriented environment
* Conducts oneself in external settings in a way that reflects positively on your employer
* Ability to be creative, mature, proactive, and committed to continual learning and improvement in professional settings

**Job Requirements**

* High School diploma or GED
* At least two (2\) years of progressively responsible work or volunteer experience in a community\-based health care or social work setting or at least one (1\) year of experience as a Case Manager I or equivalent position
* Proficient skills using Microsoft Office applications like Word, Excel, and Outlook, as well as the ability to work in and/or manage databases
* Access to reliable transportation with current license and insurance

**Job Preferences**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Social Work, or another Health or Human Services field
* Work or lived experience in area(s) relevant to the population to be served: e.g. perinatal, homelessness, recovery, criminal justice, elder care, palliative and end\-of\-life care, or behavioral health

jobs.title: Program Lead, Math
jobs.description:
**About Primer**
================


Primer is a growing network of K–8 schools restoring the timeless foundations of American education. Inspired by the original teaching primers that shaped a nation of readers, thinkers, and builders, our schools begin with what has always worked, and build for what lies ahead. Close\-knit learning environments. Skilled educators. A culture that takes kids seriously as learners and leaders.


Primers shaped the first 200 years of American children. Primer will ready them for the next.

**About the role**
------------------


Primer's 3\-8 math program runs almost entirely through learning software: kids move through core math instruction primarily via math apps, with virtual teachers layered in for the live support, motivation, and problem\-solving those apps can't provide on their own. This role owns that program — choosing and sequencing the right apps, building the instructional model around them, and leading the team of virtual math teachers.


You'll be the in\-house expert on 3\-8 math at Primer: someone who knows the landscape of math apps and adaptive platforms, has real opinions about which ones move kids forward and why, and can turn both into a program that holds up across a network of small campuses. This is a remote, collaborative role on the broader Academic curriculum team, with quarterly travel to campuses to see the program in action. You’ll also play a key role in shaping the long\-term strategy for 3–8 math at Primer, balancing strong execution of today’s program with forward\-thinking about how our math model should evolve.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Own the 3\-8 math academic program
* Make and document curriculum decisions across 3\-8 math, including learning software and all instructional materials that drive the program
* Build and maintain the Primer Math Learning Continuum that ties math apps together into one coherent pathway, partnering with the K\-2 Lead where the two bands meet
* Design and support training for Primer Leaders and virtual math teachers on the program and how to run it well
* Stay current on math apps and adaptive learning tools — new platforms, what the research says, what's actually working elsewhere — so program decisions are well\-informed
* Think proactively about how to maintain program quality and consistency as Primer scales
* Regularly analyze student performance data and program usage data to understand what’s working, identify gaps, and use those insights to drive decisions about the 3\-8 math program
* Manage the virtual math teaching team
* Manage a team of virtual math teachers who provide live instruction and support across campuses
* Set clear expectations for what strong virtual math teaching looks like inside the Primer model, and give direct, useful feedback to improve their instruction
* Collaborate across the curriculum team
* Work closely with other members of the Academic team to ensure coherence and continuity across the K\-8 experience, especially at the K\-2/3\-8 handoff
* Partner with the Director of Campus Teams and Head of Training to understand what's happening on the ground and translate that into program adjustments and improved training
* Report to and operate in close partnership with the Director of Academics
* Shape the 3\-8 math experience in our Primer operating system
* Serve as an active partner to the product team on 3\-8 math features and app integrations — contributing to design discussions, giving feedback, piloting new tools before broader rollout
* Flag issues and gaps in how Primer.com supports the math program and advocate for solutions
* Stay connected to campuses
* Travel quarterly (at minimum) to observe the math program in action
* Build relationships with Primer Leaders and virtual math teachers to understand how the program is landing and where support is needed

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* Bachelor's degree
* At least 5 years of experience teaching or leading math instruction in grades 3\-8
* Experience managing or coaching teachers
* Experience designing, strategically shaping, or improving a math program not just delivering one
* Experience with adaptive or mastery\-based math programs
* Expertise in math instruction and learning software
* Deep knowledge of 3\-8 math: how kids build math understanding across these grades, and what a strong software\-driven model looks like in practice
* Hands\-on familiarity with major math learning apps and adaptive platforms with a clear point of view on which ones work and why
* You genuinely believe well\-designed learning software can drive core math instruction
* 2\+ years of relevant experience in curriculum, instructional design, or a closely related role


Strong people management, collaboration, and communication

* Experience managing a team, with the ability to set clear expectations and give direct, useful feedback
* You work well across a small, distributed team and can manage your own time and priorities without heavy oversight
* You're comfortable giving and receiving direct feedback


Remote work \+ travel

* You do your best work independently and don't need daily in\-person collaboration to stay effective
* You're genuinely interested in seeing your work in action and willing to travel quarterly to campuses to make that happen


Nice to Have

* Experience in a charter, microschool, or non\-traditional school environment
* Experience managing a remote or distributed team of teachers

*Primer is a mission\-first company. We believe our mission is the highest\-leverage way we can create positive change. In service of that, we keep work centered on mission execution and avoid social or political activism at work that’s unrelated to the mission. If that energizes you, we’d love to see you apply.*

Crusoe is on a mission *to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence*. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. We're looking for problem\-solving, opportunity\-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.

Crusoe's **Recruiting and People Operations** teams move fast \- and pre\-employment programs sit at the critical handoff point between an accepted offer and a confirmed start date. As the People Operations Manager, Pre\-Employment Programs, you will own the orchestration of our pre\-employment checks \- including background checks, drug and alcohol tests, immigration checks, etc \- ensuring each candidate moves smoothly and compliantly from offer to Day 1\.


You will manage the vendor relationship with our pre\-employment check vendor and act as the connective tissue between Recruiting and Onboarding Programs, translating today's ad hoc handoffs into a documented, auditable process with clear roles and responsibilities. This role also owns the administration of Crusoe's background screening and drug and alcohol testing programs, including DOT and non\-DOT populations, ensuring programs are compliant, well\-governed, and consistently executed as the company scales. This is a full\-time, onsite position based in San Francisco, CA, for someone who wants to build the operational backbone behind a high\-stakes, high\-visibility process.

* **Drug \& Alcohol Testing Program Administration:** Oversee the administration of our pre\-employment and support the administration of the random, post\-accident, reasonable suspicion, and return\-to\-duty testing programs, including maintaining appropriate testing pools for DOT and non\-DOT populations.
* **Process Design \& Documentation:** Design and document the end\-to\-end pre\-employment process, including a clear RACI that defines roles and responsibilities across Recruiting, People Operations, and Onboarding.
* **Compliance \& Adjudication Partnership:** Partner with Compliance, Legal, and Employee Relations on adjudication decisions, job profile designation (safety\-sensitive, DOT, PHMSA), and FCRA\-compliant recordkeeping.
* **Cross\-Functional Bridge:** Serve as the connective tissue between Recruiting and Onboarding, ensuring handoffs are seamless and no candidate falls through the cracks.
* **Training \& Enablement:** Build training, documentation, and communications for Recruiting, People Operations, Onboarding, and hiring managers on pre\-employment requirements and processes.
* **Continuous Improvement:** Monitor turnaround times, error rates, and candidate experience data; identify opportunities to improve efficiency, compliance, and consistency as volume grows.

* **Vendor Management:** Proven ability to manage external vendor relationships, holding partners accountable to SLAs and resolving service issues.
* **Process Design:** A track record of designing and documenting end\-to\-end processes, including defining roles and responsibilities across cross\-functional teams.
* **Regulatory Fluency:** Working knowledge of FCRA and DOT/PHMSA screening and testing requirements, and how they apply to job profile designation.

jobs.title: NPI Materials Program Manager
jobs.description:
Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) is seeking a Senior New Product Introduction Materials Program Manager to drive materials planning, manufacturing coordination, and supply execution supporting OCI’s global cloud infrastructure and data center deployment operations.


This role is responsible for ensuring material availability, manufacturing readiness, inventory optimization, and operational alignment across contract manufacturers, suppliers, and internal cross\-functional teams. The NPI Materials Program Manager will work closely with Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Manufacturing, Procurement, Engineering, and Data Center Operations to support OCI’s rapidly growing infrastructure footprint.


The ideal candidate brings strong experience in materials management, manufacturing operations, inventory planning, and supplier management within high\-tech hardware, cloud infrastructure, or large\-scale manufacturing environments.


  
**Materials Planning \& Execution**

* Collaborate with Demand Planning and Supply Planning teams to align material availability with short\-term and long\-term forecast requirements.
* Analyze forecast demand, supply risks, and material constraints to support execution and continuity of supply.
* Partner with contract manufacturers to manage material readiness, lead times, and production schedules.
* Ensure timely delivery of rack and infrastructure products to support OCI deployment requirements.
* Validate clean\-to\-build (CTB) assessments to confirm material availability for planned production.
* Identify material shortages and gaps at contract manufacturers and drive escalation and resolution activities.
* Support inventory planning strategies that balance supply continuity, inventory optimization, and operational efficiency.
* Help manage excess and obsolete inventory mitigation activities in partnership with planning and operations teams.
**Contract Manufacturer \& Supplier Management**

* Manage operational relationships with Contract Manufacturers (CMs), ODMs, suppliers, and manufacturing partners.
* Drive supplier and manufacturing commit alignment at weekly, monthly, and quarterly intervals.
* Ensure manufacturing partners have sufficient materials and capacity to support demand plans.
* Monitor inventory control practices and material management processes at contract manufacturer and warehouse locations.
* Work with suppliers and manufacturers on stocking and buffering strategies to improve supply continuity and responsiveness.
* Support KPI reviews and operational performance management with manufacturing partners.
**Manufacturing \& Operational Coordination**

* Partner with Manufacturing and Operations teams to ensure capacity planning supports forecasted demand.
* Support New Product Introduction (NPI) activities to ensure materials are qualified and production\-ready .
* Coordinate across Engineering, Product Operations, Commodity Management, and Deployment teams to support operational readiness.
* Help drive process improvements that improve material flow, execution efficiency, and operational scalability.
**Risk Management \& Process Improvement**

* Identify supply chain risks, material shortages, and operational bottlenecks that may impact production or deployment schedules.
* Support mitigation planning including alternate sourcing, supplier recovery actions, and inventory buffering strategies.
* Track and report key operational metrics related to inventory health, supplier performance, material availability, and manufacturing execution.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on inventory accuracy, planning efficiency, and supply chain execution.
**Leadership \& Collaboration**

* Lead materials program teams and mentor junior supply chain team members in a fast\-paced operational environment.
* Build strong working relationships across Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Engineering, Procurement, and Deployment organizations.
* Communicate operational risks, supply challenges, and mitigation plans to leadership teams.
* Contribute to long\-term supply chain planning and operational scaling initiatives supporting OCI growth.
**Required Qualifications**

**Experience**

* 6\-10 years of experience in materials management, supply chain operations, manufacturing planning, or related functions.
* Experience working with contract manufacturers, suppliers, and global manufacturing operations.
* Strong background in inventory management, production scheduling, materials planning, and supply chain execution.
* Experience supporting hardware manufacturing, cloud infrastructure, networking, server, or high\-tech operations environments preferred.
* Experience supporting New Product Introduction (NPI) or manufacturing ramp activities preferred.
**Technical \& Functional Skills**

* Strong understanding of materials management, manufacturing operations, inventory control, and supply chain planning processes.
* Experience with ERP, MRP, or supply chain management systems.
* Analytical mindset with experience developing and managing operational KPIs and performance metrics.
* Knowledge of manufacturing capacity planning, supplier management, and logistics operations.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment.
**Leadership \& Communication**

**About the role**


Azora is looking for an energetic, highly resourceful person to help keep a fast\-growing company organized and moving.


This is a broad, in\-person role spanning executive support, purchasing, travel, office organization, team logistics, recruiting coordination, and basic people operations. You will become the person the team relies on to solve practical problems quickly, coordinate the details behind important work, and make sure nothing gets lost between people, vendors, systems, and deadlines.


The right person thrives around people and activity. You enjoy tracking down hard\-to\-find equipment, untangling difficult travel schedules, organizing a busy office, helping new employees get started, and handling unexpected problems without waiting for someone to create a process first.


This is not a narrow administrative role or a predictable list of recurring tasks. Azora is growing quickly, and the work will change with it. There is substantial room to take on broader ownership of company operations as the team expands.


**What you’ll do**


* Provide executive and team support, including scheduling, calendar management, domestic and international travel coordination for employees, candidates, and company visitors, and organizing team events, dinners, off\-sites, and meeting logistics
* Keep the office organized, functional, stocked, and ready for employees, customers, and visitors.

### **Required Qualifications**


* Previous experience in company operations, office management, hospitality, recruiting coordination, executive administration, or a similarly demanding role.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Demonstrated ability to manage many changing priorities without losing track of commitments.
* Resourcefulness and comfort completing unfamiliar tasks with limited direction.
* Strong judgment regarding urgency, confidentiality, cost, and when to escalate.
* Comfortable working in person and supporting a team that moves quickly.
* Able to interact naturally and professionally with engineers, candidates, vendors, customers, and external partners.

jobs.title: Account Manager Lead - Corporate
jobs.description:
**About ElevenLabs**
--------------------


ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.


We launched in January 2023 with the first human\-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses \- from fast\-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B \- multiples of 11, always.  

  

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

* ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.
* ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70\+ languages.
* ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.


Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team \- builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex\-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

**How we work**
---------------

* **High\-velocity:** Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.
* **Impact not job titles:** We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.
* **AI first:** We use AI to move faster with higher\-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.
* **Excellence everywhere:** Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.
* **Global team:** We prioritize your talent, not your location.

**What we offer**
-----------------

* **Innovative culture:** You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.
* **Growth paths:** Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact \- beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.
* **Learning \& development**: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.
* **Social travel**: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.
* **Annual company offsite:** Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location \- past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.
* **Co\-working**: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co\-working stipend.

### **About the Role**


As the Corporate Account Manager Lead, you'll lead a team of Account Managers across our highest\-velocity, highest\-volume post\-sales segment. You'll balance people leadership, strategic direction, and hands\-on customer impact \- driving excellence in post\-sales outcomes and ensuring your team consistently delivers measurable value across a large, fast\-moving book of accounts.


This is a revenue\-critical role at an inflection point: ElevenLabs is scaling fast, and Corporate is where that scale shows up first \- more accounts, more velocity, and less room for anything that doesn't repeat well. The decisions you make around segmentation, playbook design, and how AI agents and automation get embedded into everyday AM workflows will define how this motion performs as volume keeps growing. Making ElevenAgents the agent of choice across the Corporate portfolio is a core part of that expansion playbook.

**You will:**

* Lead, coach, and develop a high\-performing Corporate Account Management team, owning team quota performance, retention, expansion, and cross sell goals across a high\-volume book of business.
* Drive revenue outcomes as a core mandate \- building a team culture where expansions and cross\-sells are owned with the same rigor as any quota\-carrying sales function.
* Design and implement repeatable, scalable playbooks for renewals, expansion, and adoption that hold up across hundreds of accounts, not just a handful.
* Embed AI agents and automation into AM workflows by default, so the team can manage growing volume without simply adding headcount.
* Champion AI fluency across the team: set expectations, build capability, and create an environment where every AM is actively experimenting with and adopting AI\-powered approaches to their work.
* Set strategic direction for how the Corporate segment is structured and staffed as the business scales, partnering closely with RevOps, Comp/Finance, and CX leadership.
* Represent the voice of the customer in leadership discussions, influencing roadmap, tooling, and revenue strategy.

### **Requirements**

* 5\+ years of experience in Account Management, Sales, Customer Success, or post\-sales roles within SaaS, ideally with meaningful exposure to high\-volume, transactional or corporate\-segment books of business.
* Proven track record of owning and exceeding revenue targets (renewals, expansion, NRR/GRR, cross sell), with a clear commercial instinct.
* 2\+ years of direct people leadership experience \- managing AMs/CSMs, driving team quota, and developing talent through coaching and enablement. Passion for building a high\-performance, feedback\-driven culture grounded in accountability and customer impact.
* Deep AI fluency: you use AI tools in your own daily workflow, understand what AI agents and automation can do, and are ready to lead a team through a meaningful shift in how work gets designed and executed.
* Strong player\-coach mindset: comfortable managing accounts directly while leading others to excel in their own portfolios.
* Expertise in post\-sales methodologies and best practices (e.g. success planning, adoption frameworks, ROI storytelling) adapted for a high\-volume, scaled motion.

jobs.description:
**About Us:**


At Parafin, we’re on a mission to grow small businesses.  

  

Small businesses are the backbone of our economy, but traditional banks often don’t have their backs. We build tech that makes it simple for small businesses to access the financial tools they need through the platforms they already sell on.
  

  

We partner with companies like DoorDash, Amazon, Worldpay, and Mindbody to offer fast and flexible funding, spend management, and savings tools to their small business users via a simple integration. Parafin takes on all the complexity of capital markets, underwriting, servicing, compliance, and customer service for our partners.  

  

We’re a tight\-knit team of innovators hailing from Stripe, Square, Plaid, Coinbase, Robinhood, CERN, and more — all united by a passion for building tools that help small businesses succeed. Parafin is backed by prominent venture capitalists including GIC, Notable Capital, Redpoint Ventures, Ribbit Capital, and Thrive Capital. Parafin is a Series C company, and we have raised more than $194M in equity and $340M in debt facilities.  

  

Join us in creating a future where every small business has the financial tools they need.

**About the Position**


We are looking for a Servicing Specialist to support our merchants each day. This role will be a critical operator of the company's product suite by providing a positive payment experience for the small businesses we support. You will be responsible for running and building best\-in\-class processes for payments, fraud, and servicing, and work directly with our Servicing Ops Lead to solve problems for hundreds of thousands of merchants. You will always have a seat at the table, given a platform to share your thoughts and suggestions for improvement!


Are you a customer\-obsessed operational problem solver excited to work at a fast\-growing startup to help grow small businesses? If so, come join us!

**What You’ll Be Doing:**

* Investigate and resolve issues in the areas of processing payments, creating alternative payment plans, error handling, and other related tasks to ensure full payment collections.
* Provide quality service to small business owners via email, SMS, and phone, with a focus on debugging and resolving payment issues.
* De\-escalate scenarios and present resolutions for tough\-to\-navigate situations.
* Identify and track payment issues to ensure transparency and decrease missing payments over time.
* Provide necessary documentation, details, and evidence in a timely manner to ensure all payment issues are addressed.
* Review and respond to payment disputes, gathering documentation and evidence to represent Parafin's position with bank and card network partners
* Monitor transaction activity for fraud indicators or anomalous patterns, escalating high\-risk cases per policy in a timely manner
* Work with the Customer Support and Funding teams to build feedback loops and processes in servicing customers.
* Work directly with management and product ops managers for ongoing improvements of the merchant experience, including but not limited to systems, process, and product\-level improvements.
* Work in a startup environment with the goal to strive for improvement with both the quality and method of the interaction with merchants.
* Review current processes and provide feedback on how to improve the function, question the status quo as well as call out inefficiencies to address.
* Support other product functions with your specialties as needed.

**What We’re Searching For:**

* 2\+ years of experience with loan servicing
* Strong understanding of payments, ACH failures, and return codes
* Experience reviewing and resolving payment disputes/chargebacks, including compiling evidence and representing cases to banks or card networks
* Familiarity with transaction monitoring — identifying fraud signals, unusual account activity, or high\-risk patterns and escalating appropriately
* Excellent communication skills
* Thrive in an entrepreneurial environment
* Data\-driven approach to monitoring and optimizing recovery rates
* Desire to have an impact, grow your career, and be a game changer in the space for Parafin

**We Prefer If You Have:**

* Experience working in a fintech startup.
* Experience building a team and processes from the ground up
* Fluency in (or desire to learn) data analysis skills and tools, such as SQL / R / Python

jobs.title: Technical Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**About us**
------------


MintMCP helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. Our product gives those agents governed access to company data and tools. That has to start from trust.

  

Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. MintMCP scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long\-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on.

  

We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how.

  

We are AI\-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them.

  

Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50\+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co\-founded Coursera.

  

**The job**
-----------


You own the customer once the deal is signed, all the way through. On day one that means building the mutual delivery plan with the customer: what success looks like, who does what, and by when. You drive onboarding, get the product live against real use cases, and stay close as usage grows. You are the person the customer trusts to make their rollout work.

  

From there you own the whole arc. You track account health, run the check\-ins and business reviews, catch problems before they become risks, and pull in engineering or the founders when a customer needs more than you can give them alone. You own renewals, and you find and grow expansion, more teams, more agents, more of the company's work running on us. When something is on fire, you are the one who owns getting it resolved.

  

You'll also push in both directions. On the customer side, that means telling them when what they've asked for isn't what they need, and reframing it against what we've seen work elsewhere. Internally, it means advocating for your customers clearly and directly to the founders — while weighing what they want against what the company needs to prioritize. We'd rather you argue with us than quietly agree with a customer.

  

You are our first dedicated post\-sales hire, so you also build the function. You turn what works into a repeatable motion: the delivery plan template, health scoring, the review rhythm, the handoff from sales. As the customer base grows, you help decide who we hire next and grow into leading customer success. The role is in person, with travel to meet customers.

  

**About you**
-------------

* You are exceptional with customers. People trust you quickly, and you keep a rollout on track without being told to. This is the core of the job.
* You have owned customer relationships end to end, in customer success, account management, consulting, or a client\-delivery role.
* You can run a plan and drive it to an outcome across a customer's team, aligning stakeholders, tracking commitments, and keeping momentum.
* You are comfortable in technical conversations without being an engineer. You can hold your own with a technical buyer, explain what the product does and why it matters, and know when to pull in the team for the deep end. You do not write config or debug integrations.
* You have carried retention and expansion, or have the commercial instinct to, and can point to relationships you kept and grew.
* You have built structure where there was none, playbooks, templates, cadences, and you would rather build the motion than inherit one.
* You are calm under pressure and own the outcome when a customer is unhappy.
* You are AI\-native, or will get there fast, and are genuinely curious about AI, agents, and how companies adopt them.
* You move fast without a lot of process, and you want to grow into leading a team.

  

**Bonus**
---------

* AI solutions engineer or forward\-deployed engineer background.
* You've sold to or supported technical and engineering buyers.
* Experience with enterprise rollouts where security review, procurement, and multi\-threading are part of the relationship.
* Comfort representing the company in person: business reviews, dinners, and on\-site meetings with technical and security leaders.

  

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Competitive base, variable, and significant equity.
* Full ownership of your accounts, with room to build the function and grow into leadership.
* Direct access to the CEO, customers, and product decisions.
* Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first.

 *Prefer to have your agent apply? Point it at* *https://www.mintmcp.com/hiring/mcp*

jobs.description:
### **Change the way the world travels**



Join the GetYourGuide journey to connect people with unforgettable travel experiences around the world. Millions look to us for unique activities they can trust, and it's all powered by our commitment to make every single journey extraordinary \- including yours.



Ready to unlock your potential with a community of fellow explorers? Find your next role at our Berlin HQ or one of our local offices around the globe, from New York to Bangkok. Head to getyourguide.careers to take the first step.


### **Team mission**


We're looking for an Account Manager to join our Sales team in San Francisco You'll own a book of business made up of mid\-market supplier partners across the US and Canada, with full accountability for their performance, satisfaction, and commercial growth on our platform.



You'll build trust \& influence with your accounts, act as their strategic partner, and find every opportunity to help them thrive. That means pitching new expansion ideas, solving problems, digging into data, and showing up for your partners in a way that makes GetYourGuide their most valuable business relationship.



This is a role for someone who's commercially sharp, genuinely curious, and excited about being part of a company that's redefining how people explore the world.


**Please note we operate hybrid working:** Monday, Tuesdays and Thursdays in office, and Wednesday and Friday remote days.


### **Your mission**


* Manage and grow a book of business consisting of mid\-market supplier accounts (tours, activities, and experience providers), understand your assigned market(s), and hit your performance targets
* Empower your accounts for success through education, resources, and enablement and become their go\-to partner at GetYourGuide for growth and strategy to drive long\-term retention
* Pitch, cross\-sell, and upsell to win high\-velocity commercial opportunities including new activity listings, increased availability, and commission negotiations
* Partner with internal teams to identify roadblocks, troubleshoot connectivity issues, and escalate tactfully to provide a world\-class supplier experience
* Focus on operational excellence and monitor partner health by solving supplier challenges such as reducing cancellation rates, promoting on\-trip quality, and increasing review scoring to foster a great customer/traveler experience
* Review account performance regularly, share clear insights with management, and proactively flag opportunities for expansion

### **Your toolkit**


* 2 to 3 years of experience in Account Management or Customer Success, ideally in tech or a marketplace environment
* A track record of hitting (and beating) commercial targets
* Strong communication skills and the ability to build trust with partners quickly
* A data\-driven mindset; you're comfortable working with performance metrics and turning numbers into action
* Passion for shaping the future of sales and partner success in the age of AI. You thrive in fast\-paced environments, using available resources to build and scale efficiently
* Great problem\-solving skills and a proactive, ownership\-oriented attitude
* Enthusiasm for travel and genuine enthusiasm for what GetYourGuide stands for

### **How we'll make your career journey extraordinary**

  


* 10 Paid Sick Days Per Year
* 40 Telecomuting Days
* 16 weeks 100% paid parental leave for the birth of your child
* Marriage Leave \- 3 days
* 401k Plan \- a retirement plan (after 6 month employment), GYG offer company contribution match of up to 3\.5%, 100% vested
* Healthcare \- medical, dental and vision options
	+ Medical by Anthem: BlueCross BlueShield with 3 plans\-Platinum PPO, Gold PPO, and Silver PPO \+ HSA.
	+ Option for FSA (Flexible Spending Accounts), HSA (Health Savings Accounts)
	+ Sunlife Dental \& Vision
	+ Others: Basic Life Insurance (no charge), Short Term Disability Insurance (no charge), Voluntary Life Insurance, Voluntary Long Term Disability Insurance, Voluntary Accident Insurance, Voluntary Specified Disease Insurance, TotalPet, InfoArmor
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Family and Friends Discount
* Contribution toward foreign Language classes
* Learning Budget \- 1,000 Euro per year
* Maven Family Planning
* Transportation reimbursement benefi
* Lunch Provided in office twice a week

  



And more…


### **Starting salary**


* $97,000 base ($121,000 OTE)

### **How to apply**



Submit your CV/resume in English using the form below. For tips and insights into our hiring process and culture, check out 'how we hire' and 'life at GetYourGuide'. If you have any further questions, please don't hesitate to get in touch at jobs@getyourguide.com.

**Lao Family Community Development, Inc. (LFCD)** is a community development non\-profit agency established in the City of Richmond in Contra Costa County in 1980\. Today Lao Family has expanded its operations and service footprint to two additional counties, including Alameda and Sacramento. LFCD’s headquarters office is in Oakland, CA. It delivers programs and services from 7 locations in 35 languages. The agency provides both community development real estate facilities and a diverse array of workforce, education, and human services that directly support predominantly low\-income US\-born high\-barrier families and individuals, refugees, immigrants, transitional age youth, seniors, and other special populations such as individuals with disabilities.

**Job Summary:** Under the direction of the program supervisor, this position will serve low\-income Workforce Innovation Opportunity Act (WIOA) participants to gain job placements, as well as manage participants under the California Advancing and Innovating Medical (Cal\-AIM) Initiative, which provides comprehensive care management to address both clinical and non\-clinical needs. This position is responsible for interfacing with local employers and training providers, external organizations, and the internal LFCD department, especially the America’s Job Center of California (AJCC) and Business Centers. This position is required to rotate at Berkeley Adult School and LFCD AJCC locations and reports to the Program Supervisor.

**Roles and Responsibilities:**

* Conduct comprehensive participant assessments to develop individualized care management and employment plans that address physical health, behavioral health, substance use disorders, oral health, social determinants of health, career goals, and employment objectives.
* Perform community outreach and engagement activities, including attending resource fairs, distributing promotional materials, recruiting participants, and coordinating referrals to workforce programs, healthcare providers, and social service agencies.
* Facilitate workshops, program orientations, one\-on\-one and group counseling sessions, and educational activities focused on job readiness, career development, healthy living, self\-sufficiency, and goal achievement.
* Assist participants in developing resumes, cover letters, and Individual Employment Plans (IEPs). Provide labor market information, career counseling, interview preparation, job referrals, job placement assistance, and retention services.
* Provide intensive case management services, including intake, eligibility determination, enrollment, assessment, documentation collection, career planning, referral coordination, and follow\-up services. Support participants throughout their program participation and provide up to 12 months of employment retention services.
* Coordinate with training providers to facilitate enrollment in approved training programs and ensure Individual Training Account (ITA) requests and related documentation are submitted accurately and promptly.
* Maintain accurate participant records, including daily activity logs, case notes, service documentation, assessments, eligibility records, and data entry into CalJOBS, Care Management Systems (CMS), and other required databases.
* Deliver Community Supports services designed to address health\-related social needs and improve participants' overall health, stability, and employment outcomes.
* Schedule and coordinate appointments; provide reminders; arrange transportation; accompany participants to critical medical appointments, community service appointments, and job interviews when appropriate; and assist in resolving barriers to participation.
* Develop and maintain strong partnerships with employers, healthcare providers, community\-based organizations, educational institutions, and workforce development agencies to expand opportunities and resources for participants.
* Identify employment opportunities that offer competitive wages and benefits, conduct employer outreach and orientations, maintain employer relationships, and coordinate On\-the\-Job Training (OJT) opportunities.
* Assist participants in accessing public benefits and supportive services, including Supplemental Security Income (SSI), CalFresh, cash assistance programs, workforce training resources, housing resources, and other community\-based services.
* Provide transitional care coordination and employment retention services through participant follow\-up, employer engagement, job tracking, and ongoing support to promote long\-term employment success.
* Maintain current knowledge of Workforce Innovation and Opportunity Act (WIOA), CalAIM, and related workforce and healthcare initiatives. Utilize community partnerships and available resources to improve participant outcomes.
* Ensure compliance with all applicable federal, state, county, and agency regulations, including participant confidentiality requirements, HIPAA standards, workforce development regulations, and funding source requirements.
* Collaborate with colleges, career centers, training providers, healthcare organizations, and county agencies to facilitate participant enrollment, training approvals, service coordination, and successful outcomes.
* Communicate regularly with county departments, workforce development staff, and community partners to ensure program compliance, timely reporting, eligibility verification, and coordinated service delivery.

* Provide administrative and programmatic support to Directors, Managers, Program Supervisors, and Site Supervisors as needed.
* Perform other duties and special projects as assigned.

jobs.title: Care Manager II
jobs.description:
**Note:If you are a current employee, please apply through the internal career page.**


IOA is on the forefront of revolutionary healthcare models, reshaping the way people can age in place. Our innovative models transform lives, enhance communities, and save healthcare systems millions of dollars. Rather than focusing on archaic outdated design, we strive to consistently question the “status\-quo” and create new and more innovative ways to help aging adults and adults with disabilities maintain their quality of life.


With over 23 programs, we offer multiple ways to aid seniors maintain their health, well\-being, independence and participation in the community, fulfilling our mission.


The Care Manager II (CMII) is responsible for the assessment of clients with multiple medical and psychosocial needs. The CMII also plans for and monitors services and interventions ensuring provision of quality care.
RESPONSIBILITIES:* Conducts comprehensive assessments and on\-going re\-assessments of the client including psychosocial, physical and mental health, environmental and spiritual needs.
* Writes comprehensive assessments. Based on assessment information with the client develops and initiates the Community Living Plan, which is client\-centered, comprehensive and consistent with program guidelines and policies and procedures.
* Conducts home visits, acute hospital \& skilled nursing facility visits, as well as escorts clients to medical and other appointments as clinically indicated.
* Identifies, arranges for, and monitors appropriate community services based on a good knowledge of Medicare, Medi\-Cal, and other entitlement programs.
* Establishes and maintains a care management relationship with clients and their informal support network as appropriate, offering respect, dignity and support. Provides crisis intervention, advocacy, problem solving and therapeutic interventions.
* Meets with clients at least monthly, and more often as clinically indicated. Reviews and modifies their Community Living Plan on an ongoing basis.
* Documents via progress notes all case management activity regarding identified problems within 24\-48 hours, adding any new problems to the Community Living Plan, as needed.
* Maintains required paperwork and follows a clear, concise, and consistent system of charting to allow for continuity of care.
* Ongoing evaluation for client Purchase of Service needs and follow\-up to determine if services have been provided in a timely manner.
* Educates clients and informal support network about resources.
* Establishes and maintains open and effective communication with community providers, including physicians and other health care and social service workers. Provides appropriate information on all significant aspects of individual client care and program operations, while maintaining necessary confidentiality.
* Monitors the quantity and quality of the services provided by other involved providers.
* Working closely with the team, continuously evaluates the clients’ ability to remain safely at home, coordinates placement as appropriate, according to program guidelines.
* In collaboration with the client, caregiver, and involved services, terminates clients when appropriate. Documents the process as required.
* Participates in research studies and data collection, as required.
* Participates in and promotes ongoing efforts towards Continuous Quality Improvement.
* Attends and actively participates in team and program meetings, activities and problem\-solving endeavors; contributes to open lines of communication within the team.
* Utilizes supervision appropriately, maintaining open lines of communication and providing updates on caseload activity.
* Actively incorporates the ethical and legal standards of the National Association of Social Workers into all aspects of interactions with others.
* Understands and applies the regulatory and procedural requirements of the Institute on Aging.
* Attends continuing education classes and/or in\-service training to increase knowledge, skills and attitudes related to case management, gerontology, family and community systems and other areas relevant to the Community Living Fund client population.
* All other reasonably related responsibilities as assigned.

  

EDUCATION:

* M.S.W. (Masters in Social Work) or another appropriate Masters level degree such as an MPH, MFT with additional or specialized work experience such as psychology, counseling, or geriatrics.
* Alternatively, in lieu of a Masters degree, an employee may qualify for a Care Manager II position with a BA or BS in Social Work or another appropriate major and a minimum of two (2\) years of relevant social work experience and the ability to demonstrate autonomous work in conceptualizing and formulating biopsychosocial assessments, identifying care needs and necessary interventions, and then executing effective care interventions.


BACKGROUND AND EXPERIENCE:

* **Russian speaking highly preferred.**
* One year working with disabled adults and/or older adults required.
* Experience with and understanding of the medical and psychosocial problems of functionally impaired adults and older adults.
* Experience working with individuals with mental and/or behavioral health diagnoses and substance abuse disorders highly desired.
* Exceptional communication and presentation skills relating to functionally impaired adults and older adults, their support systems and teams of health professionals.
* Demonstrates case management skills and experience in the community health care delivery system.
* Detail oriented with good problem solving skills and the ability to prioritize multiple tasks.
* Computer literacy required.

jobs.description:
Applicants in San Francisco: Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.  

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **New York, NY, USA; Chicago, IL, USA; Mountain View, CA, USA; San Francisco, CA, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 4 years of experience in product marketing, brand marketing, corporate/internal communications, management consulting, Google Ads sales or sales enablement, or a related field.
* 3 years of project management experience working across cross\-functional teams.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience translating high\-level strategies into polished assets alongside creative partners, video producers, and agencies.
* Experience in, experimenting with and leveraging emerging AI tools to optimize daily workflows or enhance creative output.
* Sharp critical thinking and creative investigative skills to structure and resolve complex operational issues.
* Strong background in Google Ads products, sales tech, or market trends, with an active drive to simplify sellers' day\-to\-day workflows.
* Proven track record as a versatile all\-rounder managing multiple workflows and shifting priorities in changing environments.

**About the job**
-----------------


As a Creative in Marketing, you bring visual, design, written and experiential acumen to Google products and services, presented across all major media, content, channels, and experiences. You have the ability to perform your role in a flexible, ever\-changing environment and must be open to new influences and inspiration. You will work with a deeply cross\-functional team and inspire a team of vendor partners by sharing ideas and developing effective solutions to generate multiple concepts supporting all forms of major media. You will be equally comfortable making; rolling up your sleeves and designing, mocking, writing, or prototyping; showing, not telling. Above all, you will inspire and lead by example by making the most of every opportunity to develop breakthrough creative, consistent with the Google Marketing brand, and be able to take and provide clear direction and creative feedback that pushes work forward.

As a Marketing and Communications Manager on the Google Compute Engine (GCE) Marketing team, you will be an all\-rounder combining structured thinking, compelling storytelling, and rapid execution. You will pivot seamlessly from drafting concise executive updates to creative seller\-facing narratives, high\-level strategy, or asset production (videos, templates). You will translate complex AI and product concepts into clear stories, thriving in ambiguity to address whatever issues come next.


Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

US: $116000 \- $166000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits  

  

Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Craft beautifully written, punchy, and highly polished communications, executive updates, newsletters, and slide copy that make complex Ads products, sales training initiatives, and AI tools instantly understandable.
* Pivot fluidly between high\-level planning, operational execution, and creative copywriting as business priorities shift.
* Synthesize complex leadership discussions and data points into crisp action items, and design polished, narrative\-driven decks for high\-stakes executive discussions.
* Lead collaborative initiatives across global product, sales, and engineering teams, translating complex strategies into seller\-first framing.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Would you like to be part of an ISV sales team focused on transforming education alongside the most prominent ISV companies in the global Education market?  

  

Our EdTech ISV sales team supports the largest and most impactful Education Technology companies in the world as they strive to transform learning experiences and outcomes through application of AI and emerging technologies. We are looking for an Account Manager to work closely with a named set of enterprise EdTech ISV customers to drive growth and innovation with them. You will be responsible for establishing and fostering relationships, while generating and launching new opportunities across multiple accounts. The ideal candidate demonstrates strong bias for action, customer obsession, and a track record of consistently delivering results. This individual should possess both a sales and technical background that enables them to earn trust at the CXO level, various business stakeholders (Product, Finance, etc.), as well as with software developers, engineers, and IT architects. Come join our team and help us transform the way we learn, teach, and develop the next generation of students and professionals.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

Collaborate across all levels of the customer's organization, from C\-suite executives to engineering, product management, and sales. Success in this role requires creative systems thinking and the ability to build relationships throughout the account. You'll execute collaboratively with extended teams to address the full spectrum of ISV customer needs.  

  

As an AWS Account Manager, you'll own the strategic relationship and develop comprehensive strategies for customer adoption and AWS service deployment. Working hand\-in\-hand with AWS resources, including executives, partners, support teams, and solution architects. You will champion customer interests while balancing business objectives. This includes dotted\-line responsibility for driving partnership and technical collaboration across the organization.  

  

* Drive adoption of AWS’ full suite of services into a portfolio of enterprise ISV customers
* Exceed annual revenue and design win targets
* Drive levers for growth of the business: inclusive of Account Plans, GTM programs to drive adoption of our ISV partners’ products, working closely with marketing and the partner teams
* In partnership with Sales Ops, manage all operational aspects of the business; SFDC, etc.
* Develop long\-term strategic relationships with AWS Executives and Partner management teams
* Embrace and drive the Amazon culture; lead through our Leadership Principles

  

About the team  

Diverse Experiences  

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  

  

Why AWS?  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

  

Inclusive Team Culture  

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.  

  

Mentorship \& Career Growth  

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
  

  

Work/Life Balance  

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

* 5\+ years of technology/software sales experience
* Bachelor's degree, or experience in a relevant field
* Experience leveraging AI tools in a field sales role

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience with direct field experience selling software or cloud solutions

* Experience working in the Education market
