jobs.title: Sr. Learning Experience Lead, Onboarding & Enablement
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.

  

Replit is building a modern, AI\-native learning function, and we're looking for a Sr. Learning Experience Lead to own it. You'll own our learning platform and the onboarding and enablement experiences that run on it: designing them, delivering them, turning them into durable on\-demand learning, and proving they work. This is a builder\-leader role. You'll design learning, facilitate it live, build it into the platform, and measure its impact, and you'll do much of that hands\-on, in the tools, the way a modern builder works.

  

You'll start close to home and grow the mandate. Your initial focus is owning the onboarding experience for our Support organization, taking it end\-to\-end and turning it into a real, tracked, repeatable system. Over time, you'll elevate onboarding and enablement beyond Support to the broader company, partnering with our People team, with the learning platform as the vehicle.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Own the learning platform. As its DRI, you own the roadmap, the learning journeys, and the instructional design behind them. You make the calls and own the outcomes.
* Support onboarding, end\-to\-end. Facilitation, the live\-to\-on\-demand pipeline, and the role\-based journeys that get new team members confident and productive fast.
* Create content and learning plans. Prescriptive learning paths and the content that fills them.
* Own measurement criteria and data\-driven results: The layer that proves onboarding and enablement change behavior and speed ramp, not just completion rates, with the tracking and feedback loops that keep it healthy over time. As the mandate grows.
* Grow the platform and the learning function as adoption expands, raising the bar for how people learn at Replit.

  

**Required Skills \& Experience**
---------------------------------

* Deep L\&D / learning\-experience expertise. You've designed and run learning programs, not just authored content, and owned outcomes whose impact was visible across an org.
* A builder. You turn ideas into working things with modern tools (you've built learning apps, LMS experiences, or similar yourself) and you'd rather ship and iterate than wait for a perfect spec.
* A track record of leading multi\-person, cross\-functional efforts. You've stood up onboarding, cohort programs, or learning paths from scratch. You think about end\-to\-end experiences and create learning journeys that people actually use and love.
* Facilitation chops. You can run the room live and convert what happens there into durable, on\-demand content.
* A measurement instinct. Pre/post, behavior change, co\-designing metrics with the leaders and ICs who live with them; a healthy skepticism of vanity surveys.
* Someone who quickly masters new domains and is comfortable with ambiguity on a small, fast, generative team where everyone builds.

  

**Bonus Qualifications**
------------------------

* Hands\-on with AI\-native build tools (Replit) or modern no\-/low\-code app builders.
* Micro\-learning and cohort\-based program design; an experiment\-and\-report\-back philosophy.
* Experience extending learning experiences across an org.
* Coaching or manager\-development background.

*This is a full\-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The role has an in\-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.*

**Full\-Time Employee Benefits Include:**


Competitive Salary \& Equity


401(k) Program with a 4% match (*US Only*)


Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance


Short Term and Long Term Disability


Paid Parental, Medical, Caregiver Leave


Flexible Time Off (FTO) \+ Holidays


Commuter Benefits (*In\-Office \& US Only*)


Monthly Wellness Stipend


Autonomous Work Environment


In Office Set\-Up Reimbursement (*In\-Office Only*)


Quarterly Team Gatherings


In Office Amenities (*In\-Office Only*)

**Want to learn more about what we are up to?**

* Self\-driving Company
* Replit Agent at Scale
* AI Adoption
* Build Open\-Source Apps

 **Interviewing \+ Culture at Replit**

* Operating Principles
* Reasons not to work at Replit

jobs.title: Senior Market Manager
jobs.description:
Expedia Group brands power global travel for everyone, everywhere. We design cutting\-edge tech to make travel smoother and more memorable, and we create groundbreaking solutions for our partners. Our diverse, vibrant, and welcoming community is essential in driving our success.


**Why Join Us?**

To shape the future of travel, people must come first. Guided by our Values and Leadership Agreements, we foster an open culture where everyone belongs, differences are celebrated and know that when one of us wins, we all win.


We provide a full benefits package, including exciting travel perks, generous time\-off, parental leave, a flexible work model (with some pretty cool offices), and career development resources, all to fuel our employees' passion for travel and ensure a rewarding career journey. We’re building a more open world. Join us.


**Senior Market Manager**

**Introduction to the Team**

Expedia Group B2B connects partners across the travel industry to our leading technology, supply, and services \- helping them deliver seamless travel experiences to their partners.


From airlines and hotels to financial institutions and other travel platforms, we power smarter, faster, and more impactful travel solutions through the most connected marketplace in the world.


**Make an Impact**

As a Senior Market Manager, you will manage and develop a segment of the portfolio to deepen partner relationships and grow accounts through strategic planning. You will act as a trusted advisor, take ownership of partner challenges, and coordinate internal and external solutions that deliver strong business outcomes. You may also lead negotiations for smaller accounts and share best practices across teams and regions.


**In this role, you will:**

* Establish and foster trusted relationships with key decision\-makers and influencers across partner accounts.
* Develop and manage dynamic local, regional, or chain\-level account plans based on partner needs, industry trends, account value, and likelihood of success.
* Identify opportunities to strengthen and grow accounts, including cross\-selling relevant products, services, and solutions.
* Lead partner discussions, progress reviews, fact\-finding meetings, and feedback sessions to understand needs and demonstrate the value of Expedia Group’s offerings.
* Apply knowledge of the partner’s business, industry, market dynamics, competitors, financial drivers, and operational complexity to anticipate needs and influence decisions.
* Identify business issues and potential solutions, assess costs, benefits, risks, and financial implications, and build a clear rationale for recommended action.
* Explain standard contracts and terms, partner with legal resources on appropriate terms for simple contracts, and seek senior support when negotiating complex or short\-term agreements.
* Replace simple or short\-term contracts with complex, multi\-year agreements where appropriate for the account or region.
* Travel to connect with partners face to face in assigned market (Bay Area)
* Align products, technology, and offerings to partner and market needs while maintaining a thorough working knowledge of Expedia Group’s portfolio and competitors’ strengths and weaknesses.
* Build productive relationships across the team, department, organization, and broader industry to support portfolio and organizational priorities.
* Represent Expedia Group at relevant industry events, support market or territory planning, and build the company’s profile in the assigned market where needed.
* Provide ongoing input to senior management on scalable solutions that improve process efficiency and partner outcomes.
**Experience and Qualifications**

* You have 5\+ years of relevant experience with a bachelor’s degree, or 3\+ years of relevant experience with a master’s degree.
* You have a bachelor’s or master’s degree, or equivalent related professional experience.
* You are proficient in English and, where applicable, the local language of the assigned market or markets.
* You are an impactful communicator who can present compelling rationales, influence stakeholders, handle objections, and move negotiations toward favorable outcomes.
* You apply effective sales techniques, including portfolio management, cross\-selling, account planning, and strategic relationship development.
* You have experience negotiating with director\- and C\-suite\-level stakeholders and managing operational complexity.
* You understand how to consider issues from another party’s perspective, identify common ground, and evaluate the costs and benefits of possible solutions .
* You understand the financial impact of decisions and how your role contributes to positive outcomes.
* You can build working knowledge of partner industries, market trends, economic challenges, competitive landscapes, products, technologies, and services.
The total cash range (inclusive of base salary and variable incentive target) for this position in San Francisco is $147,500\.00 to $206,500\.00\. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $236,000\.00, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role. Incentive plan performance above target will also earn more than the incentive target compensation amount.\&\#xa;  

  

Starting pay for this role will vary based on multiple factors, including location, available budget, and an individual’s knowledge, skills, and experience. Pay ranges may be modified in the future.

jobs.title: Operations Supervisor (Transportation) South San Francisco CA
jobs.description:
Hallcon is a transportation and related infrastructure services company that serves clients such as technology companies, manufacturers, railroads, universities, corporate business parks, hospitals, airports, public transportation networks and more.
  
  

Hallcon provides essential services spanning multi\-modal operations, integrated command centers, electric vehicle (EV) infrastructure, technology integration, analytics, business intelligence, fleet management, specialty cleaning, and overall rider experience performance. We are inviting the right leader to join our team and help us drive rapid growth.
  
  

The Role
  
The Supervisor supports daily transportation operations by serving as a central point of communication between customers, drivers, maintenance, and management. This role involves monitoring events, logging and filtering information for reporting, tracking ridership data, and handling various administrative tasks. The Supervisor ensures that all activities are documented accurately, communicated clearly, and handled promptly.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
* Coordinate daily operations by working with Operations Managers and drivers, ensuring professional communication across all levels.
* Manage yard logistics, including assigning parking stalls and electric bus chargers, and working with the maintenance team to schedule bus repairs and preventative maintenance.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for drivers reporting events, incidents, or emergencies, responding quickly and appropriately with sound judgment.
* Document and manage all incidents and customer complaints per client standards, escalating complex issues as necessary.
* Prepare and distribute time\-sensitive client reports, filtering daily events into concise, actionable information.
* Perform essential administrative duties, including manual data entry, record keeping, and tracking daily ridership data.
* Utilize Excel and Outlook for all operational reporting, scheduling, and correspondence needs.
* Ensure safety and compliance by performing field inspections (bus and driver), auditing driver vehicle inspection reports, and driver daily run reports.
* Key responsibilities are subject to change based on evolving business needs.
* Serve as back up driver in the event business and staffing needs require a backup driver.
* Knowledgeable of DOT regulations.


Qualifications, Experience and Education
  
* Possession of Commercial Driver License (CDL) B with Airbrake and Passenger Endorsement
* Must have a minimum of 1 year of commercial driving experience
* Must have and maintain a current DOT Medical Certificate
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Quick decision\-making ability under pressure.
* Basic proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Outlook.
* Experience in an office or operations setting preferred.
* Ability to multitask and manage time effectively in a fast\-paced environment.
* Prior experience in transportation, dispatch, or a similar administrative role is an asset.


We offer competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, exceptional growth potential and stability, all within a professional, yet casual work environment.
  
  

Hallcon is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applications from all qualified individuals. All qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.
  
  

Hallcon is an equal opportunity at will employer and does not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of age, race, religion, color, disability, sex, sexual orientation or national origin.

The Public Health Institute (PHI) is an independent, nonprofit organization dedicated to promoting health, well\-being, and quality of life for people throughout California, across the nation and around the world. As one of the largest and most comprehensive public health organizations in the nation, we are at the forefront of research and innovations to improve the efficacy of public health statewide, nationally, and internationally.



PHI was distinguished as one of the top 50 “Best Non\-Profit Organizations to Work For” by the Non\-Profit Times in a national search.

  


##### **POSITION SUMMARY**



The Public Health Institute (PHI) serves as the National Program Office (NPO) for the Pediatric Environmental Health Specialty Units (PEHSU), funded through the CDC. PHI, as the national program office, facilitates and amplifies the capacity of the PEHSU network to prevent/mitigate hazardous environmental exposures during fetal, childhood, and adolescent development, and the preconception period.

jobs.description:
The Strategic Account Manager is responsible for nurturing and expanding relationships with key enterprise clients. This role focuses on driving long\-term value through strategic planning, cross\-functional collaboration, and proactive account management. The ideal candidate is a trusted advisor who understands client business goals and aligns internal resources to deliver impactful solutions. This role is highly cross\-functional in nature and does not have direct reports.

* Serve as the primary point of contact for strategic accounts.

* Ability to balance customer needs with platform scalability.
* Self\-starter capable of building structure where it does not yet exist.

jobs.description:

Our “People first” approach means we also highly value our employees, who work relentlessly to help execute our mission. Taiho’s success is founded on ensuring we always act with accountability, collaboration, and trust. By following these guiding principles, we earn and maintain the confidence of patients, the global healthcare community, collaborators and partners, and each other. Together, we are working on cutting\-edge science and growing our portfolio and pipeline across a range of tumor types to address the ongoing and evolving needs of patients. Advanced technology, a world\-class clinical development organization, and state\-of\-the\-art facilities: these and other resources empower us to innovate and touch the lives of more and more patients. It’s our work, our passion, and our legacy. We invite you to join us.
  
Field

Responsible for the on\-label promotion and sales of existing oncology products within the Taiho Oncology portfolio.

The OAM will disseminate product, disease state, and fact statements about other products, across multiple therapeutic areas, while partnering with the commercial business on various cross\-functional initiatives, driving on\-label product adoption and appropriate use. The OAM will drive sales through their face\-to\-face interactions and implementation of innovative tools and analytical processes, while working closely with regional peers, and internal/external matrix teams.

* Provides a high level of product expertise and customer service to all accounts.
* Calls on customers (academic \& community setting) in a specific geography, provides on\-label technical and administrative \- information on company’s products.

* Builds relationships with physicians, nurses, pharmacy, office staff and key thought leaders in assigned territory.

* Demonstrates effective account management skills and selling competencies.
* Accountable for driving on\-label product demand to ensure HCPs identify the right patient at the right time.
* Successfully completes all training classes and product certifications.
* Attends and or displays, at all relevant medical congresses and meetings as needed.
* Can develop and execute strategies to reach difficult to access HCP's and accounts in a compliant manner.
* Can effectively deliver on label product messages for several products in person and virtually.
* Demonstrates ability to manage a large geographic territory with overnight travel and occasional weekends.
* Results oriented approach to time and territory management.
* Refers requests for off\-label information to the Medical Information Request process.


**Education/Certification Requirements:**  

* BA/BS degree required.


**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:**  

* Minimum 3 to 4 years in pharmaceutical/ healthcare sales.
* Hospital sales experience is a plus.
* Minimum of 2 years of oncology experience.
* Possesses and maintains a valid driver’s license.
* Documented sales success of meeting and achieving sales goals.
* A self\-motivating, can\-do attitude.
* Demonstrated flexibility and willingness to be coached and developed.
* Demonstrated ability to effectively collaborate with internal colleagues.

jobs.description:
**Who We Are:**  

At Velocity Vehicle Group (VVG), we represent a premium commercial brand in medium to heavy truck dealerships. We provide full\-service experience, from exceptional sales teams to highly skilled technicians and readily available parts. Our mission is to be the ultimate one\-stop shop for truckers, owner operators, fleets, and companies. Combined with our Leasing and Rental business and financial services division, VVG stands as the premier truck dealership.
  
  

**What's in it for You:**  

Velocity Vehicle Group is a dynamic and rapidly expanding organization, and we're on the lookout for individuals who relish daily challenges and are passionate about delivering top\-notch customer service, both within the company and to our valued clients. When you join VVG, you'll experience an extraordinary work environment, complete with competitive compensation and a comprehensive benefits package, including 401K with matching, as well as Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage. Become a part of our team and immerse yourself in a company that fosters a Great Place to Work™ culture!
  
  

**What You’ll Do:**  

The Operations Specialist partners with operations management to drive operational success. A Parts Operation Specialist plays a pivotal role in managing and optimizing the flow of parts within an organization. This professional is responsible for overseeing the entire lifecycle of parts, from procurement to distribution, ensuring efficiency and accuracy at every stage. Their duties involve maintaining inventory levels, tracking shipments, and coordinating with suppliers to guarantee timely delivery of required components. The Parts Operation Specialist collaborates closely with various department levels, such as procurement, logistics, and maintenance, to streamline processes and minimize downtime. Additionally, they may utilize inventory management systems to track stock levels, analyze trends, and make informed decisions to enhance overall operational effectiveness. In essence, a Parts Operation Specialist is a key player in ensuring that the right parts are available at the right time, contributing significantly to the smooth functioning of the organization's processes.

* Supports a culture of Safety through reporting, training support and maintaining records
* Ensures vendors are paid timely and accurately utilizing Docuphase
* Monitor and review accounting schedules to provide training and quality assurance within Parts accounting processes
* Reconciles payments daily for Parts Department
* Provides reporting and metrics to Parts Management supporting strategic goals
* Process and support Parts Staff payroll
* Develop process and policies to continuously improve the Parts Department operations
* Willing and able to contribute to strategic projects within the Parts Department


**Required Skills and Qualifications:**  

* Experience as a billing Clerk or similar role is a plus
* Point of sales systems experience preferred
* Basic Accounting knowledge preferred
* Proficient in remote working tools (Zoom, file sharing, etc)
* Well\-developed organizational skills
* Inventory control experience a plus
* Coaching and/or mentoring skills
* Great time\-management skills
* Experience supporting/leading projects and working with lean methodologies
* Heavy\-Duty truck experience preferred
* Ability to travel as needed for the business


**Physical Requirements:**  

* Able to take and pass background check and drug screening.


**Compensation:**  

* $20\-$25/hr. based on skills and experience

* Fantastic Culture
* 401k \+ match
* Health, Dental \& Vision Insurance \+ HSA \& FSA
* Employer paid Life Insurance

* Sick Leave
* Company perks such as employee discounts, company events and training programs

jobs.title: Telephonic Case Manager
jobs.description:
Company Overview:

At Enlyte, we combine innovative technology, clinical expertise, and human compassion to help people recover after workplace injuries or auto accidents. We support their journey back to health and wellness through our industry\-leading solutions and services. Whether you're supporting a Fortune 500 client or a local business, developing cutting\-edge technology, or providing clinical services you'll work alongside dedicated professionals who share your commitment to excellence and make a meaningful impact. Join us in fueling our mission to protect dreams and restore lives, while building your career in an environment that values collaboration, innovation, and personal growth. **Be part of a team that makes a real difference.**
Job Description:
**This is a full\-time, flexible work from home position and** **can be located anywhere in the U.S.** **RN Compact license and CA RN license required****English/Spanish bilingual is a plus****URAC\-recognized certification in case management (CCM, CDMS, CRC, CRRN or COHN, COHN\-S, RN\-BC, ACM, CMAC, CMC) preferred.** **Perks:** Full and comprehensive benefits program, 24 days of paid vacation/holidays in your first year plus sick days, home office equipment including laptop and desktop monitor, Employee Assistance and Referral Program, and hands\-on workers’ compensation case management training.  

Join our compassionate team and help make a positive difference in an injured person’s life. As a Telephonic Case Manager, you will work closely with treating physicians/providers, employers, customers, legal representatives, and the injured/disabled person to create and implement a treatment plan that returns the injured/disabled person back to work appropriately, ensure appropriate and cost\-effective healthcare services, achievement of maximum medical recovery and return to an optimal level of work and functioning. In this role, you will:* Demonstrate knowledge, skills, and competency in the application of case management standards of practice.
* Use advanced knowledge of types of injury, medications, comorbidities, treatment options, treatment alternatives, and knowledge of job duties to advise on a treatment plan.
* Interview disabled persons to assess overall recovery, including whether injuries or conditions are occupational or non\-occupational.
* Collaborate with treating physicians/providers and utilize available resources to help create and implement treatment plans tailored to an individual patient.
* Work with employers and physicians to modify job duties where practical to facilitate early return to work.
* Evaluate and modify case goals based on injured/disabled person’s improvement and treatment effectiveness.
* Independently manage workload, including prioritizing cases and deciding how best to manage cases effectively.
* Complete other duties, such as prepare status updates for submittal to customers, assist in training/orientation of new staff as requested, and other duties as assigned.


Qualifications:
* **Education:** Associates Degree or Bachelor’s Degree in Nursing or related field.
* **Experience:** 2\+ years clinical practice preferred. Workers’ compensation\-related experience preferred.
* **Skills:** Ability to advocate recommendations effectively with physicians/providers, employers, and customers. Ability to work independently. Knowledge of basic computer skills including Excel, Word, and Outlook Email. Proficient grammar, sentence structure, and written communication skills.
* **Certifications, Licenses, Registrations:**
	+ Active Registered Nurse (RN) license required. Must be in good standing.
	+ URAC\-recognized certification in case management (CCM, CDMS, CRC, CRRN or COHN, COHN\-S, RN\-BC, ACM, CMAC, CMC).
* **Internet:** Must have reliable internet.

Benefits:

We’re committed to supporting your ultimate well\-being through our total compensation package offerings that support your health, wealth and self. These offerings include Medical, Dental, Vision, Health Savings Accounts / Flexible Spending Accounts, Life and AD\&D Insurance, 401(k), Tuition Reimbursement, and an array of resources that encourage a lifetime of healthier living. Benefits eligibility may differ depending on full\-time or part\-time status. Compensation depends on the applicable US geographic market. The expected base pay for this position ranges from $74,000 \- $86,000 annually, and will be based on a number of additional factors including skills, experience, and education.  

*The Company is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, status as a protected veteran, among other things, or status as a qualified individual with disability.*

jobs.title: Client Implementation Manager - Operations & Systems
jobs.description:
**The Role**

Are you the person who quietly fixes everything?

The plan is unclear, so you clarify it. The process is broken, so you rebuild it. Other people talk about what should happen; you make sure it actually happens.

But your current role may still have you updating project statuses, sitting in meetings, chasing approvals, and watching good recommendations die in a slide deck.

At PestLaunch, your job is to turn strategy into working systems that produce measurable results for real businesses.

We help pest control company owners grow profitably, strengthen their operations, and build companies that no longer depend on them for every decision. We identify the highest\-priority constraint in the business and prescribe a focused implementation “Play.” You take that approved direction and drive it from idea to verified completion.

That could mean building an office accountability system, launching a customer reactivation campaign, implementing a sales process, creating operational scorecards, organizing a CRM workflow, or turning an inconsistent process into something the client’s team can follow every day.

The strategy sets the destination. You build the road and make sure the client reaches it.

This is not a traditional project\-management role. You will not simply coordinate meetings, update timelines, or pass work between departments. You will plan the implementation, build much of the work yourself, coordinate specialized support when needed, QA every detail, launch the system, and verify that it is being used successfully.

You’ll work closely with the founder and have significant visibility into our clients, systems, and company. The opportunity is substantial: build an exceptional implementation function, improve the way every client result is delivered, and increase the number of businesses PestLaunch can transform.

Responsibilities

* **Own client implementations:** Turn each approved Play into a complete implementation plan with clear deliverables, milestones, owners, dependencies, deadlines, and proof of completion.
* **Build the work:** Create and customize SOPs, scripts, trackers, dashboards, workflows, templates, automations, and other implementation assets.
* **Drive execution:** Keep every active Play moving, resolve dependencies, follow up early, and escalate risks before deadlines slip.
* **Protect the scope:** Execute the approved outcome without allowing unrelated ideas or opportunities to derail the current Play.
* **QA everything:** Verify client information, systems, numbers, links, workflows, formatting, and cross\-references before anything is delivered.
* **Launch and verify:** Ensure the finished system is handed off correctly, adopted by the client’s team, and working as intended.
* **Maintain visibility:** Keep accurate statuses, next actions, owners, deadlines, and progress updates across all active work.
* **Improve the machine:** Turn what works into better Plays, templates, SOPs, checklists, and automations so every implementation becomes faster and stronger.

Requirements

* At least 4 years of experience in implementation, operations, project delivery, consulting, agency operations, or a similar role.
* A track record of personally building systems—not merely recommending or coordinating them.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication. You can turn complexity into a concise plan and explain it without reading from a document.
* Strong operational judgment. You distinguish confirmed facts from assumptions, identify missing information, and ask clear questions early.
* High attention to detail and a strong instinct for quality.
* Comfortable owning multiple implementations without losing deadlines, next actions, or client commitments.
* Highly capable with Google Workspace and modern project\-management systems. Experience with CRMs, dashboards, automations, AI tools, or QuickBooks is valuable.
* Self\-directed and resourceful. You can move forward without step\-by\-step instructions while knowing when a decision requires clarification.
* Comfortable working directly with a fast\-moving founder, receiving candid feedback, and improving quickly.
* Available and consistently reachable during the scheduled working day.
* Authorized to work in the United States.

Experience in home services, pest control, consulting, coaching, SaaS implementation, or a high\-accountability small business is helpful but not required.

This Role Is Probably Not for You If

* You prefer coordinating work over personally building it.
* You need every step mapped out before you can begin.
* You frequently miss small details or rely on someone else to QA your work.
* You confuse activity with completion.
* You tend to expand projects beyond the approved outcome.
* You communicate through long explanations when a clear answer would work.
* You want a large company with narrow responsibilities and multiple layers of management.

Results

You will be successful when:

* Every new Play has a complete implementation plan within 24 hours.
* Every active Play has an accurate next action, owner, and deadline.
* Implementation milestones are completed on time.
* Deliverables pass QA without preventable mistakes or client corrections.
* Work is only marked complete after it has been launched and verified.
* Clients receive systems they can immediately understand and use.
* The founder does not need to chase updates, reconstruct plans, or catch avoidable errors.
* Our Play Library and implementation process improve every month.
* PestLaunch can serve more clients and produce stronger results because of what you build.

Schedule

* Full\-time, Monday through Friday
* 9:00 AM–5:30 PM Mountain Time
* Remote within the United States
* You must be consistently available and responsive throughout the working day
* Most meetings take place on Zoom with professional camera, audio, lighting, and presentation expected

Compensation

* $85,000–$110,000 base salary

jobs.description:
**About Us:**

Trilliant Food \& Nutrition is a leading manufacturer of premium coffees and powdered beverages, proudly headquartered in Little Chute, Wisconsin. With a legacy rooted in quality, innovation, and service, Trilliant delivers branded and private label solutions across retail, foodservice, and e\-commerce channels.

  




Horseshoe Beverage Company, based in Neenah, WI, is a leading ready\-to\-drink beverage manufacturer dedicated to delivering an exceptional beverage experience. By combining industry\-leading talent and cutting\-edge equipment, we drive innovation and consistently deliver the highest quality products to our customers—first and fast.

  



Our brand portfolio includes Victor Allen’s®, Dutch Bros® beverages and Nurri™, our better\-for\-you protein beverage line. We are passionate about beverages – and about building a team that’s just as energized. We invite you to explore opportunities at Trilliant or Horseshoe, to see if your talents and career aspirations may fit with our openings.

  


**Our Core Values:**

  


**Position Overview:**



The Customer Operations Program Manager serves as the strategic operational partner for assigned customers and is accountable for a standardized way of work across customer operational performance, inventory and replenishment insights, service execution, compliance, cost\-to\-serve visibility, and continuous improvement. The role is aligned to the customer not to a brand portfolio and develops deep knowledge of the customer’s systems, requirements, inventory position, replenishment processes, service expectations, and operational priorities.



The COPM connects customer data and operational signals to action. The role works closely with Sales and cross\-functional partners to identify risks and opportunities, provide actionable insights, facilitate root\-cause resolution, and ensure clear ownership and follow\-through.



For this specific customer assignment, the COPM will support Walmart and Sam’s Club and must bring demonstrated replenishment and customer operational experience supporting both Walmart and Sam’s Club. This role requires deep working knowledge of Walmart and Sam’s Club replenishment processes, systems, inventory and POS data, and customer\-specific operational requirements, including hands\-on experience with Retail Link and Nova.

  


**Responsibilities:**


**Customer Operational Partnership**


* Develop an intimate understanding of assigned customers, including customer systems, processes, replenishment requirements, service expectations, operational contacts, and business priorities.


* Serve as the primary operational partner for assigned customers in partnership with the Sales account owner.


* Establish a consistent customer operating cadence, including operational/replenishment reviews, KPI reviews, risk and opportunity discussions, action tracking, and escalation.


* Translate customer needs and operational signals into clear actions and connect work to the appropriate internal partner through resolution.


**Inventory, Replenishment \& POS Analytics**


* Monitor and analyze customer POS, store/DC inventory, in\-stock levels, weeks of supply, order patterns, MABD/fill\-rate compliance, OTIF/service performance, and other customer\-specific inventory and replenishment measures.


* Identify out\-of\-stock risk, excess or imbalanced inventory, replenishment gaps, order opportunities, service risk, and other material customer\-operational concerns.


* Perform root\-cause analysis and provide actionable recommendations to improve in\-stock, inventory flow, replenishment, service, and the cost of moving product optimally.


* Provide order/replenishment recommendations using customer demand signals, inventory position, transit and lead\-time considerations, promotions, seasonality, and customer requirements.


* Prepare customer\-specific replenishment/performance reporting and lead or participate in recurring customer replenishment meetings.


* Develop and improve replenishment tools, reporting, processes, and standard work as business and customer requirements evolve.


* Serve as the customer operations and replenishment subject\-matter expert for Walmart and Sam’s Club, maintaining deep knowledge of customer\-specific replenishment processes, systems, metrics, reporting, and operational expectations.


* Utilize Walmart and Sam’s Club systems, including Retail Link and Nova, to analyze POS, store/DC inventory, in\-stock performance, replenishment trends, order activity, and other customer\-specific operational data.


* Prepare for and lead recurring replenishment and operational performance discussions with Walmart and Sam’s Club replenishment teams, identifying risks, opportunities, root causes, and recommended actions.


**Demand \& Forecast Insights**


* Gather and translate customer POS and/or DC, inventory, replenishment, order, promotional, seasonal, and other customer demand signals into actionable insights for Sales, Demand Planning, and Supply Chain.


* Provide forecast recommendations and proactively identify material changes in demand or inventory position.


* Maintain an active seat at the business table by ensuring customer and replenishment insights inform commercial and operational planning.


**Customer Operational Performance**


* Own visibility to customer operational KPIs, including OTIF, in\-stock, MABD/fill rate, inventory position/weeks of supply, replenishment performance, service performance, compliance, and applicable cost\-to\-serve measures.


* Maintain visibility to purchase\-order\-through\-delivery performance and partner with Customer Service, Logistics, Supply Chain, and other functions to identify systemic execution issues.


* Monitor applicable customer compliance requirements, deductions, chargebacks/fines, and recurring operational failures; coordinate root\-cause analysis, corrective action, and prevention with cross\-functional partners.

**WHO YOU ARE AND WHAT YOU HAVE**


* 8\-10\+ years of media operations or project management experience in a fast\-paced environment, preferably a media agency or in\-house on a media team.

All this might sound great, but you're probably still wondering, "Would I be a good fit for Known?" or "Would Known be a good fit for me?" ### **About Kitsch**


Kitsch is a certified female\- and minority\-owned global beauty brand. Our products are in 32,000\+ retailers across 92 countries. We make essentials that make you feel exceptional.

### **The Role**


We're looking for a **Creative Project Manager** to join our Product Development team, reporting to the VP of Product \& Assortment Strategy. This is a full\-time contractor role, US\-based and remote, Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM PST.


You'll be the link between Creative and Product Development. You'll own the artwork and photography workflow from the first brief to the final file. And you'll make sure our photo assets always match what's really on the shelf.

### **What You'll Do**

* Check every creative brief before work starts. Make sure it has images, copy, specs, and dieline details. Stop incomplete briefs before they slow down the team.
* Own the priority queue for the Creative team. Balance requests from Product Development, Marketing, and other teams so no designer has to guess what's next.

* Be the source of truth for both teams. Share updates early. Clear up confusion before it becomes a delay.

* Keep Asana accurate and complete for every active project. Build timelines that match Product Development schedules.
* Spot and fix workflow problems. Bring ideas that save the team time.

* A knack for turning a messy project into a clear one. You ask the right questions before work starts, not after.
* Backbone. You push back on unrealistic timelines or incomplete briefs, and you find a workable path.
* Comfort translating between two teams with different rhythms and priorities.
* A proactive style. You chase the next step. You don't wait to be asked.
* Rigor with Asana as the single source of truth for your team.
* A talent for building relationships across departments.
* Comfort using AI tools day to day — drafting briefs, summarizing feedback, building templates.

Candidates with experience in **state education agencies, K\-12 organizations, school districts, student data systems, TSDS, or Texas Education Agency projects** are strongly encouraged to apply.

------------------


We're hiring a Data \& AI Program Manager to support a Fortune 100 technology company. This role sits at the intersection of data strategy and applied machine learning, owning the end\-to\-end data lifecycle that fuels natural language processing (NLP) applications and large language model (LLM) development. You'll define what "good data" looks like for a range of NLP use cases, build the guidelines and pipelines to get there, and partner closely with data engineering, data science, and ML teams to turn high\-quality annotated data into measurable model performance gains.

* Design judgment guidelines and instructions for data annotation, validation, and quality control

* Identify data gaps and opportunities; propose new data sources, methods, and features to improve data quality and model outcomes
* Communicate data vision, strategy, and results to internal and external stakeholders, including product owners, engineers, researchers, customers, and partners

* Experience in NLP data strategy, annotation program management, or a related data quality/linguistics role
* Strong understanding of data annotation workflows, guideline design, and inter\-annotator quality control
* Familiarity with LLM training/fine\-tuning pipelines and how annotated data feeds model evaluation

**Adaptive Hunting \& Shooting Sports Customer Success Coordinator**

**ABOUT DIGITAL FOV, LLC**  
Digital FOV, LLC is the company behind Digital Crosshairs adaptive hunting and shooting sports technology. Our products attach to optical scopes and display the scope image on a digital screen, helping people with low vision or physical limitations participate in hunting and recreational shooting. We serve individual hunters and shooters, veterans, caregivers, families and adaptive\-sports organizations.

**THE OPPORTUNITY**  
We are hiring a warm, organized and dependable Customer Success \& Community Coordinator for a 90\-day paid part\-time pilot. You will follow up with customers, discuss how they use Digital Crosshairs in the field or at the range, identify support needs, support product/community meetings and collect permission\-based stories. Direct personal or professional hunting or shooting sports experience is strongly preferred because credibility and rapport matter.

**THIS IS NOT**  
This is not a commission sales job, a cold\-calling position or a social\-media content creator role. The purpose is customer care, relationship building and reliable follow\-through.

**WHAT YOU WILL DO**  
\- Conduct thoughtful check\-in calls and emails with existing customers.  
\- Listen for customer outcomes, field or range experiences, equipment context, support needs and next steps.  
\- Accurately document conversations and follow\-up commitments in our tracking system.  
\- Route technical or policy questions to the founder rather than guessing at an answer.  
\- Identify strong customer stories and use our approved permission process before anything is shared.  
\- Invite customers to approved product\-support/community meetings and manage reminders and follow\-up.  
\- Provide a concise weekly report showing results, unresolved items and priorities.

**YOU MAY BE A STRONG FIT IF YOU**  
\- Have direct personal or professional experience with hunting or shooting sports and can discuss common terminology, field or range settings, optical scopes and customer goals without overstating technical expertise.  
\- Are an excellent listener who helps people feel respected rather than rushed.  
\- Write clear, accurate notes and reliably complete follow\-up.  
\- Can work independently within a small number of weekly hours.  
\- Are comfortable speaking with older adults, veterans, people with low vision or physical limitations, caregivers and families.  
\- Use email, shared documents, video meetings and simple CRM or spreadsheet tools confidently.  
\- Exercise mature judgment with confidential customer information and permission\-based stories.

**EXPERIENCE THAT MAY TRANSLATE WELL**  
Direct hunting or shooting sports experience is strongly preferred. Relevant backgrounds include active hunter or target shooter; range or club staff; outdoor, firearms or optics retail; guiding; competitive shooting; conservation or adaptive hunting programs; or military/law\-enforcement experience paired with recreational shooting. Customer success, recreation therapy, veteran services, nonprofit coordination or story interviewing are also valuable. The strongest candidate combines credible sports familiarity with empathy, organization and follow\-through.

**POSITION DETAILS**  
Job type: Part\-time contract pilot  
Initial term: 90 days, with potential continuation based on results and fit  
Hours: Approximately 8 hours per week; some weekday Eastern Time availability required  
Pay: $28 per hour  
Work location: Remote  
Reports to: Founder, Digital FOV, LLC

**HOW TO APPLY**  
Submit your resume and brief answers to the following four questions:  
1\. Describe a time you helped a customer, member, patient or participant feel heard and then turned the conversation into clear next steps. Please answer in 150 words or fewer.  
2\. Describe your personal or professional experience with hunting and/or shooting sports, including the settings or work that gave you familiarity with the people, terminology and equipment. Please answer in 150 words or fewer.  
3\. What interests you about helping people with low vision or physical limitations continue participating in hunting and recreational shooting?  
4\. Confirm that you can commit approximately 8 hours per week for a 90\-day pilot and have some weekday availability during Eastern Time business hours.

Digital FOV, LLC evaluates applicants based on the requirements of the role, demonstrated capability, judgment and professional fit. We welcome qualified applicants from varied backgrounds and experiences.

Expected hours: 8\.0 per week

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager, Thrive For Support Teams
jobs.description:
Thrive is a leading behavior change technology company founded by Arianna Huffington in 2016 with the mission to end the stress and burnout epidemic. Thrive helps individuals and organizations improve well\-being, performance and mental resilience with its AI\-powered behavior change technology platform. Thrive’s Microsteps – small, science\-backed steps to improve health and productivity – have been adopted by employees at more than 125 organizations in over 140 countries, from frontline and call center workers to executives at multinational companies.

  

Thrive for Support Teams (TST) is a dedicated area of our business focused on frontline support organizations, primarily contact centers and the teams that support them inside large enterprises. We’ve built purpose\-built software for these users, designed around how they actually work and what wellbeing looks like in a high\-volume, high\-pressure environment.

  

We are hiring a Customer Success Manager to own a portfolio of named TST accounts end to end. You will be the clients primary partner from launch through renewal: running implementation and integration, reporting on progress, leading business reviews, and growing the relationship over time.

  

TST has clear process and structure already in place, and we are actively building on it. You will inherit a working foundation, not a blank page, and we are looking for someone detail oriented enough to keep things moving day to day while making the process sharper as they go. This role is a strong fit for someone who likes owning the full arc of a client relationship, is comfortable learning a technical product quickly, and wants clear ownership of their book of business.

 **Who You Are**

* **You are an end\-to\-end relationship owner.** You enjoy managing the full arc of the client journey and take responsibility for delivering a consistently strong experience from implementation through renewal and expansion.
* **You are a structured, detail\-oriented operator.** You keep multiple workstreams moving, make commitments and dependencies visible, and follow through reliably—without losing sight of the broader client strategy.
* **You communicate with clarity and confidence.** You translate technical details and data into straightforward business language, adapt your message to different audiences, and can lead an executive business review with credibility.
* **You are proactive and resourceful.** You are comfortable navigating ambiguity, finding answers, making sound decisions with incomplete information, and driving issues through resolution.
* **You are both process\-minded and improvement\-oriented.** You value established processes and documentation while continually looking for ways to make the work more efficient, scalable, and effective.
* **You are a strong cross\-functional partner.** You build productive relationships across Product, Engineering, Data, Sales, Legal, and Security and know how to move work forward through influence.
* **You are comfortable with data.** You can interpret engagement and outcomes data, identify meaningful trends, and turn insights into clear recommendations and compelling client stories.
* **You are commercially minded.** You understand how strong program delivery translates into retention and growth, and you are comfortable building the value case and leading renewal, pricing, and contract conversations.

 **How You'll Contribute:**

* **Own a portfolio of client relationships.** Serve as the day\-to\-day point of contact for assigned accounts, build trusted relationships with key stakeholders and decision\-makers, and maintain accountability for the overall health of each partnership.
* **Lead implementation and integration.** Manage new client launches and technical integration work from start to finish, coordinating across Product, Engineering, and Data to keep timelines, dependencies, and go\-live commitments on track.
* **Drive program execution.** Manage ongoing client workstreams, maintain clear action plans, and identify and address risks before they affect delivery or the client experience.
* **Measure and communicate impact.** Track engagement, adoption, and outcomes, translating the data into clear insights and recommendations for both clients and internal partners.
* **Lead strategic business reviews.** Own the full business\-review cycle and connect wellbeing and program insights to measurable business value, reinforcing the case for renewal and expansion.
* **Drive retention and growth.** Develop account strategies, identify opportunities to deepen partnerships, and lead renewal and expansion conversations in collaboration with internal stakeholders.
* **Champion the client internally.** Bring client feedback into product and roadmap discussions and partner with Sales, Legal, Security, and other teams to advance contracts, data agreements, and escalations.

* A bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant professional experience.
* At least five years of demonstrated success in customer success, account management, or a comparable client\-facing role, ideally including two or more years at a SaaS technology company.
* Experience independently owning named accounts within a SaaS, health technology, or enterprise services organization.
* Experience carrying or directly contributing to a renewal or growth target.

* The ability to manage multiple client workstreams and competing deadlines with a high degree of organization and accountability.

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
#### **About the Role**


At Xtremepush, we enable companies to build, grow, and retain strong customer relationships by delivering exceptional technology, expertise, and customer service. As a leading provider of customer engagement solutions, our mission is to empower businesses to create meaningful, personalised experiences for their audiences.  

  

Due to rapid growth, we’re seeking an Account Manager to join our high\-performing team. In this role, you will be pivotal in fostering long\-term, trusted partnerships with some of our most valuable customers. By driving revenue retention and growth through relationship building, cross\-selling, and upselling, you’ll directly contribute to our company’s success.  

  

As an Account Manager, you will play a key role in ensuring our customers achieve exceptional outcomes through our platform. By leveraging your expertise and interpersonal skills, you’ll help them realise the full value of their investment, fostering product adoption, expansion, and retention.  

  

This is a hybrid role. \#LI\-Hybrid

#### **Key Responsibilities**

**Client Account Management \& Relationship Development:*** Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned client accounts.
* Build and nurture long\-lasting client relationships, maintaining regular and proactive communication.
* Conduct Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to discuss performance, align on strategic goals, and plan upcoming initiatives.
* Cultivate trusted advisor relationships with key accounts, customer stakeholders, and executive sponsors.

**Business Development:*** Identify and present opportunities for cross\-selling and upselling.
* Negotiate contracts and close agreements.

**Reporting \& Operations:*** Manage client interactions and track progress meticulously using HubSpot.
* Prepare and present detailed account status reports.
* Forecast and track critical account metrics, such as sales performance and annual revenue projections.
* Oversee the end\-to\-end management of RFPs, ensuring timely and high\-quality delivery.

**Client Partnership:*** Act as a client advocate, ensuring their needs and feedback are effectively communicated across teams.
* Collaborate with internal departments to develop and implement strategies that drive customer satisfaction and loyalty.
* Address client concerns promptly and escalate complex issues as necessary.
* Ensure the timely and successful delivery of solutions that align with customer objectives.

#### **Your Experience and Qualifications**

* Proven work experience in an Account Manager, Key Account Manager, Sales Account Manager, Customer Success Manager or relevant role
* Have at least 2 years experience in a tech / SaaS company
* Experience working in the sports, betting and gaming industry
* Demonstrable ability to communicate, present and influence key stakeholders at all levels of an organisation, including executive and C\-level
* Experience delivering client\-focused solutions to customer needs
* Proven ability to juggle multiple account management projects at a time, while maintaining sharp attention to detail
* Excellent listening, negotiation and presentation abilities
* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Familiar with SaaS customer management or have a background in data with a flair for client communication and understand consumer behaviour is desirable
* Additional language is desirable

#### **Location**


This is a hybrid role based in North America. \#LI\-Hybrid

#### **About us**


Headquartered in Ireland with offices in the UK and US, Xtremepush is an Omnichannel Customer Engagement Platform powered by a built\-in CDP. It enables high\-velocity companies to build, grow, and retain strong customer relationships through personalised, relevant, and timely communication. With a true single customer view at its core, Xtremepush provides actionable customer intelligence that drives engagement, conversion, and revenue across all channels, while putting customer retention first.  

  

*At Xtremepush, we believe that diversity adds incredible value to our teams, our products, and our culture. We don’t just accept differences, we celebrate it, we support it, and we thrive on it for the benefit of our employees, our products and our community. As an equal opportunity employer, we stay true to our mission by ensuring that our place can be anyone’s place regardless of race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, disability or age.*

The Technical Account Manager (TAM) at Total Expert is a trusted partner to our financial services customers, helping them maximize the value of the platform through strategic guidance, technical enablement, and ongoing optimization. TAMs serve by combining product expertise with a deep understanding of customer goals, business context, and technology landscape.



This role bridges the gap between strategic vision and practical execution, delivering consistent, high\-quality engagements that are grounded in best\-practices that will drive adoption, operational efficiency, and measurable outcomes. The ideal candidate brings a proactive, service\-minded approach and is energized by the opportunity to help customers make critical financial decisions that shape their lives.


***For candidates based in the Dallas, TX or Minneapolis, MN area, the position follows a hybrid schedule with 3 on\-site days per week. This position would be remote for qualifying candidates residing outside of those areas.***

**What we are looking for:**


* Ability to operate independently with a proactive, customer\-first mindset
* Bias for action and urgency
* Passion for helping organizations adopt technology and achieve measurable success
* Experience working with multi\-stakeholder, enterprise accounts in complex industries
* Strong critical thinking and communication skills—capable of translating strategy into action

**Compensation/Benefits:** The anticipated base salary range for this role is $85,000 \- $95,000 annually. jobs.title: Former Admissions Officer (Account Manager, Full-time)
jobs.description:
**Former Admissions Officer (Account Manager)**
===============================================

**Full\-time \| Remote****Who We Are**
--------------


Prepory is a premier college admissions counseling company. Our innovative, holistic approach is reshaping how students apply to college, find their fit, and earn admission to their dream schools. We've guided more than 20,000 students across 80\+ countries, and we routinely help our students earn admission to the nation's most selective colleges and universities.  

Through our college admissions practice, we work one\-on\-one with students from as early as 8th grade, helping them build an intentional extracurricular profile, craft compelling essays, and navigate every step of the application process. We hold ourselves to an excellent record of success by gearing our services to genuinely counsel the students, families, and institutions we serve.**About This Role**
-------------------


The Former Admissions Officer (Account Manager) is the person our parents hear from most. You'll own the relationship between Prepory and the parents and guardians of the students we serve, from the orientation calls through final admissions decisions, and you'll make sure the experience a family signed up for is the experience they actually get.  

This is a client\-facing, relationship\-driven role. You'll run new student orientations and parent check\-in meetings, serve as the escalation point when a family's expectations and a coach's approach fall out of alignment, and mentor our college admissions coaches on how to navigate hard conversations and complicated family dynamics. When a family is ready to add programming or re\-enroll for another year, you'll be the person they trust enough to ask.  

You'll also maintain a cohort of up to 15 students. That caseload is deliberately small, because the majority of your hours belong to client success. Coaching a few students keeps you close to the advising experience you represent to parents every day.  

You'll report to our Client Success Director and work alongside our Program Directors, Program Managers, Enrollment team, and coaching team. **What You'll Do**

### **Own the family relationship**

* Conduct new student orientation sessions that set clear expectations for the program and each family's role in it.
* Run parent check\-in meetings alongside the student's coach, translating student progress into terms families understand and can act on.
* Communicate proactively with parents and guardians so concerns surface early, while there's still time to solve them.
* Serve as the point of escalation for families whose expectations, needs, or dynamics call for a steadier hand, and know when to bring in the Client Success Director.
* Handle difficult conversations with disappointed or anxious families directly, calmly, and with a solutions\-oriented attitude.

### **Support and protect the coaching relationship**

* Serve as the point of contact and escalation for college admissions coaches navigating client concerns, expectations, and family dynamics.
* Mentor coaches on client communication, individualized student needs, and the situations that don't have a playbook.
* Collaborate with coaches and program leadership to adjust programming when a student's needs change.

### **Grow the relationship**

* Recognize when a family is ready for more, and introduce the Prepory programming that fits: college tours, UK admissions support, graduate and professional school admissions, and enrichment and research planning.
* Own re\-enrollments for the families you serve, and carry the commercial conversation with the same care you bring to every other conversation.
* Champion referral and review strategies, including mentoring coaches on leveraging their relationship with families to drive positive reviews and referrals to friends and family.

### **Coach a cohort of up to 15 students**

**JOB ANNOUNCEMENT**


The Community Youth Center of San Francisco (CYC) provides the youth of our city a sense of belonging and vital tools and experiences to succeed in life. Our services include academic support and college counseling, job placement and employment training, substance use and violence prevention education, crisis intervention and mediation, leadership development, technology and computer training. Our mission is to encourage a diverse population of high\-need young people to explore their full potential through academic, career, family, and community life.

 **Title:****Program Coordinator \- YAWL Work Based Learning**

**Salary:****$30\.00 \- $34\.00 per hour plus excellent benefits**

**Reports to:****Program Supervisor**

**Status:****Full\-Time, (40 hours/week), Non\-Exempt**  

  

**Program Summary:** CYC’s YAWL Workforce Development Program provides job readiness and employment support services to youth ages 16\-24\. The program offers 1:1 job search and career coaching, work based learning internships, college and career exploration, and job shadowing opportunities to propel youth and young adults to be ready for college, work and reach productive adulthood.  

  

**Position Description:** Under the supervision of the Program Supervisor, the Program Coordinator is responsible for overseeing the Work Based Learning portfolio, supervising staff, overseeing workshops/trainings, establishing best practice program models, and providing high quality youth workforce and development services.

 **DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Oversee the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of the Young Adult Work Link program and comprehensive service delivery model.
* Develop policy and procedure recommendations to strengthen the program model and collaboration among grantee and coalition partners.
* Ensure program development and service delivery align with “Youth Program Quality Standards” and meet all “Work Plan” deliverables and deadlines.
* Complete all required documentation, reports, and program deliverables in a timely manner.
* Lead citywide outreach and recruitment efforts, cultivating strategic community partnerships and developing a robust referral network to support recruitment and engagement, with a focus on priority populations.
* Develop and facilitate job readiness training workshops, including but not limited to professionalism, career exploration, resume and cover letter building, job search/navigation, interview skill development, mock interviews, and strength/talent identification.
* Coordinate subsidized internships, recruiting local SF businesses/employers to partner as a worksite and provide support to worksite supervisors and participants throughout the internship period.
* Conduct participant assessments and provide intensive case management, wraparound supportive services, and guidance to address barriers affecting work and school performance.
* Develop individualized vocational goals and career plans using vocational and interest assessments, and provide personal and career guidance.
* Coordinate GED attainment, tutoring, basic skills remediation, postsecondary education, and workforce training services.
* Provide 1:1 career guidance and assist participants with individualized education and career planning services, job search and placement assistance and conduct follow ups for retention services.
* Connect participants to resources within CYC and other CBO or city services for barrier removal to ensure their success.
* Supervise, support, coach and train Program Specialists in job readiness training content, career counseling, outreach, funder databases, and other duties as applicable.
* Collaborate with the workforce team to strategize on program planning, development and implementation of overall youth workforce development programs and outcomes.
* Partnerships/Event Planning
* Coordinate career exploration events and adult mentoring opportunities such as worksite/company tours, college tours, and networking events for program participants
* Support agency\-wide events and perform other duties as assigned by management.

 **QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor's degree in relevant field.
* Experience working with diverse youth backgrounds, preferably within youth workforce development programs.
* Previous experience in program coordination, internship coordination, and development
* Ability to work with ethnically diverse groups of low\-income youth as well as English learners to support their social and emotional needs during transition.
* At least 1 year of experience supervising a team of three or more staff.
* Experience working with San Francisco's diverse communities and neighborhoods.
* Experience working with community\-based service providers and private sector partners.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills and proficiency in Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, Zoom, and other technology platforms.
* Experience facilitating workshops for youth and young adults.
* Ability to work as part of a team, to prioritize and handle multiple tasks and to work independently in a high\-pressure environment.
* Bilingual in Cantonese/Mandarin/Spanish and English is preferred.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills.
* Enthusiasm for promoting academic achievement and college education.
* Able to lift or move at least 25lbs
* Ability to work some evenings and weekends.

new_jobs.description:
**About Anthropic**
-------------------



Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

**About the role**
------------------



Join Anthropic as a Customer Success Manager supporting our Beneficial Deployments team's initiatives in Life Sciences. As a Customer Success Manager for Life Sciences, you’ll be a strategic partner and trusted advisor to the world's leading organizations working to accelerate scientific discovery. You will help them harness the full potential of Claude's capabilities across the API, Claude for Enterprise, Claude Code, and Claude Science to accelerate their scientific work.



This is a hybrid role that blends deep 1:1 account management with scaled, one\-to\-many programs. You'll own a portfolio of named strategic accounts, such as research institutes, academic medical centers, scientific foundations, and mission\-driven biotech, where you'll build genuine partnerships grounded in a deep understanding of their research mission, scientific objectives, programmatic goals, and technical capacity. You will help these organizations scale their usage effectively drive model and use case optimization, implement change management strategies, and maximize the value of their investment through expanded use cases across their organization. Alongside that portfolio, you'll design and run a handful of one\-to\-many engagement programs, including webinars, hackathons, cohort\-based enablement, and researcher communities, that extend Claude's impact across the broader life sciences ecosystem well beyond any single partner relationship.



The insights you gather from these partnerships will directly inform our research priorities, product development (including how Claude for Life Sciences evolves), and strategies for beneficial AI deployment, making you a key voice in shaping how we build and deliver AI systems that accelerate science for the benefit of society.


**Key responsibilities:**
-------------------------


* Build trusting, strategic relationships with research leaders, principal investigators, program directors, and IT teams to understand their organizational goals, scientific priorities, and impact objectives, identifying opportunities for optimization and expanded AI deployment in service of their research mission
* Become an expert in Anthropic's products across the API, Claude for Enterprise, Claude Code, and Claude for Life Sciences (including scientific tool integrations and agent skills), understanding the technical nuances and best practices for each to guide partners to the right solutions
* Monitor usage patterns and proactively drive adoption across your 1:1 accounts, identifying optimization opportunities and discovering new applications for Claude
* Develop and execute change management strategies appropriate for scientific and academic organizational cultures, driving adoption through Train the Trainer programs, Center of Excellence development, and organizational enablement that respects partner capacity constraints, governance requirements, and decision\-making processes
* Establish the repeatable playbooks, templates, and health metrics that define what "great" looks like for both dedicated and scaled customer success in life sciences at Anthropic
* Design and run one\-to\-many engagement programs for the life sciences community, such as live and on\-demand webinars, hackathons and build days, cohort\-based onboarding, office hours, and researcher user communities, that move a broad set of organizations from signed to activated and extend impact beyond individual partner relationships
* Guide partners through the technical and governance foundation for launch, including SSO and provisioning, workspace configuration, and data handling considerations relevant to research and health data (such as HIPAA, IRB, and institutional data policies), so research and IT leaders trust the deployment from day one
* Document and quantify value realized through research productivity, time\-to\-insight, program effectiveness, cost savings, and mission amplification to build compelling cases for continued investment in AI, and partner with Marketing to develop success stories and reference accounts

**You may be a good fit if you have:**
--------------------------------------


* 6\+ years of experience in Customer Success, Technical Account Management, or Solutions Engineering
* 3\+ years of experience in life sciences research with ample exposure to the intersection of new technologies as a catalyst for accelerating progress
* Experience working directly with life sciences organizations, such as academic research institutions, nonprofit research institutes, foundations, biotech, or pharma, and familiarity with how scientific research is conducted, funded, and governed.
* Deep understanding of regulations, risk, and compliance needs of the industry
* Experience driving success across both consumption\-based and seat\-based business models, with understanding of different expansion levers and success metrics for each
* Experience designing and delivering one\-to\-many customer programs (webinars, hackathons, cohort\-based onboarding, user communities, or similar) alongside managing dedicated strategic accounts

**About the Company:**

  

GreenWaste has been an industry leader in recycling and waste diversion for 40 years and is on a growth trajectory after private equity investment in 2021\. Our business was founded on principles of environmental sustainability, and innovation is a cornerstone of our ongoing operations and growth strategy. GreenWaste specializes in all aspects of material collection, processing, and sales, tailoring our service offerings to the unique needs of our customers and communities, and helping to shape the evolution of the solid waste and recycling industry. new_jobs.description:
**About Nowadays**
==================


We're building the future of in\-person connection, from intimate exec offsites to a conference\-level company offsite.


Nowadays is the first AI\-powered platform for planning corporate events. Our software handles everything from venue sourcing to vendor negotiations, making it easier and faster for teams to meet up in real life.


We've planned events across the globe for companies like Google, Airbnb, and Quantstamp, and we're just getting started.


Our mission is simple: make it easier for teams to create meaningful moments together.

**Who we are**
==============


We're a sister\-founded team based in San Francisco. We move fast, care deeply, and love bringing people together (whether it's a strategic offsite or a Friendsgiving in our Nowadays home).


We believe the best teams:

* Take ownership
* Keep things scrappy
* Celebrate wins (big and small)
* Genuinely enjoy working (\+ hanging out) together


Some of our favorite team excursions so far:

* Flying trapeze
* Steak\-offs at home
* Hauling a Christmas tree up to the office
* Hitting the spa after a big launch
* Racing an Ironman Relay

**What this role is**
=====================


This is a **zero\-to\-one operations role**. You'll take messy, fast\-moving workflows and turn them into systems that are simple, teachable, and scalable, without losing the human care that defines Nowadays.

**What you'll do**
==================

**80% of your time will focus on event operations and client communication**

* Own events end\-to\-end simultaneously, including clear written \+ verbal on\-brand client communication
* Own and evolve the end\-to\-end ops flow for running events, from first request to post\-event wrap
* Be the point person for prioritizing urgent vs non\-urgent ops issues
* Turn tribal knowledge into clear documentation, onboarding, and templates that anyone can use

**The remaining 20% of your time will focus on building for scale**

* Build scalable playbooks for: running a single complex event start\-to\-finish, and managing many events in parallel
* Partner closely with engineering to: translate customer feedback and bugs into clear product requirements and actionable tickets, and help test, validate, and refine tools before launch
* Create and maintain internal resources: ops onboarding docs, and client\-facing guides and templates for planning offsites
* Continuously identify what should be simplified, automated, or eliminated

**What we're looking for**
==========================

* You consistently put clients first, understanding that this can sometimes require late nights or weekend work
* You can juggle multiple workstreams and know how to prioritize quickly
* You're excellent at turning complexity into clarity
* You care deeply about process, but never at the expense of momentum
* Extreme attention to detail
* You're comfortable working across ops, product, dev, sales, and clients
* You communicate clearly, thoughtfully, and with good judgment
* You like building systems that other people can run
* You want to shape how a company operates, not just follow a playbook

**Bonus points**
================

* Startup zero\-to\-one experience
* Experience working with clients \+ owning client relationships
* Strong intuition for customer experience and boundaries
* Experience writing clear tickets in tools like Linear or Jira
* Comfort with basic SQL or data analysis to answer operational questions
* Comfort using AI/tools to replace manual, repetitive work

**Other details**
=================

**Location**

* In\-person in San Francisco

**Perks**

* Free lunch \+ dinner
* Quarterly team offsites (yes, we went to the White Lotus S3 hotel in Thailand), and exclusive access to top venues and events
* Monthly fitness stipend
* Health insurance
* 12 weeks paid parental leave
* Generous PTO with required time off to recharge
* High ownership, autonomy, and direct access to founders
* Access to top venues, events, and travel experiences

  

Compensation Range: $90K \- $130K
