new_jobs.title: Senior Quality Assurance Technician - NPI
new_jobs.description:
**Company Overview**


Embark on an enriching journey with PROCEPT BioRobotics, where our vision, mission, and values guide everything we do as a company. At PROCEPT, we put the patient first in everything we do and are committed to revolutionizing treatment for benign prostatic hyperplasia (BPH, otherwise known as prostate gland enlargement) through innovation in surgical robotics. As our company succeeds and grows, we improve the quality of life of patients, provide more effective treatment options for surgeons, uphold the trust of our shareholders. That starts with a commitment to our People with a focus on creating an evolving landscape for your career, brimming with transformative opportunities that provide continuous career growth opportunities.

**Understanding PROCEPT's Culture**


At PROCEPT, we believe every person matters. Every employee, every patient, every caregiver. Because we are here to create a revolution, and we believe in doing that by innovating everywhere with pathological optimism. We believe in being humble and highly engaged in the work we do, while also working together seamlessly for a common goal. At Procept, curiosity, ingenuity and conviction in the power technology will transform the lives of our patients and providers.




And this doesn’t happen by accident. It starts with our live induction program that serves as an incubator for cross\-functional team building, an immersion in Procept’s history, jam\-packed interactive sessions with executive leadership and a crash\-course in the mission and purpose of what we do. It continues with our one\-of\-a\-kind management program designed to build the best managers in the industry, where our people managers across functions come together to exchange ideas and grow, as both managers and learners, in an environment that challenges, supports and broadens.




We are fueled by the opportunity to give people their lives back. And we believe that it begins with YOU! At Procept, we push beyond just finding a work/life balance, we strive to find a work/life blend, a professional world that you are honored and impassioned to belong to, one that you can proudly share with your family, friends, and acquaintances.




An opportunity at PROCEPT BioRobotics won’t just be about finding a job. It will be an opportunity for you to join a community devoted to making a difference in this world!

 **The Opportunity That Awaits You:**

Do you want to be part of an innovative, cutting\-edge technology and robotics company that is transforming the treatment of BPH? Are you excited to work with an enthusiastic, driven, and collaborative team that continuously learns and improves together? Are you passionate about driving process excellence and making a meaningful impact? Are you detail\-oriented and thrive in a fast\-paced NPI environment?


At PROCEPT BioRobotics, you will contribute to our continuous improvement culture as a member of the Quality Engineering team, supporting New Product Introduction (NPI) activities for disposables and accessories. As a **Senior Quality Assurance Technician**, you will perform inspections, testing, documentation, and other quality\-related activities to help ensure that single\-use products and accessory components meet established requirements from development through commercialization.


This role will support product quality activities with a primary focus on Verification \& Validation (V\&V) testing and New Product Introduction (NPI). This role works cross\-functionally with R\&D, Manufacturing, and Quality Engineering to ensure products meet design requirements, regulatory standards, and company quality objectives throughout the product lifecycle. Success in this position requires strong attention to detail, a hands\-on and proactive approach, effective communication, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced NPI environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Partner with Quality Engineering, R\&D, and Manufacturing during product development and design transfer to support prototype builds, design iterations, engineering studies, pilot builds, and product testing.
* Prepare, label, track, store, and maintain traceability of test samples throughout testing.
* Set up test fixtures, equipment, instrumentation, and samples in accordance with approved procedures and protocols.
* Verify that test and measurement equipment is within calibration before use and report any equipment\-related issues.
* Execute design verification and validation protocols, including functional, reliability, performance, and simulated\-use testing.
* Perform visual, dimensional, and functional inspections using approved methods and inspection equipment.
* Accurately record test conditions, observations, and results in accordance with Good Documentation Practices (GDP).
* Compile and summarize test data for review by Quality Engineering and other project stakeholders. Identify, document, and promptly escalate protocol deviations, nonconformances, equipment issues, and unexpected test results.
* Support failure investigations and root cause analysis by reproducing failures, collecting evidence, performing measurements, and documenting observations.
* Provide practical feedback regarding product testability, manufacturability, inspection methods, and potential quality risks.
* Support the development and improvement of test fixtures, inspection methods, work instructions, and test procedures.
* Assist with document control activities, including drafting, reviewing, and updating procedures, test methods, forms, and associated quality records.
* Support equipment maintenance, laboratory organization, material inventory, and workplace cleanliness. Follow applicable environmental, health, and safety requirements when handling equipment, chemicals, and test samples.
* Perform assigned activities in accordance with the FDA Quality Management System Regulation (QMSR), ISO 13485, EU MDR, and PROCEPT’s internal quality s

new_jobs.title: TAY Trauma Case Manager
new_jobs.description:
**Job Description: Transitional Age Youth Case Manager**

**DEPARTMENT:** **Jail Health Services: Behavioral Health and Reentry Programs**

**Core Job Description**

Responsible for providing behavioral health treatment, care management and care coordination services to Transitional Age Youth incarcerated in the San Francisco City and County Jail system. Conducts trauma screenings and needs assessments and works collaboratively with clients to develop comprehensive reentry plans. Adheres to all State, Federal and County documentation standards and HIPAA regulations. Is computer literate and competent in electronic health record documentation. Bachelor Degree is required.

**Summary of Major Job Responsibilities**

Under administrative direction and clinical supervision, provides evidence based treatment with a focus on reentry planning to a caseload of transitional age youth suffering from a history of trauma. As a staff member, the case manager is responsible for the mission of Jail Health Services’ Behavioral Health and Reentry Services programs as outlined in the specific areas of responsibility.

**Specific Areas of Responsibilities**

* Conducts trauma screenings and behavioral health evaluations with individuals incarcerated in the San Francisco City and County Jail who are between the ages of 18 and 25\.
* Collaborates with patients to develop comprehensive reentry plans.
* Provides evidence\-based and trauma informed care to all patients in both individual and group treatment settings.
* Makes referrals to community treatment providers as clinically indicated.
* Works with existing treatment providers, family members and friends to prevent the patient’s disconnection from their natural community supports.
* Acts as a liaison between the patient’s natural community supports and the criminal justice and legal systems.
* Works closely with San Francisco Superior Court’s Collaborative Court programs including Young Adult Court, Drug Court and Behavioral Health Court.
* Collects demographic and treatment outcome data for the incarcerated TAY population.
* Provides follow\-up treatment after community placement, as indicated.
* Provides in custody mental health treatment including, but not limited to, individual, group and milieu therapy.
* Routinely assesses for client safety.
* Charts on patients.
* Develops treatment plans.
* Refers to psychiatrist for medication when indicated.
* Follows all policies and procedures of the program.
* Imparts and maintains ethical standards
* Promotes high quality treatment that is grounded in the principles of wellness and recovery.
* Works with Jail Health Services staff and other treatment providers to ensure integrated care.
* Wears appropriate, professional attire at all times.
* Demonstrates commitment to the continued development of multi\-cultural understanding through trainings, workshops, reading, etc.

**Minimum Qualifications** 

* Experience working with individuals with mental illness, substance use disorders and / or characterological challenges.
* Proficiency in computer usage, including Microsoft Office products (Excel, Outlook and Word).
* Good communication skills.
* Good attention to detail.
* Ability to get to all of San Francisco’s jails and treatment facilities.
* Ability to type.
* Ability to respond quickly and use good judgment in unusual and emergency situations.
* Ability to work with prisoners in a jail environment.
* Ability to obtain and maintain a jail clearance.
* Willingness to accompany clients in the community.
* Sensitivity to and experience working with the ethnically, culturally, socially, and sexually diverse individuals, communities, agencies, and organizations which comprise the constituency of Jail Health Services.
* Ability to work independently within a multidisciplinary team and interact effectively with the medical and criminal justice system as well as community providers in order to facilitate the delivery of comprehensive behavioral health care.
* Bachelor Degree

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Working knowledge of DSM 5 diagnoses.
* Knowledge of evidence\-based practices ie Motivational Interviewing, Cognitive Behavioral Therapy, Trauma Informed Care and Wellness and Recovery principles.
* Experience with crisis intervention, assessment, suicide prevention, and drug and alcohol treatment.
* Experience working with the Transitional Age Youth population.
* Working knowledge of psychiatric medications.

**Essential Job Functions and Physical Demands**

Ability to read and write, and to use a telephone and a computer. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit, talk, hear, stand, and walk. The employee is occasionally required to reach with hands and arms, use hands to finger or handle, and climb. Specific vision abilities required by the job include close vision and ability to adjust focus. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions.

**Work Environment**

Working in a jail frequently exposes the employee to moderate levels of noise, fumes, airborne particles and toxic or caustic chemicals. Employees work with criminal offenders, some of whom may be dangerous.

Schedule : Monday \- Friday (evenings and weekends may be required)

* Health insurance

* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Ability to Relocate:

new_jobs.title: Case Manager II
new_jobs.description:
**JOB SUMMARY**: The Case Manager II (CM II), a key member of the primary care interdisciplinary team, provides services for patients with complex care needs. This position conducts patient outreach, engagement and psychosocial service assessment, assists in developing a patient\-centered care plan, is the lead implementer of Enhanced Care Management (ECM) and coordinates service referrals and delivery. The Case Manager meets clients in home, clinic, or community as appropriate or required by the specific program/site. The CM II provides services to specific populations that have multiple complex health and social services needs and often provides care outside of a traditional health center setting, such as home visits, hospitals, supportive housing sites, encampments and shelters.


This position is represented by SEIU\-UHW. Salaries and benefits are set by a collective bargaining agreement (CBA), and an employee in this position must remain a member in good standing of SEIU\-UHW, as defined in the CBA.

**Essential Functions**:

* Outreach, via telephone and in person at LifeLong, community and residential sites, to patients who meet case management program eligibility criteria or are prioritized by LifeLong for this service
* Proactively meet and engage with patients to build effective relationships and assess strengths and needs through use of standard intake, screening tools, and health, and social services records review
* Actively involve patients and caregivers, as appropriate, in designing and delivering services, including development of care plans, assuring alignment with patients’ values and expressed goals of care
* Provide and facilitate referrals for internal and external resources, and collaborate with the patient to complete required applications, forms, or releases of information
* Maintain a patient caseload in accordance with LifeLong standards for the specific population served or site requirements
* Utilize data registries and reports to manage caseload, meet program requirements, maintain grant deliverables, and promote high quality care
* Provide health education and training to patients, including but not limited to, harm reduction and disease risk\-mitigation strategies that empower patients to manage their own health and wellness (e.g. overdose prevention, mitigating spread of communicable diseases)
* Assist patients with accessing and retaining public benefits and insurance (e.g. MediCal, SSI/SSDI, CalFresh, General Assistance, etc), and affordable/subsidized housing
* Respectfully and routinely communicate with patients, their care team members, external partners, and identified social supports
* Maintain knowledge of patients’ medical/behavioral health treatment plans and facilitate utilization of services by providing resources such as accompaniment, transportation, in\-home care, reminder calls etc.
* Participate in team meetings to coordinate care, support patient goals, and reduce barriers to accessing services
* Advocate on behalf of patients to get their needs met and/or support patients to learn advocacy strategies for themselves.
* Provide case management services to patients with multiple complex acute or chronic medical or behavioral health conditions (e.g. HIV/AIDS, Hep C, congestive heart failure, severe diabetes, severe hypertension, psychosis, pregnancy, and homelessness)
* Provide general housing case management services that includes document readiness, housing problem solving, and assessments for Coordinated Entry System
* Assist with patient crisis intervention and de\-escalation
* Provide and document billable services to eligible populations that result in revenue generation for LifeLong
* Keep current on community resources and social service supports to effectively serve the target population
* Document patient contacts/services in required data systems (EHR, HMIS etc.) according to LifeLong policy
* Specific activities may vary depending on the requirements of the program and funder.
* Promote diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging in support of patients and staff
* Represent LifeLong positively in the community and advocate on behalf of underserved populations

**Qualifications**

* Commitment to working directly with low\-income persons from diverse backgrounds in a culturally responsive manner
* Commitment to harm reduction, recovery, housing first, age\-friendly and patient centered care
* Strong organizational, administrative and problem\-solving skills, and ability to be flexible and adaptive to change while maintaining a positive attitude
* Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written skills
* Ability to prioritize tasks, work under pressure, and complete assignments in a timely manner
* Ability to seek direction/approval on essential matters, yet work independently, using professional judgment and diplomacy
* Works well in a team\-oriented environment
* Conducts oneself in external settings in a way that reflects positively on your employer
* Ability to be creative, mature, proactive, and committed to continual learning and improvement in professional settings

**Job Requirements**

* High School diploma or GED
* At least two (2\) years of progressively responsible work or volunteer experience in a community\-based health care or social work setting or at least one (1\) year of experience as a Case Manager I or equivalent position
* Proficient skills using Microsoft Office applications like Word, Excel, and Outlook, as well as the ability to work in and/or manage databases
* Access to reliable transportation with current license and insurance

**Job Preferences**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Social Work, or another Health or Human Services field
* Work or lived experience in area(s) relevant to the population to be served: e.g. perinatal, homelessness, recovery, criminal justice, elder care, palliative and end\-of\-life care, or behavioral health

new_jobs.title: Program Lead, Math
new_jobs.description:
**About Primer**
================


Primer is a growing network of K–8 schools restoring the timeless foundations of American education. Inspired by the original teaching primers that shaped a nation of readers, thinkers, and builders, our schools begin with what has always worked, and build for what lies ahead. Close\-knit learning environments. Skilled educators. A culture that takes kids seriously as learners and leaders.


Primers shaped the first 200 years of American children. Primer will ready them for the next.

**About the role**
------------------


Primer's 3\-8 math program runs almost entirely through learning software: kids move through core math instruction primarily via math apps, with virtual teachers layered in for the live support, motivation, and problem\-solving those apps can't provide on their own. This role owns that program — choosing and sequencing the right apps, building the instructional model around them, and leading the team of virtual math teachers.


You'll be the in\-house expert on 3\-8 math at Primer: someone who knows the landscape of math apps and adaptive platforms, has real opinions about which ones move kids forward and why, and can turn both into a program that holds up across a network of small campuses. This is a remote, collaborative role on the broader Academic curriculum team, with quarterly travel to campuses to see the program in action. You’ll also play a key role in shaping the long\-term strategy for 3–8 math at Primer, balancing strong execution of today’s program with forward\-thinking about how our math model should evolve.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Own the 3\-8 math academic program
* Make and document curriculum decisions across 3\-8 math, including learning software and all instructional materials that drive the program
* Build and maintain the Primer Math Learning Continuum that ties math apps together into one coherent pathway, partnering with the K\-2 Lead where the two bands meet
* Design and support training for Primer Leaders and virtual math teachers on the program and how to run it well
* Stay current on math apps and adaptive learning tools — new platforms, what the research says, what's actually working elsewhere — so program decisions are well\-informed
* Think proactively about how to maintain program quality and consistency as Primer scales
* Regularly analyze student performance data and program usage data to understand what’s working, identify gaps, and use those insights to drive decisions about the 3\-8 math program
* Manage the virtual math teaching team
* Manage a team of virtual math teachers who provide live instruction and support across campuses
* Set clear expectations for what strong virtual math teaching looks like inside the Primer model, and give direct, useful feedback to improve their instruction
* Collaborate across the curriculum team
* Work closely with other members of the Academic team to ensure coherence and continuity across the K\-8 experience, especially at the K\-2/3\-8 handoff
* Partner with the Director of Campus Teams and Head of Training to understand what's happening on the ground and translate that into program adjustments and improved training
* Report to and operate in close partnership with the Director of Academics
* Shape the 3\-8 math experience in our Primer operating system
* Serve as an active partner to the product team on 3\-8 math features and app integrations — contributing to design discussions, giving feedback, piloting new tools before broader rollout
* Flag issues and gaps in how Primer.com supports the math program and advocate for solutions
* Stay connected to campuses
* Travel quarterly (at minimum) to observe the math program in action
* Build relationships with Primer Leaders and virtual math teachers to understand how the program is landing and where support is needed

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* Bachelor's degree
* At least 5 years of experience teaching or leading math instruction in grades 3\-8
* Experience managing or coaching teachers
* Experience designing, strategically shaping, or improving a math program not just delivering one
* Experience with adaptive or mastery\-based math programs
* Expertise in math instruction and learning software
* Deep knowledge of 3\-8 math: how kids build math understanding across these grades, and what a strong software\-driven model looks like in practice
* Hands\-on familiarity with major math learning apps and adaptive platforms with a clear point of view on which ones work and why
* You genuinely believe well\-designed learning software can drive core math instruction
* 2\+ years of relevant experience in curriculum, instructional design, or a closely related role


Strong people management, collaboration, and communication

* Experience managing a team, with the ability to set clear expectations and give direct, useful feedback
* You work well across a small, distributed team and can manage your own time and priorities without heavy oversight
* You're comfortable giving and receiving direct feedback


Remote work \+ travel

* You do your best work independently and don't need daily in\-person collaboration to stay effective
* You're genuinely interested in seeing your work in action and willing to travel quarterly to campuses to make that happen


Nice to Have

* Experience in a charter, microschool, or non\-traditional school environment
* Experience managing a remote or distributed team of teachers

*Primer is a mission\-first company. We believe our mission is the highest\-leverage way we can create positive change. In service of that, we keep work centered on mission execution and avoid social or political activism at work that’s unrelated to the mission. If that energizes you, we’d love to see you apply.*

new_jobs.title: Account Manager Lead - Corporate
new_jobs.description:
**About ElevenLabs**
--------------------


ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.


We launched in January 2023 with the first human\-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses \- from fast\-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B \- multiples of 11, always.  

  

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

* ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.
* ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70\+ languages.
* ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.


Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team \- builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex\-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

**How we work**
---------------

* **High\-velocity:** Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.
* **Impact not job titles:** We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.
* **AI first:** We use AI to move faster with higher\-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.
* **Excellence everywhere:** Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.
* **Global team:** We prioritize your talent, not your location.

**What we offer**
-----------------

* **Innovative culture:** You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.
* **Growth paths:** Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact \- beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.
* **Learning \& development**: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.
* **Social travel**: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.
* **Annual company offsite:** Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location \- past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.
* **Co\-working**: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co\-working stipend.

### **About the Role**


As the Corporate Account Manager Lead, you'll lead a team of Account Managers across our highest\-velocity, highest\-volume post\-sales segment. You'll balance people leadership, strategic direction, and hands\-on customer impact \- driving excellence in post\-sales outcomes and ensuring your team consistently delivers measurable value across a large, fast\-moving book of accounts.


This is a revenue\-critical role at an inflection point: ElevenLabs is scaling fast, and Corporate is where that scale shows up first \- more accounts, more velocity, and less room for anything that doesn't repeat well. The decisions you make around segmentation, playbook design, and how AI agents and automation get embedded into everyday AM workflows will define how this motion performs as volume keeps growing. Making ElevenAgents the agent of choice across the Corporate portfolio is a core part of that expansion playbook.

**You will:**

* Lead, coach, and develop a high\-performing Corporate Account Management team, owning team quota performance, retention, expansion, and cross sell goals across a high\-volume book of business.
* Drive revenue outcomes as a core mandate \- building a team culture where expansions and cross\-sells are owned with the same rigor as any quota\-carrying sales function.
* Design and implement repeatable, scalable playbooks for renewals, expansion, and adoption that hold up across hundreds of accounts, not just a handful.
* Embed AI agents and automation into AM workflows by default, so the team can manage growing volume without simply adding headcount.
* Champion AI fluency across the team: set expectations, build capability, and create an environment where every AM is actively experimenting with and adopting AI\-powered approaches to their work.
* Set strategic direction for how the Corporate segment is structured and staffed as the business scales, partnering closely with RevOps, Comp/Finance, and CX leadership.
* Represent the voice of the customer in leadership discussions, influencing roadmap, tooling, and revenue strategy.

### **Requirements**

* 5\+ years of experience in Account Management, Sales, Customer Success, or post\-sales roles within SaaS, ideally with meaningful exposure to high\-volume, transactional or corporate\-segment books of business.
* Proven track record of owning and exceeding revenue targets (renewals, expansion, NRR/GRR, cross sell), with a clear commercial instinct.
* 2\+ years of direct people leadership experience \- managing AMs/CSMs, driving team quota, and developing talent through coaching and enablement. Passion for building a high\-performance, feedback\-driven culture grounded in accountability and customer impact.
* Deep AI fluency: you use AI tools in your own daily workflow, understand what AI agents and automation can do, and are ready to lead a team through a meaningful shift in how work gets designed and executed.
* Strong player\-coach mindset: comfortable managing accounts directly while leading others to excel in their own portfolios.
* Expertise in post\-sales methodologies and best practices (e.g. success planning, adoption frameworks, ROI storytelling) adapted for a high\-volume, scaled motion.

new_jobs.title: Product Operations Specialist, Servicing
new_jobs.description:
**About Us:**


At Parafin, we’re on a mission to grow small businesses.  

  

Small businesses are the backbone of our economy, but traditional banks often don’t have their backs. We build tech that makes it simple for small businesses to access the financial tools they need through the platforms they already sell on.
  

  

We partner with companies like DoorDash, Amazon, Worldpay, and Mindbody to offer fast and flexible funding, spend management, and savings tools to their small business users via a simple integration. Parafin takes on all the complexity of capital markets, underwriting, servicing, compliance, and customer service for our partners.  

  

We’re a tight\-knit team of innovators hailing from Stripe, Square, Plaid, Coinbase, Robinhood, CERN, and more — all united by a passion for building tools that help small businesses succeed. Parafin is backed by prominent venture capitalists including GIC, Notable Capital, Redpoint Ventures, Ribbit Capital, and Thrive Capital. Parafin is a Series C company, and we have raised more than $194M in equity and $340M in debt facilities.  

  

Join us in creating a future where every small business has the financial tools they need.

**About the Position**


We are looking for a Servicing Specialist to support our merchants each day. This role will be a critical operator of the company's product suite by providing a positive payment experience for the small businesses we support. You will be responsible for running and building best\-in\-class processes for payments, fraud, and servicing, and work directly with our Servicing Ops Lead to solve problems for hundreds of thousands of merchants. You will always have a seat at the table, given a platform to share your thoughts and suggestions for improvement!


Are you a customer\-obsessed operational problem solver excited to work at a fast\-growing startup to help grow small businesses? If so, come join us!

**What You’ll Be Doing:**

* Investigate and resolve issues in the areas of processing payments, creating alternative payment plans, error handling, and other related tasks to ensure full payment collections.
* Provide quality service to small business owners via email, SMS, and phone, with a focus on debugging and resolving payment issues.
* De\-escalate scenarios and present resolutions for tough\-to\-navigate situations.
* Identify and track payment issues to ensure transparency and decrease missing payments over time.
* Provide necessary documentation, details, and evidence in a timely manner to ensure all payment issues are addressed.
* Review and respond to payment disputes, gathering documentation and evidence to represent Parafin's position with bank and card network partners
* Monitor transaction activity for fraud indicators or anomalous patterns, escalating high\-risk cases per policy in a timely manner
* Work with the Customer Support and Funding teams to build feedback loops and processes in servicing customers.
* Work directly with management and product ops managers for ongoing improvements of the merchant experience, including but not limited to systems, process, and product\-level improvements.
* Work in a startup environment with the goal to strive for improvement with both the quality and method of the interaction with merchants.
* Review current processes and provide feedback on how to improve the function, question the status quo as well as call out inefficiencies to address.
* Support other product functions with your specialties as needed.

**What We’re Searching For:**

* 2\+ years of experience with loan servicing
* Strong understanding of payments, ACH failures, and return codes
* Experience reviewing and resolving payment disputes/chargebacks, including compiling evidence and representing cases to banks or card networks
* Familiarity with transaction monitoring — identifying fraud signals, unusual account activity, or high\-risk patterns and escalating appropriately
* Excellent communication skills
* Thrive in an entrepreneurial environment
* Data\-driven approach to monitoring and optimizing recovery rates
* Desire to have an impact, grow your career, and be a game changer in the space for Parafin

**We Prefer If You Have:**

* Experience working in a fintech startup.
* Experience building a team and processes from the ground up
* Fluency in (or desire to learn) data analysis skills and tools, such as SQL / R / Python

**What We Offer**

* Salary Range: $118k \- $123k
* Equity grant
* Medical, dental \& vision insurance
* Unlimited PTO
* Work from home flexibility
* Commuter benefits
* Free lunches
* Paid parental leave
* 401(k)

To shape the future of travel, people must come first. Guided by our Values and Leadership Agreements, we foster an open culture where everyone belongs, differences are celebrated and know that when one of us wins, we all win.


We provide a full benefits package, including exciting travel perks, generous time\-off, parental leave, a flexible work model (with some pretty cool offices), and career development resources, all to fuel our employees' passion for travel and ensure a rewarding career journey. We’re building a more open world. Join us.


**Senior Market Manager**

**Introduction to the Team**

Expedia Group B2B connects partners across the travel industry to our leading technology, supply, and services \- helping them deliver seamless travel experiences to their partners.


From airlines and hotels to financial institutions and other travel platforms, we power smarter, faster, and more impactful travel solutions through the most connected marketplace in the world.


**Make an Impact**

As a Senior Market Manager, you will manage and develop a segment of the portfolio to deepen partner relationships and grow accounts through strategic planning. You will act as a trusted advisor, take ownership of partner challenges, and coordinate internal and external solutions that deliver strong business outcomes. You may also lead negotiations for smaller accounts and share best practices across teams and regions.

* Identify opportunities to strengthen and grow accounts, including cross\-selling relevant products, services, and solutions.

This role focuses on driving long\-term value through strategic planning, cross\-functional collaboration, and proactive account management. **Who We Are:**  

At Velocity Vehicle Group (VVG), we represent a premium commercial brand in medium to heavy truck dealerships. We provide full\-service experience, from exceptional sales teams to highly skilled technicians and readily available parts. Our mission is to be the ultimate one\-stop shop for truckers, owner operators, fleets, and companies. Combined with our Leasing and Rental business and financial services division, VVG stands as the premier truck dealership.
  
  

**What's in it for You:**  

Velocity Vehicle Group is a dynamic and rapidly expanding organization, and we're on the lookout for individuals who relish daily challenges and are passionate about delivering top\-notch customer service, both within the company and to our valued clients. When you join VVG, you'll experience an extraordinary work environment, complete with competitive compensation and a comprehensive benefits package, including 401K with matching, as well as Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage. Become a part of our team and immerse yourself in a company that fosters a Great Place to Work™ culture!
  
  

**What You’ll Do:**  

The Operations Specialist partners with operations management to drive operational success. A Parts Operation Specialist plays a pivotal role in managing and optimizing the flow of parts within an organization. This professional is responsible for overseeing the entire lifecycle of parts, from procurement to distribution, ensuring efficiency and accuracy at every stage. Their duties involve maintaining inventory levels, tracking shipments, and coordinating with suppliers to guarantee timely delivery of required components. The Parts Operation Specialist collaborates closely with various department levels, such as procurement, logistics, and maintenance, to streamline processes and minimize downtime. Additionally, they may utilize inventory management systems to track stock levels, analyze trends, and make informed decisions to enhance overall operational effectiveness. In essence, a Parts Operation Specialist is a key player in ensuring that the right parts are available at the right time, contributing significantly to the smooth functioning of the organization's processes.
  
  

**Job Duties:**  

* Supports a culture of Safety through reporting, training support and maintaining records
* Ensures vendors are paid timely and accurately utilizing Docuphase
* Monitor and review accounting schedules to provide training and quality assurance within Parts accounting processes
* Reconciles payments daily for Parts Department
* Provides reporting and metrics to Parts Management supporting strategic goals
* Process and support Parts Staff payroll
* Develop process and policies to continuously improve the Parts Department operations
* Willing and able to contribute to strategic projects within the Parts Department


**Required Skills and Qualifications:**  

* Experience as a billing Clerk or similar role is a plus
* Point of sales systems experience preferred
* Basic Accounting knowledge preferred
* Proficient in remote working tools (Zoom, file sharing, etc)
* Well\-developed organizational skills
* Inventory control experience a plus
* Coaching and/or mentoring skills
* Great time\-management skills
* Experience supporting/leading projects and working with lean methodologies
* Heavy\-Duty truck experience preferred
* Ability to travel as needed for the business


**Physical Requirements:**  

* Able to take and pass background check and drug screening.


**Compensation:**  

* $20\-$25/hr. based on skills and experience


**Benefits Velocity Vehicle Group Offers:**  

* Fantastic Culture
* 401k \+ match
* Health, Dental \& Vision Insurance \+ HSA \& FSA
* Employer paid Life Insurance
* Paid Vacation Days
* Sick Leave
* Company perks such as employee discounts, company events and training programs

new_jobs.title: Telephonic Case Manager
new_jobs.description:
Company Overview:

At Enlyte, we combine innovative technology, clinical expertise, and human compassion to help people recover after workplace injuries or auto accidents. We support their journey back to health and wellness through our industry\-leading solutions and services. Whether you're supporting a Fortune 500 client or a local business, developing cutting\-edge technology, or providing clinical services you'll work alongside dedicated professionals who share your commitment to excellence and make a meaningful impact. Join us in fueling our mission to protect dreams and restore lives, while building your career in an environment that values collaboration, innovation, and personal growth. **Be part of a team that makes a real difference.**
Job Description:
**This is a full\-time, flexible work from home position and** **can be located anywhere in the U.S.** **RN Compact license and CA RN license required****English/Spanish bilingual is a plus****URAC\-recognized certification in case management (CCM, CDMS, CRC, CRRN or COHN, COHN\-S, RN\-BC, ACM, CMAC, CMC) preferred.** **Perks:** Full and comprehensive benefits program, 24 days of paid vacation/holidays in your first year plus sick days, home office equipment including laptop and desktop monitor, Employee Assistance and Referral Program, and hands\-on workers’ compensation case management training.  

Join our compassionate team and help make a positive difference in an injured person’s life. As a Telephonic Case Manager, you will work closely with treating physicians/providers, employers, customers, legal representatives, and the injured/disabled person to create and implement a treatment plan that returns the injured/disabled person back to work appropriately, ensure appropriate and cost\-effective healthcare services, achievement of maximum medical recovery and return to an optimal level of work and functioning. In this role, you will:* Demonstrate knowledge, skills, and competency in the application of case management standards of practice.
* Use advanced knowledge of types of injury, medications, comorbidities, treatment options, treatment alternatives, and knowledge of job duties to advise on a treatment plan.
* Interview disabled persons to assess overall recovery, including whether injuries or conditions are occupational or non\-occupational.
* Collaborate with treating physicians/providers and utilize available resources to help create and implement treatment plans tailored to an individual patient.
* Work with employers and physicians to modify job duties where practical to facilitate early return to work.
* Evaluate and modify case goals based on injured/disabled person’s improvement and treatment effectiveness.
* Independently manage workload, including prioritizing cases and deciding how best to manage cases effectively.
* Complete other duties, such as prepare status updates for submittal to customers, assist in training/orientation of new staff as requested, and other duties as assigned.


Qualifications:
* **Education:** Associates Degree or Bachelor’s Degree in Nursing or related field.
* **Experience:** 2\+ years clinical practice preferred. Workers’ compensation\-related experience preferred.
* **Skills:** Ability to advocate recommendations effectively with physicians/providers, employers, and customers. Ability to work independently. Knowledge of basic computer skills including Excel, Word, and Outlook Email. Proficient grammar, sentence structure, and written communication skills.
* **Certifications, Licenses, Registrations:**
	+ Active Registered Nurse (RN) license required. Must be in good standing.
	+ URAC\-recognized certification in case management (CCM, CDMS, CRC, CRRN or COHN, COHN\-S, RN\-BC, ACM, CMAC, CMC).
* **Internet:** Must have reliable internet.

Benefits:

We’re committed to supporting your ultimate well\-being through our total compensation package offerings that support your health, wealth and self. These offerings include Medical, Dental, Vision, Health Savings Accounts / Flexible Spending Accounts, Life and AD\&D Insurance, 401(k), Tuition Reimbursement, and an array of resources that encourage a lifetime of healthier living. Benefits eligibility may differ depending on full\-time or part\-time status. Compensation depends on the applicable US geographic market. The expected base pay for this position ranges from $74,000 \- $86,000 annually, and will be based on a number of additional factors including skills, experience, and education.  

*The Company is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, status as a protected veteran, among other things, or status as a qualified individual with disability.*

new_jobs.title: Client Implementation Manager - Operations & Systems
new_jobs.description:
**The Role**

Are you the person who quietly fixes everything?

The plan is unclear, so you clarify it. The process is broken, so you rebuild it. Other people talk about what should happen; you make sure it actually happens.

But your current role may still have you updating project statuses, sitting in meetings, chasing approvals, and watching good recommendations die in a slide deck.

At PestLaunch, your job is to turn strategy into working systems that produce measurable results for real businesses.

We help pest control company owners grow profitably, strengthen their operations, and build companies that no longer depend on them for every decision. We identify the highest\-priority constraint in the business and prescribe a focused implementation “Play.” You take that approved direction and drive it from idea to verified completion.

That could mean building an office accountability system, launching a customer reactivation campaign, implementing a sales process, creating operational scorecards, organizing a CRM workflow, or turning an inconsistent process into something the client’s team can follow every day.

The strategy sets the destination. You build the road and make sure the client reaches it.

This is not a traditional project\-management role. You will not simply coordinate meetings, update timelines, or pass work between departments. You will plan the implementation, build much of the work yourself, coordinate specialized support when needed, QA every detail, launch the system, and verify that it is being used successfully.

You’ll work closely with the founder and have significant visibility into our clients, systems, and company. The opportunity is substantial: build an exceptional implementation function, improve the way every client result is delivered, and increase the number of businesses PestLaunch can transform.

Responsibilities

* **Own client implementations:** Turn each approved Play into a complete implementation plan with clear deliverables, milestones, owners, dependencies, deadlines, and proof of completion.
* **Build the work:** Create and customize SOPs, scripts, trackers, dashboards, workflows, templates, automations, and other implementation assets.
* **Drive execution:** Keep every active Play moving, resolve dependencies, follow up early, and escalate risks before deadlines slip.
* **Protect the scope:** Execute the approved outcome without allowing unrelated ideas or opportunities to derail the current Play.
* **QA everything:** Verify client information, systems, numbers, links, workflows, formatting, and cross\-references before anything is delivered.
* **Launch and verify:** Ensure the finished system is handed off correctly, adopted by the client’s team, and working as intended.
* **Maintain visibility:** Keep accurate statuses, next actions, owners, deadlines, and progress updates across all active work.
* **Improve the machine:** Turn what works into better Plays, templates, SOPs, checklists, and automations so every implementation becomes faster and stronger.

Requirements

* At least 4 years of experience in implementation, operations, project delivery, consulting, agency operations, or a similar role.
* A track record of personally building systems—not merely recommending or coordinating them.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication. You can turn complexity into a concise plan and explain it without reading from a document.
* Strong operational judgment. You distinguish confirmed facts from assumptions, identify missing information, and ask clear questions early.
* High attention to detail and a strong instinct for quality.
* Comfortable owning multiple implementations without losing deadlines, next actions, or client commitments.
* Highly capable with Google Workspace and modern project\-management systems. Experience with CRMs, dashboards, automations, AI tools, or QuickBooks is valuable.
* Self\-directed and resourceful. You can move forward without step\-by\-step instructions while knowing when a decision requires clarification.
* Comfortable working directly with a fast\-moving founder, receiving candid feedback, and improving quickly.
* Available and consistently reachable during the scheduled working day.
* Authorized to work in the United States.

Experience in home services, pest control, consulting, coaching, SaaS implementation, or a high\-accountability small business is helpful but not required.

This Role Is Probably Not for You If

* You prefer coordinating work over personally building it.
* You need every step mapped out before you can begin.
* You frequently miss small details or rely on someone else to QA your work.
* You confuse activity with completion.
* You tend to expand projects beyond the approved outcome.
* You communicate through long explanations when a clear answer would work.
* You want a large company with narrow responsibilities and multiple layers of management.

Results

You will be successful when:

* Every new Play has a complete implementation plan within 24 hours.
* Every active Play has an accurate next action, owner, and deadline.
* Implementation milestones are completed on time.
* Deliverables pass QA without preventable mistakes or client corrections.
* Work is only marked complete after it has been launched and verified.
* Clients receive systems they can immediately understand and use.
* The founder does not need to chase updates, reconstruct plans, or catch avoidable errors.
* Our Play Library and implementation process improve every month.
* PestLaunch can serve more clients and produce stronger results because of what you build.

Schedule

* Full\-time, Monday through Friday
* 9:00 AM–5:30 PM Mountain Time
* Remote within the United States
* You must be consistently available and responsive throughout the working day
* Most meetings take place on Zoom with professional camera, audio, lighting, and presentation expected

Compensation

* $85,000–$110,000 base salary

new_jobs.title: Account Manager
new_jobs.description:
PakEnergy is a growing fast\-paced company with industry leading products. Expect to learn, to be challenged, and to have fun. We're a trusted partner to more than 2,300 oil \& gas firms, helping our customers innovate with confidence. Our mission is to simplify the hardest problems, automate operations, and help our customers maximize their profitability. We want our customers to be raving fans of PakEnergy. To do that, we need exceptional people on our team.
  

**About the Position:**
The Account Manager will be responsible for managing and nurturing client relationships, with a primary focus on identifying and driving expansion selling and cross\-selling opportunities. This includes proactively identifying additional needs within existing accounts, offering tailored solutions, and maximizing the value of our software products for each client. A deep understanding of the oil and gas industry is essential, as is the ability to effectively communicate how our software solutions can deliver ongoing value, foster long\-term partnerships, and contribute to clients’ success. This position will require up to 50% travel to engage with clients, attend meetings, and explore new business opportunities in key markets.
  

**Qualifications**:
* Experience and proven success in SaaS sales AND
* Experience and proven success in the Oil and Gas industry
* Bachelors degree in Business Administration or similar coursework a plus

**Key Responsibilities:**
* **Client Relationship Management:** AM is responsible for the Executive relationship with the customer. AM will build and maintain strong, long\-lasting client relationships through regular communication, site visits, and feedback sessions to ensure high levels of customer satisfaction.
* **Product Knowledge:** Demonstrate a comprehensive understanding of our software solutions, effectively communicating their benefits and capabilities to clients in the oil and gas sector.
* **Account Growth:** AM is responsible for the account strategy, identifying opportunities for account expansion by understanding clients' evolving needs and suggesting relevant software enhancements or new products.
* **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Partner with technical support, and product teams to ensure that clients’ needs are met, and their expectations are exceeded.
* **Contract Renewal \& Upsell:** Assist CXM in renewal motion. Responsible for commercial relationship with the customer including contractual changes, negotiations or upsell/cross sell opportunities.
* **Reporting \& Documentation:** Maintain accurate records of client interactions, feedback, and account details. Prepare and present regular reports to management on account status, opportunities, and challenges.


**Knowledge, Skills, Abilities Required:**
* **Experience:** 3\-5 years of experience in account management, client relationship management, or a similar role, preferably in the oil and gas or software industries and proficiency with CRM systems (HubSpot, Salesforce, etc.).
* **Industry Knowledge:** Strong understanding of the oil and gas industry, including key processes, challenges, and technologies.
* **Technical Acumen:** Ability to quickly learn and effectively communicate technical software solutions to non\-technical clients.
* **Communication Skills:** Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to influence and engage clients at all levels.
* **Presentation Skills:** Ability to convey a customer story and communicate value to a group by utilizing a presentation in a board room setting or on a video call. (PowerPoint) (Zoom, Teams, etc.)
* **Problem\-Solving:** Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities, with a customer\-centric approach to resolving issues.
* **Project Management:** Experience managing multiple projects simultaneously, ensuring timely delivery and high\-quality results.


  

**Optional but extremely desired skills:*** Experience working with software solutions tailored to the oil and gas industry (ERP, data analytics, production or asset management systems, etc.).


  

**Physical Requirements:**
* Prolonged periods of sitting/standing at a desk and working on a computer.
* Must be able to lift 15 pounds at times.
* Some travel will be required for on\-site client visits \& training.


**Additional Information:**
* We value building direct relationships with our candidates and prefer to manage our hiring process internally. While we occasionally partner with select recruitment agencies for specialized roles, we do not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or agencies without a written agreement executed by the authorized signatory for PakEnergy. Any resumes submitted without an Agreement will be considered the property of PakEnergy, and no recruitment fees will be owed.
* Visa Sponsorship: Employment eligibility to work with PakEnergy in the United States is required, as the company will not pursue visa sponsorship for this position. Candidates are responsible for maintaining and renewing any visas or permits that grant employment eligibility.
* Salary is commensurate with experience (Insert Band) and paid twice monthly via direct deposit. Posted salary ranges are made in good faith. PakEnergy reserves the right to adjust ranges based on qualifications, experience, training, work history, and geographic location of the selected candidate.


**Benefits:** PakEnergy offers a casual business work environment, generous PTO, and a competitive compensation structure that includes sales commissions, paid health insurance and a 401(k)\-retirement plan. We have a positive culture designed around the philosophy of mutual respect and the challenge of contributing to the continued success of our organization. PakEnergy is dedicated to individual growth opportunities, and we would love the opportunity to discuss with you in more detail!

For more information, please visit: www.trimarkusa.com
  
  

Why you’ll love it here!
  
\+ Benefits include Medical, Dental, Vision, Tuition Reimbursement, Pet, and Legal Insurance
  
\+ 401k
  
\+ Community Service Day
  
\+ CFSP Prep Certification Program
  
  

**POSITION SUMMARY:**  

* The Account Manager, National Accounts reports to the Divisional Director, Account Executives. VP \& Director, National Account
* Full\-Time
* Remote


The Account Manager, National Accounts, is a vital role within the organization, responsible for managing and nurturing relationships with national accounts to drive sales and revenue growth. This position requires a dynamic and results\-driven individual with a strong sales background, excellent communication skills, and the ability to strategically manage key accounts. The Account Executive will collaborate closely with internal teams to understand customer needs, develop tailored solutions, and achieve sales targets for national accounts.
  
  

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS \& RESPONSIBILITIES:****National Account Management:**  

* Develop and maintain strong relationships with key decision\-makers at national accounts, serving as the primary point of contact for all sales\-related inquiries and activities.


**Sales Strategy \& Planning:**  

* Develop and implement strategic sales plans to maximize revenue and market share within assigned national accounts, aligning with company objectives and priorities.
* Conduct market research and analysis to identify trends, opportunities, and competitive threats in the industry.


**New Business Development:**  

* Identify and pursue opportunities to expand the company's presence and portfolio within existing national accounts, as well as prospecting and acquiring new national account partnerships.


**Quoting \& Proposal Development:**  

* Prepare and present accurate and compelling sales proposals, quotes, and presentations to national account clients, highlighting the value proposition and benefits of the company's products and services.
* Negotiate pricing, terms, and contracts to secure profitable deals and long\-term partnerships.


**Sales Performance Tracking \& Reporting:**  

* Monitor sales performance metrics, including revenue, sales pipeline, and customer acquisition and retention rates, tracking progress against sales targets and objectives.
* Prepare regular sales reports and updates for management, providing insights and recommendations for optimizing sales strategies and performance.


**Customer Relationship Management:**  

* Maintain detailed records of customer interactions, sales activities, and account information in CRM systems, ensuring accuracy and completeness of data.
* Proactively address customer inquiries, concerns, and escalations, providing timely and effective resolution to maintain high levels of customer satisfaction.


**COMPETENCIES:**  

* Strong understanding of sales principles, techniques, and strategies, with the ability to drive revenue growth and achieve sales targets.
* Exceptional customer service skills with a focus on building and maintaining long\-term relationships with national accounts.
* Ability to develop and execute strategic sales plans and initiatives to achieve business objectives and drive market penetration.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to articulate complex ideas and proposals in a clear and compelling manner.
* Strong negotiation and persuasion skills with the ability to influence key stakeholders and secure favorable terms and agreements.
* Analytical mindset with the ability to identify opportunities, solve problems, and address customer needs effectively.


**QUALIFICATIONS \& EXPERIENCE:**  

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, or related field required, or equivalent military or practical experience.
* 2 – 4 years of experience in sales, account management, or business development, with a proven track record of success in managing national accounts and driving sales growth.
* Experience in the food service industry.


Compensation includes the posted base salary range and does not reflect potential commission, incentive, bonus, or other additional compensation opportunities, where applicable. Total compensation is determined based on experience, skills, internal equity, geographic location, and other job\-related compensatory factors.
